items.synopsis: Over five intense days, 120 Hours Behind Bars delivers an unfiltered look inside America's toughest jails -- where officers are outnumbered, cellblocks are overcrowded, and violence erupts without warning.

items.title: 25 Years of You
items.synopsis: After 25 years of silent devotion, a man finally approaches the woman he has always loved, triggering a chain of revelations tied to a dark incident from their past.

items.title: 4 Blocks Zero
items.synopsis: Travel back to 1990s Berlin and discover the story of a family caught between bureaucracy, politics, and social exclusion, determined to build a new life in Germany.

items.title: 9/11: Reunited
items.synopsis: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

items.title: A Beautiful Obsession
items.synopsis: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

items.title: A Bona Fide Killer
items.synopsis: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.

items.title: A Knight in the Making
items.synopsis: Follow "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" from the page to the screen in this fascinating and comprehensive look at how HBO's newest series in the Game of Thrones universe was brought to life.

items.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
items.synopsis: Seabad sebelum peristiwa Game of Thrones, dua pahlawan yang tak diduga mengembara ke Westeros, Ser Duncan si Tinggi, dan pelayannya, Egg.

items.title: A Love Other Than Yours
items.synopsis: Kisah romansa realistis dan menyentuh tentang pasangan yang telah bersama selama sepuluh tahun, ketika hubungan yang nyaman mulai diuji oleh perasaan tak terduga.

items.title: A Lover in the Mortal World
items.synopsis: Di perbatasan Jinglan dan wilayah suku Changmo, berdiri benteng terpencil Tianglang Pass. Jenderal Xiao Chi, “Dewa Perang Pasukan Kuda Putih”, menghadiri pernikahan bawahannya, namun insiden terjadi saat ia mengetahui sang pengantin wanita dipaksa menikah. Ia segera bertindak, memenjarakan mempelai pria dan menginterogasi pengantin wanita, yang ternyata adalah Han Yunling—gadis yang pernah menyelamatkannya di masa lalu. Terungkap bahwa Han Yunling mengorbankan dirinya demi membebaskan sahabatnya, Jiang Wanyu, yang dipenjara secara tidak adil. Setelah mengetahui kebenaran, Xiao Chi membebaskan keduanya. Namun, Han Yunling menyadari bahwa Xiao Chi menderita penyakit parah yang mengancam nyawanya. Meski diminta merahasiakannya, ia bersikeras bahwa dirinya mampu menyembuhkan sang jenderal.

items.title: A Parasite's Heart
items.synopsis: Bound by an unexpected marriage, Hataya and Ramil are outcasts in their families — but that won't deter them from saving their kin to prove their worth.

items.title: A Secret in Prague
items.synopsis: In a world where love is rarely simple, two people find themselves drawn to each other despite the expectations and struggles surrounding them. As family ties, personal choices, and difficult circumstances test their bond, they must decide how far they are willing to go to protect what they feel.

items.title: A Splendid Match
items.synopsis: Gu Jin Chao, putri sulung keluarga Gu, sejak kecil dibesarkan oleh kakek-neneknya dan hidup bebas tanpa banyak aturan. Meski diabaikan orang tuanya, kasih sayang sang nenek membuatnya tumbuh percaya diri dan berbeda dari wanita lain. Saat kembali ke keluarga Gu, ia harus menghadapi berbagai intrik dan menunjukkan ketegasannya. Kepribadiannya yang unik justru menarik perhatian tiga pria berbeda, yang membawanya ke pusaran hubungan, ambisi, dan pilihan yang tak mudah.

items.title: A Tale of Two Cities
items.synopsis: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

items.title: About Love
items.synopsis: Drama ini menceritakan kisah romantis antara Li Xiaoxi, yang berhati-hati dalam cinta, dan Xiaobei. Kesetiaan dan ketulusan Xiaobei memberi kekuatan bagi Xiaoxi untuk mengatasi rasa takutnya akan cinta. Bersama, mereka menyembuhkan luka lama, belajar saling memahami, dan tumbuh lewat berbagai rintangan hingga menemukan cinta sejati.

items.title: Absolute Value of Romance
items.synopsis: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

items.title: Abyss
items.synopsis: The long-standing peace of a conservative small town is shattered by the appearance of an online novel "Abyss." Many plot points bear a striking resemblance to a cold case from years ago that has never been made public. Li Cheng, a passionate and righteous rookie police officer, engages in a series of high-stakes battles of wits with various suspects. He unravels the mystery, revealing the truth buried beneath heartbreaking kinships and friendships.

items.title: Against the Current
items.synopsis: Cucu bangsawan Shen Jialan harus hidup sebagai pelayan setelah keluarganya dihukum mati dan tunangannya membatalkan pernikahan. Dalam identitas baru sebagai Xu Lanxiang, ia tak menyerah pada nasib. Akankah ia bisa membalas dendam, menuntut keadilan, dan merebut kembali hidupnya yang hilang?

items.title: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
items.synopsis: Saat pesta mewah di rumah pedesaan berakhir dengan pembunuhan, seorang bangsawan muda cerdas bertekad memecahkan misterinya di adaptasi novel karya Agatha Christie ini.

items.title: Agent from Above
items.synopsis: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

items.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
items.synopsis: Ketika putri seorang ayah yang sederhana hilang, dia membersihkan keterampilan operasi hitam lamanya untuk melacaknya - hanya untuk menarik perhatian yang salah.

items.title: Alkhallat+: The Series
items.synopsis: A Saudi anthology series from the creators of the beloved AlKhallat+ universe, now streaming on Netflix. Four standalone stories drop ordinary underdogs — an anxious teen, a clueless security guard, a desperate filmmaker, and a tongue-tied poet — into absurdly chaotic desert situations. Sharp satire, dry humour, and authentic Saudi cultural identity make each episode a wildly entertaining ride.

items.title: ALL or NOTHING
items.synopsis: Six idols – Lee Teuk and Shin Dong of Super Junior, Kim Yo Han of WEi, Johnny and Ji Sung of NCT, and soloist DAWN – are all set to spend a week together in Egypt. Of course, there's a twist involved: as they travel, they must complete a series of missions that will affect their future plans. The winners will become "princes," receiving luxury accommodations, meals and other perks, while the losers become “beggars,” continuing their journey under limited conditions. Each mission becomes a battle to decide who will travel in comfort and style, and who will have to tough it out.

items.title: All the Truth in My Lies
items.synopsis: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

items.title: American Hostage
items.synopsis: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

items.title: Among Us
items.synopsis: Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs.

items.title: Ancient Bracelet
items.synopsis: Healer A Zhao, a descendant of a goddess from the Wuyue Clan, falls in love with Ying Du, the ruler of the Puluo Kingdom, only to witness him massacre her clan and become bound to him across three lifetimes by a time-reversing bracelet. As A Zhao uncovers the truth and challenges heavenly law, she fights to break their cursed fate and reclaim their love.

items.title: Anna Pigeon
items.synopsis: Anna Pigeon flees city life for the solitude of America's stunning national parks following a devastating loss; while Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds.

items.title: Archives: The Nanyang Mystery
items.synopsis: In the early days of the Republic of China, a mysterious murder at sea draws Zhang Haiyan and his partner into an investigation that quickly spirals into a dangerous conspiracy. What begins as a search for truth aboard the massive ship Nan'an becomes a fight for survival in a world of intrigue and betrayal.

items.title: As Promised
items.synopsis: After dying 33 times while trying to win a crown prince's love, a palace maid learns that her fate is tied to a rival prince and joins forces with him to break the cycle.

items.title: Ashes to Crown
items.synopsis: Chu Zhao, putri jenderal yang bertindak lebih awal demi terlepas dari takdir menyedihkannya yang menjadi pengorbanan dalam perebutan takhta Xiao Xun, dia membantai sepanjang jalan dengan bantuan Xie Yanlai, melindungi cucu pertama Kaisar masuk ke istana menemui Kaisar, bermain strategi di hadapan Kaisar, membantu cucu pertama Kaisar meneruskan takhta, serta memutuskan jalan Xiao Xun untuk naik takhta. Kaisar baru naik takhta, Dinasti Chu diserang dari luar dan dalam, Chu Zhao bekerja sama dengan Xie Yanlai membalikkan keadaan dengan unik, memimpin pasukan unutk berperang, dan sepenuhnya mengubah takdir mereka serta membuat rakyat Dinasti Chu terlepas dari takdir sengsara akibat perang.

items.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
items.synopsis: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

items.title: Awaken
items.synopsis: During World War II, photographer Chen Kailai unexpectedly becomes involved in an underground resistance mission to stop the Japanese army’s secret biological experiment. Taking up his fallen mentor’s codename, he joins fellow spies in a perilous fight to expose the enemy’s crimes and prevent a viral catastrophe.

items.title: Azure Spring
items.synopsis: Two people stuck in their lives become haenyeo divers, finding healing and new meaning in the sea as they confront their pasts and fears together.

items.title: Bake Your Dream
items.synopsis: Bake Your Dream is a global pastry competition where elite and rising pastry chefs face off in intense challenges, blending technique, creativity, and passion to claim the ultimate title.

items.title: Bandi
items.synopsis: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

items.title: Bapa Mentuaku Mafia
items.synopsis: Bapa Mentuaku Mafia follows Takdir, a principled young Islamic teacher whose peaceful life is disrupted when mafia boss Zack kidnaps him and forces him to marry his daughter, Melissa. Thrust into a dangerous world of crime, family secrets and complicated relationships, Takdir struggles to uphold his faith while attempting to reform his new family and transform their illegal business.

items.title: Battle of Fates
items.synopsis: Is our fate predetermined? And can anyone truly read it? A groundbreaking competition dares to find out. Korea's top 49 top Fate Readers—masters of shamanism, saju, tarot, and face reading—put their pride on the line. Only those who can genuinely read fate will survive. Who will be the winner?

items.title: Because It’s All For You
items.synopsis: A bride is poisoned during her wedding reception, forcing the groom and a photographer to investigate the guests as dark secrets and hypocrisies among the bride's friends and family are revealed.

items.title: Below
items.synopsis: Ketika seekor makhluk laut misterius meneror sebuah kota kecil di Newfoundland, seorang nelayan tangguh dan keluarganya berjuang untuk melindungi komunitas yang erat ini.

items.title: Benidorm Is Murder
items.synopsis: Former detective Dennis Crown has swapped the chaos of the UK for a quieter life running a bar in Benidorm. But when tourists start turning up dead, he's reluctantly drawn back into detective work-egged on by his barmaid Rosa, a crime drama superfan. With Dennis's real-world experience and Rosa's encyclopaedic TV knowledge, each episode sees the duo tackling a new murder in paradise, whilst trying to remain on the right side of the local Spanish cops.

items.title: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.synopsis: Haus akan aksi perampokan baru, Berlin memanggil gengnya ke Sevilla dan menjadikan duke yang ambisius sebagai korban dari rencananya sendiri: mencuri mahakarya da Vinci.

items.title: Best Medicine
items.synopsis: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they’ve got.

items.title: Besties' Coming Fortune
items.synopsis: Two modern best friends find themselves inside a household-intrigue novel as sisters-in-law destined for tragic deaths. As they outwit deadly schemes and find love with two brothers from the Shen family, they uncover an old injustice and a royal conspiracy that could determine their family's fate.

items.title: Between Steps
items.synopsis: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

items.title: Big Girls Wanted: Escaping Pearadise
items.synopsis: Pearadise promised safety and a utopia for plus‑size women. The sisterhood turns dark as allegations of assault and coercion spread among the women.

items.title: Big Mistakes
items.synopsis: Dipaksa bekerja untuk orang-orang berbahaya, dua kakak beradik yang sangat tidak kompeten ini menjadi duo paling kacau dalam dunia kejahatan terorganisasi.

items.title: Black and Jewish America: An Interwoven History
items.synopsis: Four-part docuseries that explores the complex relationship between Black Americans and Jewish Americans - forged in shared struggle, tested by division, and representing a uniquely American experience.

items.title: Black Coral
items.synopsis: While searching for a legendary coral reef near a cursed island, a marine biologist uncovers a web of conspiracies, local legends, and hidden crimes that threaten both his mission and his life.

items.title: Black Island Prison
items.synopsis: A detective infiltrates a notorious prison to investigate disappearances while a retired soldier enters to rescue a mother and daughter, forcing the two enemies to work together against a criminal conspiracy.

items.title: BLACK TRICK: The Lawyer Who Controls Justice
items.synopsis: In a society shaped by the internet and media, a lawyer fights to clear the names of those wrongly accused by exposing the truth behind carefully crafted lies.

items.title: Blazing Summer
items.synopsis: Cast members of "Never-Ending Summer" reunite for a two-day variety show experience, taking part in games and compatibility tests to determine the best acting duo.

items.title: Blood Sacrifice
items.synopsis: Setelah pembunuhan brutal dua polisi, seorang detektif gigih terpaksa bekerja sama dengan ayahnya yang mantan polisi dan tak akrab dengannya, untuk menangkap si pembunuh.

items.title: Blood vs Duty
items.synopsis: In the world of crime and injustice, dangerous missions force those on opposite sides of the law to choose between protecting family and doing their duty.

items.title: Bloody Flower
items.synopsis: A former medical school dropout claiming to be able to cure terminal illnesses is sentenced to death for the murder of 17 people. Is he a monstrous killer, or a savior holding the cure for humanity?

items.title: Bloody Smart
items.synopsis: In a town where strict rules shape students into their “best selves,” a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly “need” them. Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unraveling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.

items.title: Bloom Life
items.synopsis: A heartwarming tale follows three sisters from Kashgar's ancient city as they navigate love, family bonds, and life's storms together, rebuilding their lives with resilience and hope.

items.title: Blossom Through the Cloud
items.synopsis: Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

items.title: Blossoms of Power
items.synopsis: Satu-satunya korban pembantaian yang selamat, Gu Qingzhi, terbangun dengan identitas barunya sebagai Shen Xihe. Dari yang dulunya gadis cantik dari perbatasan yang pemberani, ia menjelma jadi putri dingin nan mematikan. Di sisi

items.title: Bonjour Bakery
items.synopsis: When top movie stars meet senior citizens, a truly heartwarming chemistry is about to unfold! "Bonjour Bakery" sets its scene in a tranquil rural village, creating Korea's first cafe exclusively for the elderly. Here, more than just desserts are sold; stories are shared. A super-warm "service team" composed of Kim Hee-ae and Kim Seon-ho heals each senior with gentle conversations and kind smiles; in the kitchen, "all-around chef" Cha Seung-won and Lee Ki-taek transform local ingredients into exquisite works of art. Watch as these celebrities accompany seniors as they reminisce about their lives, spreading warmth through the aroma of bread.

items.title: Born Again
items.synopsis: After being murdered at her own wedding by those closest to her, a top influencer becomes trapped in an endless time loop. With each resurrection, she uncovers more of the conspiracy and joins forces with a doctor who remembers the loops to prevent the tragedy before it happens.

items.title: Born to Be Alive
items.synopsis: In 1990s Qinghai’s Maji County, rampant poaching plunged the region into poverty. Deputy County Head Dorje’s mountain patrol team shifted from mineral exploration to protecting antelopes. Bai Ju, a fearless female officer raised by a Tibetan doctor, grew into a leader fighting for a nature reserve with her comrades and journalist lover, only to face Dorje’s mysterious disappearance. Decades later, as coal mining threatens the eco-balance again, Bai Ju reunites with allies to solve the cold case and uphold the legacy of safeguarding the Tibetan Plateau’s untouched beauty.

items.title: Born with Luck
items.synopsis: Zhang Yi'ang, seorang polisi yang sudah beberapa tahun meninggalkan lini depan penyelidikan kriminal, dikirim ke Sanjiangkou setelah kementerian provinsi menerima surat laporan anonim. Tak lama setelah ia tiba di Sanjiangkou, kapten unit kriminal tewas dibunuh. Saat berusaha membersihkan nama dirinya, Zhang Yi'ang justru secara tak sengaja menangkap pelaku pembunuhan berantai, membuat reputasinya naik dengan cepat.\NIa kemudian memusatkan arah penyelidikan pada kelompok pengusaha kaya setempat, Zhou Rong, namun para pencuri bodoh terus bermunculan. Intrik di antara para pencuri itu menimbulkan efek kupu-kupu yang justru membantu tim polisi yang dipimpin Zhang Yi'ang mencapai banyak keberhasilan. “Takdir” mempertemukan Zhang Yi'ang dengan seluruh para pencuri tersebut, dan dengan kecerdasan serta keberaniannya, ia menjadi orang yang tertawa terakhir. Ia juga berhasil mengungkap penyebab tewasnya rekan sesama polisi, dan pada akhirnya menangkap pelaku sebenarnya.

items.title: Boyfriend on Demand
items.synopsis: Seo Mi-rae kelelahan karena pekerjaan. Cinta tak terpikirkan olehnya. Namun, layanan kencan virtual memicu timbulnya perasaan—dan mungkin peluang nyata dalam percintaan.

items.title: Braving the Famine with My Wife
items.synopsis: Dewa Zhao Dong yang hanya berfokus pada pencerahan dan mengabaikan ikatan duniawi akhirnya dikhianati dan meninggal dengan penuh penyesalan. Setelah terlahir kembali, ia menempati tubuh Zhao Dong, seorang preman desa yang memiliki nama sama dengannya. Dalam kehidupan barunya di dunia fana, ia berusaha menghadapi masa lalu dan mencari kesempatan untuk menebus penyesalannya.

items.title: Brazil '70: The Third Star
items.synopsis: Tahun 1970, tim nasional Brasil turun ke lapangan dengan mimpi besar dan tantangan yang jauh lebih besar: menjadi peraih pertama juara dunia tiga kali.

items.title: Cabbage Your Life
items.synopsis: When executive Seong Tae-hun is abruptly reassigned to the remote village of Yeonri‑ri, his family is thrown into rural chaos. Mi-ryeo struggles with farm life, Ji-cheon begins to rethink his future, and the wary village chief keeps his distance. As homesickness grows and tensions rise, the family must decide whether to endure—or find their way back home.

items.title: Calabasas Confidential
items.synopsis: After graduating college, the group return to Calabasas for “a summer they’ll never forget”. Back home and living in their parents’ hillside mansions, they’ll be faced with the daunting reality of confronting unresolved drama while trying to define what’s next for their lives and relationships. Four years may have put distance between them, but new flames, old feuds, and unexpected secrets don’t stay hidden forever behind the gates of LA’s most envied zip code.

items.title: Can This Love Be Translated?
items.synopsis: Seorang selebritas dan juru bahasanya dilanda emosi yang sulit dipahami ketika mereka berkeliling dunia untuk syuting acara TV. Akankah cinta menemukan bahasanya sendiri?

items.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
items.synopsis: Debbie Fenton is a granny, lawn bowler, tinpot dictator - who will stop at nothing to make sure her family's protected. Unfortunately, most of the time the person they really need protecting from is her. When her hermit-like husband William unexpectedly dies, she makes an outlandish decision that will put the family under more pressure than ever before.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.synopsis: Masalah besar akan menimpa sepasang suami-istri pengacara saat seorang pembunuh ternama dari masa lalu mereka bebas dari penjara.

items.title: Captain Isfandyar Shaheed
items.synopsis: The nation always comes first. For Captain Isfandyar, patriotism was more than just a word. It was a way of life. He faced every challenge with courage, every threat with determination, and every sacrifice with pride. His journey serves as a powerful reminder of what it truly means to serve the nation.

items.title: Carrie
items.synopsis: Setelah kematian ayahnya yang mendadak dan terlalu cepat menjerumuskannya dalam lingkungan sekolah menengah atas negeri, Carrie terpaksa mengatasi skandal perundungan viral yang menghebohkan komunitasnya, tekanan tanpa henti, dan kekejaman yang kerap terjadi di era media sosial, serta bangkitnya kekuatan telekinesis misterius yang muncul bersamaan dengan masa remajanya.

items.title: Catedrales
items.synopsis: A 17-year-old girl is found burned and dismembered in an empty lot in a middle-class neighborhood of Santiago, Chile. Due to police negligence, the crime goes unpunished until thirty years later, when the family manages to piece together the murder puzzle, revealing a forbidden relationship and a cruel truth.

items.title: Cautiva
items.synopsis: An Argentine dramatic television miniseries co-produced by TNT and FLOW. It follows the life of a nun who, after fifteen years, manages to escape from a cloistered convent where she was a victim of psychological abuse and held against her will. Starring Carolina Kopelioff, Lorena Vega, Rita Cortese, and Julieta Zylberberg.

items.title: CIA
items.synopsis: When by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman is loaned out to a clandestine CIA/FBI task force, he finds himself teamed up with secretive and roguish CIA case officer Colin Glass. Together they work covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells, and geopolitical secrets.

items.title: City of Blood
items.synopsis: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

items.title: City Rong
items.synopsis: After his family is massacred, Lian Ye teams up with police official Li Mingyuan and dance hall owner Chen Dieyi to investigate the tragedy. Their investigation exposes a Japanese espionage conspiracy threatening the city, forcing them to fight the invaders and defend their homeland.

items.title: Climax
items.synopsis: An ambitious prosecutor rises through Korea’s elite by marrying a famous actress, only to be pulled into a ruthless power cartel where hidden informants, corporate heirs, and political players collide in a brutal struggle for survival and control.

items.title: Cocktail Wars
items.synopsis: Pits America’s buzziest mixologists against each other in a lively, high-stakes competition with $10,000 on the line in every episode. Each installment showcases a fast, fiery battle of skill, creativity, humor, and flair. From playful flavor combinations to eye-catching technique, the focus is on having a good time, taking risks, and serving up drinks with personality. Each shake, stir, and splash could be the winning touch or the one that sends them home. It’s a cocktail competition where the vibes are high, the drinks are strong, and the bragging rights are everything.

items.title: Colosio: Political Assassination
items.synopsis: A docuseries examining one of Mexico's most controversial political events: the 1994 assassination of presidential candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio. It explores the investigation, contradictions, and unanswered questions surrounding the case.

items.title: Coven Academy
items.synopsis: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

items.title: Crap Happens
items.synopsis: Raper Toni kembali ke kampung halaman untuk pemakaman sang ibu, dan mendapati dirinya mengejar karier impian sekaligus mendadak menjadi ayah untuk seorang putra remaja.

items.title: Crew Girl
items.synopsis: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

items.title: Crystal Lake
items.synopsis: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

items.title: Cupertino
items.synopsis: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

items.title: Curtain Up, Class!
items.synopsis: Actress Kim Tae-ri, a first-time teacher, starts a theatre club at a rural school on the verge of closure. Together with the students, she builds a unique after-school theatre club, capturing real, unscripted lessons and growth. As the stage comes to life, small changes begin to ripple beyond the classroom.

items.title: D.O.P.E. Unit
items.synopsis: After the murder of a police chief’s son, a covert, off-the-books task force is assembled to infiltrate Philadelphia’s most dangerous crime families, but as the investigation deepens, the line between cop and criminal disappears, and no one walks away clean.

items.title: Daldal
items.synopsis: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

items.title: Dalliance
items.synopsis: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

items.title: Dang!
items.synopsis: After their sister Ruthie blows up her perfect life, Andrew and Eunice show her the fun in being flawed as she helps them adult.

items.title: Dating Alys Perez
items.synopsis: Years after moving to the US, Alys returns home as a successful pastry chef while building a life with Tripp. But seeing Drake again revives old feelings and unresolved heartbreak, pulling the three into an emotional journey of love, sacrifice, and second chances.

items.title: Dazzling
items.synopsis: After a family emergency, Qing Ye returned to her hometown in her senior year of high school. Finding it difficult to adjust after spending most of her life in a bustling city, Qing Ye vows to leave as soon as she gets a chance. But when she meets Xing Wu, a local teen who's struggling with school, she resolves to help him graduate. Gradually, Xing Wu and Qing Ye grow closer to each other, despite their different personalities and priorities in life. Upon graduating high school, Qing Ye moves away for university, but ends up returning years later – and so does Xing Wu, who still has feelings for Qing Ye. Will this second chance give them a chance to finally realize their feelings for each other?

items.title: Deadly Tag
items.synopsis: A brutal chase for survival across a vast battlefield where no one can be trusted and only the last one standing wins.

items.title: Dear Life
items.synopsis: After losing her fiancé, a grieving woman tracks down the recipients of his donated organs, leading to unexpected connections and emotional revelations.

items.title: Dear Song
items.synopsis: Yu Song enters the Song family as an assistant to seek justice for her father. With Song Cheng's trust and the driver's help, she gathers evidence to expose the family's crimes.

items.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
items.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

items.title: Delusion
items.synopsis: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

items.title: Devkhel
items.synopsis: Every Holi in Devtali, a death is blamed on the mythical demon, Shankasur. Inspector Vishwas investigates the latest death, only to uncover an unsettling truth about the alleged divine punishment.

items.title: Director’s Arena
items.synopsis: In the first-ever directorial survival show, short-form drama directors compete to prove they have what it takes to capture audiences' attention.

items.title: Dive Into You
items.synopsis: An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

items.title: Doctor on the Edge
items.synopsis: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

items.title: Doctor Qin: Executer
items.synopsis: Forensic pathologist Qin Ming investigates a woman's brutal murder and uncovers a series of connected cases tied to a mysterious avenger, a secret room, and a decade-old revenge plot.

items.title: Doctor Sin
items.synopsis: A medical thriller melodrama depicting the events that unfold between a genius doctor and the woman he loves after a chance accident.

items.title: Doctor X: Age of the White Mafia
Dongbei's Back
items.synopsis: After facing major setbacks in his career, Zhou Dongbei returns to Northeast China determined to rebuild his life, protect his family’s legacy, and fight his way back to success.

items.title: Double Lives of Suburban Wives
items.synopsis: On the surface, they're wives, mothers, and suburban neighbors, but that's only half the story. Behind closed doors, these six St. Louis women secretly make a living creating spicy content.

items.title: Dream
items.synopsis: Years ago, journalist Shen Leshui recorded the lives of workers at the Old La City Brewery. Now she returns to La City, picks up her camera again, and explores corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan, Cheng Youtian... These people, once the subjects of her lens, experience the rise and fall of fate in the torrent of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time. Moving between the past and the present, Shen Leshui uncovers these chapters of the past buried by time.

items.title: Dream of Golden Years
items.synopsis: After being set up by her company, 36-year-old executive Xia Xiaolan wakes up as her 18-year-old self in a poor village. Determined to change her fate, she pursues education while building a business empire from nothing. Along the way, she finds love, support, and a renewed sense of purpose, proving that courage and determination lead to true success.

items.title: Dream Stage
items.synopsis: A fallen music producer hits rock bottom and finds redemption by training a struggling boy band, navigating fierce K-POP competition and forging unbreakable bonds along the way.

items.title: Dream to You
items.synopsis: Bermimpi menjadi pembuat film, seorang siswa SMA yang penuh semangat mengesampingkan semua kewajibannya untuk membuat film pendek, menginspirasi seorang teman sekelas yang rajin belajar tetapi kurang bersemangat. Ikatan mendalam mereka akhirnya berubah menjadi romantis, tetapi mereka tiba-tiba terpisah ketika dia terpaksa pindah ke luar negeri. Bertahun-tahun kemudian di usia tiga puluhan, kehidupan mereka telah sepenuhnya bertukar: dia adalah seorang reporter TV yang kecewa dan berjuang, sementara dia telah menjadi sutradara pemenang penghargaan. Ketika sebuah pertemuan tiba-tiba mempertemukan mereka, dia bertekad untuk membantunya menemukan kembali semangatnya yang hilang, tetapi dia masih menyimpan dendam yang mendalam atas kepergiannya di masa lalu.

items.title: Driving Mom Crazy
items.synopsis: After criminals kidnap her baby, overwhelmed new mom Ruyi Zhang joins an unlikely crew of gangsters, ghosts and deities for a frantic rescue mission.

items.title: DTF St. Louis
items.synopsis: A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

items.title: Durrani: Perjuangan Lion Mum
items.synopsis: After clinching a major win in a high stakes divorce case, ambitious lawyer and Lion Mum, Durrani (Nurul Aini) treads into the unpredictable world of family law. She soon learns that it's an entirely different battlefield - one where love, loss and conflict blur the lines between right and wrong, and every case tests not just her skill, but her heart.

items.title: Dutton Ranch
items.synopsis: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

items.title: Earle Meets World
items.synopsis: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

items.title: East of Eden
items.synopsis: Pada awal 1900-an, seorang wanita yang sangat mandiri menciptakan perpecahan di antara dua bersaudara, memicu saga yang membentang melintasi dua generasi.

items.title: Echoes of a Thousand Moons
items.synopsis: During a brutal war, cook Meng Wanfu is mistaken for a fugitive general and steps in to protect the general’s family, while the real General Zhang Yunkui, feeling powerless, joins the guerrilla fighters; together, their courage and loyalty help carry their nation through its darkest hour.

items.title: El tiempo de las moscas (Time Flies)
Elite Force
items.synopsis: Setelah pasukannya mengalami serangan luar biasa, seorang perwira tinggi yang bersiap meninggalkan lapangan memimpin misi berbahaya yang memaksanya menghadapi masa lalu.

items.title: Elle
items.synopsis: Sebelum Elle Woods bagai ikan keluar air di Harvard, kita menjumpainya di tahun 1995 di perairan ganas SMA tempat dia menghadapi pertemanan yang sulit, cinta terlarang, dan pilihan busana yang patut dipertanyakan. Dalam bab tak terduga selama masa remajanya ini, kita menyaksikan pengalaman yang membentuk Elle menjadi wanita muda ikonik yang kita cintai.

items.title: ER: Caught on Camera
items.synopsis: Follow first-person confessional accounts of medical emergencies from the people who survived them.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.synopsis: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

items.title: Every Year After
items.synopsis: Selama enam musim panas, Barry's Bay menjadi tempat penuh keajaiban dan pengalaman pertama bagi Percy Fraser, termasuk cinta pertama-dan patah hati pertamanya. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, tragedi tak terduga membawa Percy kembali, di mana dia harus menghadapi orang-orang, kenangan, dan kesalahan yang dia kira telah dia lupakan, terutama satu orang yang mengubah hidupnya selamanya-Sam Florek.

items.title: Excellent Women
items.synopsis: Psychic Wu Yue joins forces with a policewoman, a forensic examiner, and a sketch artist to investigate a string of shocking cases, from fake resurrections to serial murders. As their all-female team digs deeper, Wu Yue crosses paths with wealthy heir Ji Wenxuan, whose carefully hidden secret draws them into a dangerous family conspiracy. With the truth slowly surfacing, the women must confront not only cunning killers, but the darker side of human desire and revenge itself.

items.title: Extraordinary Attorney Minami
items.synopsis: With her extraordinary memory and unique perspective, Minami takes on challenges in and out of the courtroom as a rookie lawyer on the autism spectrum.

items.title: Eyes of the Sky
items.synopsis: When Huo Ming loses his memory in an accident, a hidden AI chip awakens superhuman abilities within him. Caught in Lin Yun’s corporate battle, he must confront hidden truths, protect those he cares about, and find love, all while redefining who he really is.

items.title: Family Register
items.synopsis: Judged as a mistress’s daughter, a young woman fights a stigma she never chose. Meanwhile, another woman’s life stands still after her husband's betrayal. Bound together by the death of the man who tore their lives apart, these two apparent enemies are forced to confront one another under one roof. As families scarred by hatred and heartbreak collide, old wounds resurface. Facing years of prejudice, they set out to reclaim their lives and transform their bitter fate into an unexpected family bond.

items.title: Farm Busily in the Cold Palace
items.synopsis: After traveling back to ancient times, modern office worker Lu Yunluo finds herself as a neglected imperial consort in the Cold Palace. When she meets the newly enthroned Emperor Ji Wujue, she uses her knowledge of medicine and agriculture to transform her circumstances and their lives.

items.title: Fascination
items.synopsis: Lin Moqing assumes a false identity to manipulate and train Lan Hewei as part of a calculated plan against his powerful family. But as deception, shifting alliances, and hidden motives collide, Lan Hewei proves far more formidable than he expected. What begins as a strategic game of control gradually evolves into a tense and unpredictable relationship, where rivalry and attraction blur—and neither can fully anticipate who will come out on top.

items.title: Fatal Proximity to Him
items.synopsis: A time-traveling ballerina and a troubled student are trapped in a deadly cycle of love and death, forcing them to find the killer before fate repeats itself.

items.title: Fate Chooses You
items.synopsis: Lu Qianqiao, anggota Suku Roh Perang yang harus mematahkan kutukan dan bereinkarnasi menjadi manusia demi menyelamatkan garis keturunannya. Ia menyamar sebagai pejabat korup dan menikahi Xin Mei, seorang kultivator yang membawa nasib buruk bagi suaminya. Namun ketika rahasia dan bahaya mulai terungkap, keduanya justru terikat dalam takdir yang mempertemukan mereka kembali dan perlahan mengubah hubungan di antara mereka.

items.title: Fifties Professionals
items.synopsis: Three seemingly ordinary but deadly uncles, whose fate sets them in motion again. It depicts the everyday lives of three middle-aged men, who have lived 50% of their lives, and the realistic comedy of these uncles who are even sadder because they were successful in their past.

items.title: Fightland
items.synopsis: A disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime syndicate he thinks betrayed him.

items.title: Filing for Love
items.synopsis: A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

items.title: Final Table
items.synopsis: The Table: K-Chef 2026 mempertemukan para chef top Korea untuk bersaing demi gelar chef terbaik Korea. Chef terkenal misterius, Chris K., alias Kang Han, Song-yi, yang berjuang menyelamatkan restorannya, chef bintang perfeksionis Woo-jin, serta para chef lain beradu dalam pertarungan kuliner sengit. Namun, di balik kompetisi itu, mereka menemukan kehangatan dalam hidangan dan kebersamaan.

items.title: Finding Her Edge
items.synopsis: Seorang mantan atlet ice dance kembali ke arena dengan pasangan baru yang seru sambil menyimpan perasaan terhadap mantan pasangannya, yang adalah cinta pertamanya.

items.title: Fired Up!
items.synopsis: Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life’s challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

items.title: Forever Home
items.synopsis: Carol Crottie grows suspicious when her husband Robert, suffering from dementia, refuses to leave their home. She begins to question what really happened to his first wife Joan, who vanished with his brother two decades earlier.

items.title: Forging Justice
items.synopsis: In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.

items.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
items.synopsis: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

items.title: Fresh off the Sea in Calape
Furious
items.synopsis: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

items.title: Game Day Murders
items.synopsis: Veteran sportscaster Lindsay Czarniak explores the deadly intersection of sports and crime through six murder investigations involving athletes. Each episode blends a gripping whodunit with the culture surrounding the game.

items.title: Gang War: Oslo
items.synopsis: An inside look at Norway's criminal landscape since the 1980s -- as told by those who ruled the streets and lived to share their stories.

items.title: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm
items.synopsis: The GBRB crew returns for a new challenge as Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo swap city life for the ranch. Spending several days alongside experienced ranchers, the trio learns the essentials of raising dairy cows and horses while experiencing the hard work and philosophy behind livestock farming. From feeding animals to tackling demanding daily tasks, the three celebrities approach every mission with determination, humor, and plenty of mishaps. Their playful chemistry and growing bond with the animals create both hilarious and heartwarming moments. Blending comedy, friendship, and the charm of rural life, the show offers a refreshing look at ranch life and the unexpected rewards of working together in nature.

items.title: Generation to Generation
items.synopsis: Di dunia persilatan penuh tipu daya ini, Mu Qingyan yang dingin penuh strategi, dan Caizhao pendekar yang santai, terseret dalam hubungan tarik-ulur penuh cinta dan luka. Saat mereka membongkar kepalsuan di dunia silat, akankah cinta bertahan dalam pusaran rahasia?

items.title: Genius Girlfriend
items.synopsis: A genius girl and her childhood sweetheart navigate life's challenges from campus to marriage in this heartwarming coming-of-age story filled with wit, warmth and youthful passion.

items.title: Girl from Nowhere: The Reset
items.synopsis: Di semesta baru, Nanno yang misterius menjadi murid pindahan, menguak kekejaman dengan membuat kekuasaan, rasa bersalah, dan hasrat berbalik melawan para pelaku kejinya.

items.title: Girl Taken
items.synopsis: Follow the story of twin sisters Lily and Abby, whose lives are shattered when Lily is abducted from their quiet rural English town by beloved local teacher Rick Hansen. After years of abuse in captivity, Lily escapes - only to discover that freedom brings its own challenges.

items.title: Glitter & Gold: Ice Dancing
items.synopsis: Delves into competitive ice dance's intense world, where deep partnerships, total dedication, and raw emotions merge in the pursuit of Olympic gold.

items.title: Glory in Shadows
items.synopsis: Putri keluarga Shen, Shen Yaochu, dipaksa menikah dengan seorang jenderal yang dikira telah meninggal, namun ternyata masih hidup. Setelah ibunya tewas karena fitnah, ia bekerja sama dengan sang jenderal untuk mengungkap intrik dan konspirasi di dalam keluarga bangsawan, hingga kebenaran terungkap dan cinta pun tumbuh di antara mereka.

items.title: Gnomes
items.synopsis: Senior Sergeant Arnold Kipps is having the worst day of his life. His ex-partner returns to Nompton to shut down his police station, just as an ancient evil is awakened by the Gnome Queen who unleashes a hellish horde, plunging the town into chaos.

items.title: Gold Wars Downunder
items.synopsis: Gold Wars Downunder follows three hardcore mining teams as they battle it out on the one patch of gold-rich-land to see who can unearth the biggest nuggets and the most gold in an epic made-for-television gold hunting season. The sale of gold is an important source of income for hundreds of thousands of Australians, including the men and women willing to risk it all, as they venture into some of the most dangerous and inhospitable territory on the planet - hoping to strike it rich.

items.title: Golden Axe
items.synopsis: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

items.title: Goldland
items.synopsis: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

items.title: Gomorrah: The Origins
items.synopsis: The series Gomorrah - The Origins explores Pietro Savastano's youth in the 1970s, in a Naples undergoing a transformation, poverty-stricken and plagued by cigarette smuggling. The story begins in 1977 with a very young Pietro, the son of no one, growing up as an adoptive brother in a family in the poorest part of Secondigliano. A street kid, he scrapes by as best he can, dreaming of a well-being that is still denied him. The story unfolds through Pietro's loss of innocence, along with his brothers and lifelong friends, their ambitions, and his first great love, which, like that of every teenager, will be wild and passionate. His encounter with Angelo, known as 'A Sirena,' the regent of Secondigliano, marks his entry into the world of crime. Through violence, alliances, and betrayals, Pietro discovers the price that life takes.

items.title: Good Boys Go to Heaven
items.synopsis: The tragic death of a son in the remote town of Kuala Makar forces a father to track down suspicious individuals to find the real killer and clear his name.

items.title: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God 10th Anniversary
items.synopsis: Ten years after Goblin, Gong Yoo, Lee Dong-wook, Kim Go-eun, and Yoo In-na reunite for a special journey, revisiting iconic locations from the drama and sharing memories, stories, and reflections on one of Korea's most beloved series.

items.title: Habeas Corpus
items.synopsis: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

items.title: Hacked
items.synopsis: Every day, Belgian companies, government agencies, and ordinary citizens fall victim to cybercriminals. But how do they operate? And how easy is it really to break into something? Our tech journalist Kenneth Dée puts it to the test with a team of hackers for the new Streamz series ‘Hacked’.

items.title: Half-awake
items.synopsis: Dikenal sebagai CEO yang kejam dan dingin, Gu Yixiao hanya memiliki satu kelemahan—sekretarisnya, Ye Xingwan. Akibat sebuah kesalahpahaman 15 tahun lalu, ia menyusun berbagai rencana untuk mengendalikan dan menyiksa Ye Xingwan. Tak mau terus hidup dalam penderitaan, Ye Xingwan yang tampak lembut mulai melawan. Ia menjadikan dirinya sebagai umpan dan menyeret Gu Yixiao ke dalam permainan cinta yang rumit. Pada akhirnya, ia menyaksikan penyesalan Gu Yixiao dan awal dari penebusannya, namun apakah hatinya benar-benar dapat menemukan ketenangan dan kebahagiaan?

items.title: Hanyi Enters the Heart
items.synopsis: Seluruh keluarga Shen dibantai, dan Shen Li yang masih kecil menjadi saksi pembunuhan yang dilakukan oleh Zhao Wugou, Cui Hong, serta seorang sosok misterius dengan tato bunga pemakan manusia di tangannya. Setelah diselamatkan oleh Xie Yungui, ia mengubah namanya menjadi Gu Hanyi. Ia mempelajari ilmu pengobatan dan strategi, lalu menghimpun kekuatan para perempuan untuk menjalankan aksi balas dendamnya selangkah demi selangkah.

items.title: Hell Barrister
items.synopsis: A lawyer named Yau Yam-yam finds herself in the underworld, where she is authorized by the King of Hell to become the "Underworld Advocate," traversing both realms to defend ghosts in court while simultaneously investigating her own murder.

items.title: Hell Home
items.synopsis: A forbidden relationship shakes a powerful church family when it exposes infidelity and a mysterious murder, prompting a lawyer to uncover secrets buried between two families.

items.title: Hell University
items.synopsis: After discovering Hell University, a group of friends is forced into a lawless school where murder is allowed every night. As fear threatens to break them apart, Zein fights to keep her friends alive while uncovering a system designed to make no one leave.

items.title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
items.synopsis: From the fan-favorite series Homestead Rescue comes an all-new, high stakes intervention format with the Raney family. Wilderness living experts Marty and Matt, along with Misty Bilodeau, heed desperate pleas from concerned family, friends, or neighbors of homesteaders living beyond the edge of survival. Ambushed by an intervention, the stubborn off-gridders must decide whether to accept the rescue or stay on their dangerous path. For the first time, saving homesteads means confronting the people themselves.

items.title: How Dare You!?
items.synopsis: Wang Cuihua terlempar ke dalam dunia novel dan bertemu Zhang San, sesama penjelajah waktu. Bersama, mereka mengubah alur nasib dengan memperkuat negeri, menyingkirkan musuh, dan menata masa depan. Namun ketika penyakit mematikan mengancam nyawa Zhang San dan ramalan menyebut hanya satu yang bisa hidup, Wang Cuihua memilih menantang takdir demi menyelamatkannya. Di tengah intrik, racun, dan pengkhianatan, mereka berjuang untuk bertahan—dan mempertahankan dunia yang telah mereka bangun bersama.

items.title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
items.synopsis: Michael McWhorter, aka Tizzy Ent, searches for people who think they can do horrible things in public and get away with it.

items.title: How to Train Your Killer
items.synopsis: Pada malam pernikahannya, Putri Mahkota Gu Qingyao tiba-tiba menghadapi upaya pembunuhan terhadap suaminya oleh seorang pembunuh bernama Shi Yi. Tetapi keduanya mengalami pertukaran jiwa. Demi melindungi sang Putra Mahkota, Gu Qingyao harus beradu dengan Shi Yi, sehingga sebuah permainan pembunuhan pun dimulai. Di baliknya, terungkap konspirasi besar yang melibatkan dunia persilatan dan intrik kekuasaan istana yang menegangkan.

items.title: Human Vapor
items.synopsis: Kematian saat siaran langsung di TV. Pelaku yang berubah jadi gas. Di baliknya, proyek rahasia yang mengeksploitasi kaum rentan. Seorang detektif memburu kebenaran kelam.

items.title: I Will Find You
items.synopsis: Salah divonis membunuh putranya sendiri, seorang ayah memulai misi penyelamatan nekat setelah tahu bahwa putranya itu mungkin masih hidup.

items.title: I'm Not Afraid
items.synopsis: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

items.title: If It's Tuesday, It's Murder
items.synopsis: A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

items.title: If Only You Weren't the One
items.synopsis: After a painful breakup at thirty, a woman’s life is thrown into turmoil when she reunites with a former illicit lover at her workplace, reigniting unresolved desire and drawing her back into a secret relationship where love and temptation blur.

items.title: If Wishes Could Kill
items.synopsis: Aplikasi misterius berjanji mengabulkan permintaan, lalu memicu hitung mundur ke kematian. Sekelompok remaja yang terjerat harus memutus rantai maut itu agar tetap hidup.

items.title: Imperfect Women
items.synopsis: Setelah sebuah pembunuhan menghancurkan kehidupan tiga sahabat, ikatan persahabatan yang terjalin selama puluhan tahun diuji saat sebuah penyelidikan mengungkap kebenaran yang mengejutkan.

items.title: In My Prime
items.synopsis: In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

items.title: In the City
items.synopsis: Teaming up with a fresh crew of co-stars, Summer House's Amanda Batula, Kyle Cooke, and Lindsay Hubbard are set to bring the drama back to New York City as they navigate the biggest transitions of their lives at the time: marriage, separation, parenthood, reinvention, and the reality of growing up without growing apart.

items.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
items.synopsis: Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley. They self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way, and help save lives when disaster strikes.

items.title: In Your Radiant Season
items.synopsis: Chan lives every day like it is summer vacation. Haran is trapped in a lonely winter. When their forgotten past reunites them, Chan is determined to gift her another spring. Through laughter and tears, they face winter together and reach their spring in this heartwarming romance.

items.title: Incomplete Summer
items.synopsis: Eight unique individuals all come together under the same roof with one shared dream: to master the art of acting. Over the course of an intense training camp, these aspiring actors must navigate four rigorous rounds of professional assessments, aiming to transform from novices into seasoned performers.

items.title: Inseparable
items.synopsis: Rain-soaked night murder attempt unravels when father-daughter detectives Lao He and He Ying, grappling with impending retirement and fractured familial bonds, confront a case entangled with their past as suspects lead to the shadowy secrets of the Han Dong couple they once knew.

items.title: Inside the Circle
items.synopsis: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

items.title: Iroha no Koi wa Jidai o Kakeru
Irreplaceable
items.synopsis: Xu Chi adalah seorang gadis dari kota kecil yang memasuki dunia konsultasi setelah mengalami perubahan besar dalam keluarganya, dengan prinsip untuk tidak membiarkan dirinya tergantikan. Ia bertemu Ye Xinzhi, seorang mitra berbakat yang pernah dijebak dan diam-diam merencanakan balas dendam. Hubungan mereka yang bermula sebagai mentor dan murid perlahan berkembang menjadi kemitraan, hingga keduanya menjadi sosok yang tak tergantikan satu sama lain.

items.title: Isakapatnam
items.synopsis: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

items.title: It's Not Like That
items.synopsis: Freshly divorced Lori and recently widowed minister Malcolm, friends with teens, navigate singlehood while questioning if their longstanding bond hints at a romantic future.

items.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
items.synopsis: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.

items.title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
items.synopsis: The guest is king — but so is the host! Yu Jae-seok opens his first B&B, where he runs things his way and treats guests to his signature games.

items.title: Jagamae Sangeetham
items.synopsis: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

items.title: JAY-Z in 8
items.synopsis: Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

items.title: Just To Meet You
items.synopsis: A thrice-widowed woman marries Ye Lang, the illegitimate son of a powerful tycoon, believing she’s found a sincere younger lover—only to be drawn into a hidden scheme. Reborn after dying on his wedding day in a past life, Ye Lang returns seeking revenge, but finds himself entangled in her charm once again. As love and suspicion collide, deeper secrets surface, revealing that someone else may be manipulating everything from behind the scenes.

items.title: Key to the Phoenix Heart
items.synopsis: The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.

items.title: KiDnap GAME
items.synopsis: Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.

items.title: Kill Jackie
items.synopsis: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

items.title: King of Comedy
items.synopsis: A spirited young villager and her reluctant ally race against a seven-day demolition deadline, battling viral mishaps, copyright disputes, and a rival village’s sabotage to save their coastal hometown—and find love along the way.

items.title: Kumusta
items.synopsis: A group of Filipino and Korean stars comes together to operate a Filipino pop-up restaurant in Seoul.

items.title: Kylie
items.synopsis: A look at the life of Australian pop star Kylie Minogue, who opens her personal archives and reflects on a career in which she has sold 80 million records and reinvented herself, and by extension pop, several times. Home movies, personal photographs and new interviews reveal the picture, as Kylie addresses how she’s faced public scrutiny, personal loss and illness.

items.title: Labyrinth of Hortensia and the Minotaur
items.synopsis: When 200-year-old human remains discovered in the Himalayas are identified as a perfect DNA match to a missing woman, a complex mystery involving suspicious deaths, lost memories, and hidden truths begins to unfold.

items.title: Lanterns
items.synopsis: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

items.title: Last Seen
items.synopsis: Saat petugas operator darurat Ian Ridley menerima panggilan panik dari anak remaja yang dia yakini sebagai putrinya yang lama hilang, dia melakukan segala cara demi menemukannya.

items.title: Lego One Piece
items.synopsis: Kru Topi Jerami mengarungi lautan di tayangan spesial LEGO dua bagian! Ikuti petualangan epik Luffy, Nami, Usopp, dan kru yang dikemas ulang sepenuhnya balok demi balok.

items.title: Let's End Our Friendship Now
items.synopsis: At 27, Himari Shibasaki and Kazumi Hojo have been inseparable since college, but a drunken confession about Himari’s romantic insecurities completely transforms the boundaries of their friendship. What begins as a physical arrangement born from mutual loneliness quickly evolves into more, as neither of them is sure if their romantic feelings are reciprocated. Kazumi, haunted by a traumatic childhood, has secretly loved Himari, who he believes saved him from his own hollowness. Meanwhile, Himari struggles to drop the "perfect girl" persona she uses to mask her own past grief. As they navigate the transition from friends-with-benefits to a committed couple, their fragile peace is threatened by a jealous coworker and a dangerous stalker from Himari’s past, leading to a potentially dangerous situation.

items.title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: an Almost History of America
items.synopsis: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

items.title: Ligas
items.synopsis: Brilliant but controversial, lawyer Lorenzo Ligas fights for Milan's desperate cases alongside idealistic intern Marta, seeking justice and confronting his own shortcomings.

items.title: Light the Dark
items.synopsis: In the coastal town of Fogang, a family's life within the state oil corporation collapses after a gas explosion in 1997, leading the son Chen Shan to unearth factional conspiracies behind the tragedy through a new blast in 2001.

items.title: Light to the Night
items.synopsis: Sebuah kasus orang hilang di dalam lift menyeret dua polisi kriminal, He Yuanhang dan Ran Fangxu, ke dalam kabut misteri pada tahun 1997. Setelah melalui berbagai rintangan, keduanya sempat terjebak dalam kebingungan dan keraguan, hingga akhirnya berhasil mengungkap kebenaran. Seiring waktu berlalu, mereka menyembuhkan ketidakpastian hidup mereka, teguh menjaga keadilan, dan menghadapi kesulitan dengan sikap optimis serta ketangguhan.

items.title: Line of Fire
items.synopsis: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

items.title: Lion
items.synopsis: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

items.title: Live Forever
items.synopsis: Ning Changyue and Song Yiqiu share a deep, timeless connection that spans three thousand years. In the present day, their journey to understand love, belonging, and eternity is complicated by the resurfacing of a long-buried past and unresolved fates. Facing the echoes of history and the trials of the modern world, they must make pivotal choices that define their love and ultimate home.

items.title: Live Up to Your Youth
items.synopsis:
Pada era 90-an di Beijing, sebuah penginapan kecil menjadi titik pertemuan para perantau muda yang mengejar impian di tengah kerasnya kehidupan. Xu Shengli tetap berjuang sebagai penulis skenario meski terus ditolak, Zhuang Zhuang bertahan sebagai penyanyi di panggung kecil, dan Shen Ranran menghadapi pilihan sulit di dunia hiburan yang gemerlap.

Sementara itu, Tao Liangliang mengejar mimpi musiknya di bawah jembatan penyeberangan, Guo Zongbao bekerja tanpa lelah demi keluarganya, dan Cao Ye mempertahankan idealismenya sebagai pelukis meski tak dipahami. Seiring perubahan zaman, mereka diuji oleh realitas—sebagian bertahan, sebagian menyerah—namun semangat seni dalam diri mereka tetap menyala.

items.title: Love Against Time
items.synopsis: A group of young people who survived life-threatening health struggles moves into a house together to find true love. Having faced life's fragility firsthand, they look past the superficial to build deep, intense, and meaningful connections—without wasting a single second.

items.title: Love Between Lines
items.synopsis: Dalam cerita, Xiao Zhiyu dan Hu Xiu bertemu karena sebuah permainan skrip bertema Republik Tiongkok. Di dalam dunia skrip yang dipenuhi salju yang beterbangan dan bayang-bayang mata-mata yang saling bersilangan, keduanya memicu percikan takdir. Namun, pertemuan tak terduga di dunia nyata justru membuka teka-teki tentang identitas masing-masing. Keduanya lalu bergerak bolak-balik antara dunia nyata dan dunia skrip dalam ruang waktu yang saling bertumpuk, dan pada akhirnya, melalui ikatan yang melintasi dimensi, mereka mencapai pertumbuhan bersama serta menyelesaikan transformasi lanjutan dalam memahami cinta dan diri mereka sendiri.

items.title: Love Beyond the Grave
items.synopsis: He Simu sang Ratu Iblis yang kuat, tak terduga bertemu Duan Xu, seorang jenderal muda. Namun, apakah dia benar-benar Duan Xu? Saat keduanya saling menguji, rahasia kelam masa lalu terungkap. Apakah manusia dengan hidup terbatas dan iblis yang hidup ratusan tahun bisa bersatu melawan waktu?

items.title: Love for You
items.synopsis: In the 1990s, teenagers Chen Yi and Miao Jing met due to their parents, initially getting off to a rocky start. However, Miao Jing's kindness eventually softens Chen Yi's attitude towards her. Chen Yi and Miao Jing's relationship deepens after Chen Yi's father dies and Miao Jing's mother disappears, leaving the two to rely only on each other. Miao Jing eventually confesses her feelings for Chen Yi, but he pushes her away after he gets tangled up as a crime witness, urging her to leave their city. Years later, Chen Yi runs a billiards hall in their hometown, while Miao Jing returns for a work assignment. But when Chen Yi suspects that Miao Jing's boss is involved in smuggling, he vows to protect her – and stay by her side.

items.title: Love Has Fireworks
items.synopsis: Qian Fei, baru saja ditinggalkan tunangannya, Ia sedang mencari arah baru dalam hidupnya. Sementara Li Yifei yang berasal dari keluarga kaya selalu mengutamakan karirnya. Untuk membayar tunggakannya, Fei menyewakan ruangan di rumahnya ke Yifei. Dari tinggal serumah, mereka menemui banyak benturan, namun tanpa disadari ada rasa yang berbeda di antara mereka.

items.title: Love in Disguise
items.synopsis: Pewaris Grup Taekang, Yoon Yi-jun, adalah tersangka utama pembunuhan mengejutkan. Untuk mengungkap kebenaran, Kang Jae-hee menyamar sebagai sekretaris prianya untuk mengawasi Yi-jun. Makin mendekati fakta kejadiannya, makin dekat Yi-jun dan Jae-hee. Akankah Jae-hee, yang menyembunyikan identitasnya, dan Yi-jun, yang punya rahasia, bisa membiarkan perasaan mereka diketahui satu sama lain?

items.title: Love in Sync
items.synopsis: A former top actress who has lost her ability to feel and a psychological counselor who feels too much are brought together through a mysterious ability to share emotions. As she begins to rediscover emotions through him, and he learns to manage the overwhelming weight of empathy through her, the two gradually heal each other in unexpected ways.

items.title: Love in the Moonlight: Redrawn
items.synopsis: Celebrating the 10th anniversary of Love in the Moonlight, the cast reunites for a special variety show filled with laughter, memories, behind-the-scenes stories, and heartfelt moments. A nostalgic reunion brings the beloved stars back together to revisit the drama that captured hearts a decade ago.

items.title: Love on the Menu
items.synopsis: A cheerful side dish shop owner and a chef hiding a secret cross paths at a local market, but their path to romance won't be easy.

items.title: Love Phobia
items.synopsis: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.

items.title: Love Story
items.synopsis: An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.

items.title: Love U Lots
items.synopsis: Heartbroken Estong meets the mysterious Ysa, who has Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), and learns that love comes with not one twist, but lots of it.

items.title: Love's Shattered Reflections
items.synopsis: Forced to take on the role of a villain, a once-good man watches his loved ones betray him and his promising future collapse into a living nightmare. Driven by injustice, he sets out to confront those responsible and reclaim what was taken—no matter the cost.

items.title: Loved One
items.synopsis: "Goodbye" is something that could happen to anyone tomorrow. And the feelings that remain afterwards. Through the serious subject of "forensic medicine," it carefully captures the feelings of love for others and the time they lived, quietly shedding light on the darkness of a "society where the cause of death is unknown".

items.title: Loving Strangers
items.synopsis: Jiang Jiaqi, nearing forty, struggles with a failing marriage and workplace oppression. His life becomes more complicated when he is implicated in a bribery case with his subordinate, Liang Zhi'an, a twenty-year-old woman burdened by her parents' death and caring for her paralyzed grandmother. Despite their different lives, Liang’s presence reignites Jiang's spirit, and as they connect with supportive figures around them, they find warmth, encouragement, and healing in each other amidst their struggles.

items.title: Lucky
items.synopsis: Ketika perampokan bernilai jutaan dolar menjadi kacau, penipu ulung bernama Lucky terpaksa melarikan diri. Dikejar FBI sekaligus bos kriminal yang kejam, Lucky harus berjuang demi nyawanya dan mencari jalan keluar.

items.title: Lukkhe
items.synopsis: A young sportsman infiltrates the wild and dangerous world of Punjab's rap music to investigate a drug syndicate, only to find himself torn between love, family, guilt and brotherhood.

items.title: Mad Concrete Dreams
items.synopsis: A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

items.title: MAFS: After the Dinner Party
items.synopsis:
Get ready, Australia! The nation's biggest obsession just got a whole lot juicier. The Married At First Sight universe is expanding like never before with the launch of MAFS: After The Dinner Party, your first and only place to dive into exclusive, unfiltered interviews with the participants right after the show's iconic dinner parties. Plus, fans will have the chance to see unseen footage that picks up right where the main show leaves off, offering even more drama and insight.

With Jules Lund, Brittany Hockley, and Laura Byrne steering the conversation, the debrief starts the second the dinner party ends. MAFS: After The Dinner Party is the ultimate companion series, offering an unapologetic look at the season's biggest scandals. Whether it’s the 'red flags' or catching a first glimpse of the wreckage, this is the essential, no-holds-barred breakdown where the tea is spilt, and the real truth is revealed.

items.title: Make Me Tingle
items.synopsis: Dua orang yang sangat bertolak belakang bertemu, memicu hubungan tak terduga yang menggoyahkan pandangan mereka tentang cinta, gairah, dan kehidupan.

items.title: Mama Go!
items.synopsis: Kong Xiaocan rela mempertaruhkan hidupnya demi menyelamatkan sang ibu, Kong Guifang, yang sakit parah. Secara ajaib, Guifang kembali muda dengan wajah seperti usia 20 tahun dan mendapat kesempatan menjalani hidup baru. Namun waktu Xiaocan mungkin tak panjang. Di tengah kebahagiaan ini, mampukah mereka mewujudkan mimpi sebelum segalanya terlambat?

items.title: Man of Virtue
items.synopsis: When Luang Pho and the gang become suspects in a diamond robbery case, an action-filled mission to restore their honour begins.

items.title: Man on Fire
items.synopsis: Dihantui masa lalu dan diburu oleh musuh-musuhnya, seorang veteran Pasukan Khusus berjuang untuk menyelamatkan seorang gadis remaja di jalanan Rio de Janeiro yang kejam.

items.title: Marble Hall Murders
items.synopsis: Returning to England, Susan Ryeland is reluctantly drawn into a new Atticus Pünd mystery, this time written by a new, young writer. 'Pünd’s Last Case" is a story set in 1955, in an exotic villa in Corfu – but the identity of a real killer is hidden in the text, and once again Susan is going to find herself in grave danger.

items.title: Margo's Got Money Troubles
items.synopsis: Calon penulis Margo Millet hamil, terpaksa putus kuliah, dan menghadapi kekacauan finansial. Namun, saat ayahnya yang mantan pegulat profesional muncul, Margo dapat cara tak terduga untuk mengomersialkan bakat berceritanya.

items.title: Marshals
items.synopsis: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.

items.title: Mating Season
items.synopsis: Dari pikiran-pikiran gila di balik "Big Mouth" hadir serial komedi animasi dewasa yang liar tentang cinta, seks, dan hubungan yang berlatar dunia hewan.

items.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
items.synopsis: Seorang ibu yang baru bercerai terjerumus ke dalam lingkaran berbahaya akan pemerasan, pembunuhan, dan sepak bola remaja.

items.title: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past
items.synopsis: When human remains from an old case are unearthed, a forensic pathologist mysteriously makes contact with his father thirty years in the past. Their connection draws them into a series of murders, forcing them to work across time to uncover a buried truth.

items.title: Memory of a Killer
items.synopsis: Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.

items.title: Merry Berry Love
items.synopsis: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

items.title: Millennium Love
items.synopsis: After a forbidden act to save the fairy Yuyao, heavenly official Lu Siyuan is condemned to repeated reincarnations, binding their fates across lifetimes. Drawn back together again and again, they face a vengeful force in Xuan Qing and the consequences of defying heaven while protecting a powerful relic tied to their past.

items.title: Million-Follower Detective
items.synopsis: In this crime thriller, Detective Chen Chia-jen races to unmask Baba the Witch, the viral tarot reader who accurately predicts the deaths of influencers.

items.title: Minerva Academy
items.synopsis: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

items.title: Minimum Security
items.synopsis: Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.

items.title: Mission: Mompossible
items.synopsis: Two women from seemingly-opposite backgrounds both navigate the difficulties of mothering adult children.

items.title: Modern Marvels: WWII
