items.synopsis: Explore the greatest machines, most impactful weapons, and groundbreaking innovations of WWII, shining a light on the engineering and technological advances that shaped the course of the conflict and continue to influence our world today.

items.title: Mom Know Best: Sua Mae Te Conhece
Money, My Love
items.synopsis: A disillusioned billionaire heir Trai abandons his fortune and hides among ordinary people, where he falls for Phakbung, a day laborer who believes money is everything. As love deepens, Trai must confront his fear that wealth will once again come before true love.

items.title: Monsters of God
items.synopsis: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love — reptiles — into the dark underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this billion-dollar global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails.

items.title: Morfeusz
items.synopsis: The story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through a tragic twist of fate, becomes the head of a criminal gang.

items.title: Mourinho
items.synopsis: Dokumenter yang menjabarkan prestasi dan info orang dalam ini mengupas perjalanan José Mourinho sebagai salah satu manajer sepak bola top dunia di klub-klub paling elite.

items.title: Mousetrap
items.synopsis: Seorang penulis yang tertutup terbangun untuk menemukan identitasnya dicuri - dan harus bersekutu dengan rentenir yang kejam untuk merebut kembali hidupnya dari seorang pria yang dikenal sebagai "Tikus."

items.title: Mr. Kill
items.synopsis: When a comic becomes the inspiration for a killer, the author is forced to work with a detective to try and uncover the truth.

items.title: Muifei the Medium
items.synopsis: A young woman destined to suffer as a tribal spirit medium is rescued by a city outsider who falls in love with her. But after tragedy strikes, she returns as a vengeful spirit seeking justice against those who abused her.

items.title: Museum of Innocence
items.synopsis: Istanbul, 1970-an. Cinta terlarang seorang pria kepada gadis penjaga toko berubah menjadi obsesi dan kerinduan seumur hidup. Berdasarkan novel ikonik karya Orhan Pamuk.

items.title: My Bias, My Boss
items.synopsis: Pegawai baru bekerja di agensi idola favoritnya, ia berubah dari penggemar menjadi pegawainya yang paling dipercaya.

items.title: My Brilliant Career
items.synopsis: Gelisah, cerdas, dan keras kepala, Sybylla bertekad menentukan jalan hidupnya sendiri di zaman yang mengharapkannya untuk menikah dan berumah tangga.

items.title: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss
items.synopsis: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she’s about to enter.

items.title: My Loong
items.synopsis: After accidentally freeing a Dragon Lord from the Dragon Abyss, a sacrificed general's daughter allies with him to fight political conspiracies.

items.title: My Name is Gutierrez
items.synopsis: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

items.title: My Page in the 90s
items.synopsis: Saat seorang podcaster cinta dari tahun 2025 terjebak dalam novel romansa klasik dan bertemu dengan bos dingin manipulatif dari tahun 1999. Demi kembali ke dunia nyata, Lin Huan’er menjalankan misi menaklukkan sang bos, Gao Haiming. Tapi makin ia mencoba, makin ia terseret ke dalam dunia fiksi itu—dan makin sulit baginya untuk pergi. Ketika waktunya harus kembali tiba, apakah ia rela meninggalkan cinta yang tak terduga ini?

items.title: My Royal Nemesis
items.synopsis: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

items.title: My Sad Dead
items.synopsis: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

items.title: My Tutor, My Love
items.synopsis: When fame becomes a burden and criticism leaves wounds, crossing paths with this tutoring guy… will it be a lesson, or a test of the heart?

items.title: My Wife's Gunslinger God
items.synopsis: A school teacher with dreams of becoming a professional gamer is forced to marry her childhood first love, whose hatred of video games puts their relationship to the test.

items.title: My Years as the Dragon-Seeking Master
items.synopsis: A descendant of a legendary tomb-raiding family infiltrates four powerful clans before returning to a mysterious tomb from 20 years earlier, where deadly traps and supernatural horrors reveal a long-hidden truth.

items.title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
items.synopsis: For the first time ever, 12 Naked and Afraid All-Stars are going overboard. They've been told it's a Lost Coast challenge in the South Pacific, but they're about to be shipwrecked in the dark of night instead. The All-Stars will have to survive for 35 days -- and then rescue themselves to go home.

items.title: NCIS: New York
items.synopsis: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

items.title: Neagley
items.synopsis: Dari dunia REACHER, babak baru dimulai. Frances Neagley, seorang detektif swasta di Chicago dan mantan rekan Jack Reacher di Unit Investigasi Khusus 110 Angkatan Darat AS, bertekad mengungkap kebenaran setelah seorang teman lamanya tewas dalam kecelakaan yang mencurigakan.

items.title: Neighbors
items.synopsis: Examines stories of absurd, outrageous, and dramatic real-life residential conflicts from a wide range of larger-than-life characters across the United States, opening a verité portal into the lives of contemporary American.

items.title: Never-Ending Summer
items.synopsis: To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

items.title: No Pain No Gain
items.synopsis: Saat dipecat dari perusahaan besar, Pei Qian justru mendapat tawaran aneh dari sosok misterius untuk mendirikan perusahaan yang harus merugi. Ia merekrut tim serba tak meyakinkan, menaikkan gaji, memberi cuti, dan berinvestasi di proyek-proyek nyeleneh. Namun semua rencananya selalu berbalik untung. Dianggap bos idaman dan jenius bisnis, Pei Qian cemas bagaimana jika gagal merugi?

items.title: No Tail to Tell
items.synopsis: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a soccer player — altering both of their fates.

items.title: No. 9 Hunter
items.synopsis: Kemunculan “Jejak Langit” membawa bencana siluman ke dunia manusia. Shangguan Ziyan, siluman kecil yang menderita penyakit misterius, dan pendeta Tao Yuan Chu yang dikutuk sehingga orang yang dicintainya akan mati, bekerja sama sebagai Pemburu Siluman No. 9 untuk menghadapi berbagai ancaman dan menutup “Jejak Langit”.

items.title: Norway: The Dark Horse
items.synopsis: Setelah 26 tahun tak ikut turnamen, harapan Norwegia di Piala Dunia 2026 hampir nol. Namun, kini keyakinan mereka bangkit, sebagaimana diceritakan dalam dokumenter ini.

items.title: Not Suitable for Work
items.synopsis: Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.synopsis: Dosen literatur menemukan bakat seorang murid dan menawarkan pelajaran menulis kepadanya—tetapi saat ia menyelami cerita si murid, sesi belajar mereka menjadi kacau.

items.title: Oasis
items.synopsis: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

items.title: Off Campus
items.synopsis: Hannah Wells membantu kapten hoki Garrett Graham mendekati pujaan. Hubungan mereka berubah. Logan, Dean, Tucker, dan Allie menjalani kampus dan cinta.

items.title: Oh! My Guard
items.synopsis: A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

items.title: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
items.synopsis: A decade after O.J. Simpson was controversially acquitted of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman, he attempted to rebrand himself as a reality TV star with the hidden camera prank PPV special Juiced.

items.title: Ok! Let's Get Divorced
items.synopsis: After seven years of marriage, a couple decides to call it quits—but their “perfect breakup” quickly turns into a messy battle of pride, jealousy, and unresolved feelings. As unexpected twists pull them back together, they must confront the love they thought was long gone. Can they truly walk away from each other?

items.title: Old Street Justice
items.synopsis: Pada tahun 1995, Zhao Fengsheng yang pulang ke kampung halamannya justru dikucilkan oleh warga Jalan Lama akibat sebuah kesalahpahaman. Demi membersihkan namanya, Zhao Fengsheng bersama kelompok yang dikenal sebagai "4 Biang Kerok Jalan Lama" membongkar konspirasi kejahatan dan kekuatan hitam, meredakan dendam serta konflik lama, hingga akhirnya berhasil mempertahankan kedamaian tanah kelahiran mereka.

items.title: ON THE MAP : NCT WISH
items.synopsis:
One map brought to life by excitement, adventure, and 'challenges' !

Travel the world by following the 'Challenge Map', take on hidden missions across the globe, and prove each group's strengths and unique charm.

items.title: Once We Were
items.synopsis: Orphan Xiong Yuanbao and his neighbor Mu Qingyun grow up side by side, supporting each other through life’s hardships as their deep bond and shared dreams are tested in a changing era.

items.title: Oops! I'm the Concubine
items.synopsis: Free-spirited commoner Lina unexpectedly becomes a candidate to wed the cold and duty-bound Prince Kiran, but as she navigates palace rivalries and political intrigue, she discovers she may be the key to exposing a rebellion—and the consort destined for him all along.

items.title: Operation Deception
items.synopsis: Follows a controversial undercover operation that sent Alain Olivier, a drug-addicted Quebec forestry student, to death row in Thailand in 1989.

items.title: Our Dazzling Days
items.synopsis: Pada tahun 1990-an, Xiaoman, Xia Lei, dan Yan Xiaodan tumbuh bersama sebagai “anak-anak pabrik” di kawasan perumahan sebuah pabrik militer di Timur Laut. Ketika perubahan ekonomi membuat pabrik merosot dan hidup mereka terpecah ke berbagai arah, ketiganya harus meninggalkan kampung halaman untuk bertahan hidup—hingga akhirnya kembali untuk membangun kembali tempat yang membesarkan mereka dan menemukan kembali arti mimpi, persahabatan, dan cinta.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.synopsis: Seorang jaksa yang ambisius kehilangan ingatan dan tinggal bersama pelatih tinju yang mengaku sebagai pacarnya. Mampukah situasi rumit ini berubah menjadi cinta sejati?

items.title: Our Universe
items.synopsis: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.

items.title: Outlast: The Jungle
items.synopsis: Di pulau tropis terpencil, 16 pemain harus bertahan hidup menghadapi kondisi alam ekstrem, mengakali pesaing, dan menjadi bagian tim untuk memenangkan satu juta dolar AS.

items.title: Overdo
items.synopsis: Di tengah kekacauan era Republik, cinta terlarang tumbuh antara Murong Qingyi—anak jenderal yang tertukar—dan Ren Susu, penyelamatnya di masa lalu. Namun, pengorbanan, kematian palsu, dan status sebagai calon kakak ipar harus memisahkan mereka. Saat cinta kembali tumbuh... akankah mereka bisa bersama?

items.title: Overseas Security Guard
items.synopsis: After losing his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack, an elite bodyguard goes into hiding and forms a private security team overseas to protect Chinese citizens living abroad.

items.title: Pearl in Red
items.synopsis: A woman wrongfully believed to be dead returns with her child, while another woman assumes her twin sister’s identity to seek revenge. Years later, a woman who looks identical to a murdered daughter appears and abandons her own identity to avenge her father. As both women sacrifice their identities for revenge, what fate awaits them?

items.title: Perfect Crown
items.synopsis: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

items.title: Phantom Lawyer
items.synopsis: A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.

items.title: Phony
items.synopsis: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

items.title: Physical 100: Italy
items.synopsis: One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.

items.title: Physical 100: Mexico
items.synopsis: Reality competition show based on the original Korean format.

items.title: Pionek
items.synopsis: A continuation of the *Śleboda* series, centering on anthropologist Anka Serafin and journalist Sebastian Strzygoń. This time, the story takes us to Upper Silesia.

items.title: Plastic Beauty
items.synopsis: Saat ahli bedah IGD berbakat terjun ke dunia kecantikan, perseteruannya dengan dokter selebritas mengungkap keserakahan dan hasrat di balik glamor.

items.title: Ponies
items.synopsis: In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.

items.title: Positively Yours
items.synopsis: A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

items.title: Predestined Love
items.synopsis: After returning home to revive her mother’s failing restaurant, Ren Xizhou reunites with her estranged high school classmate Xiang Nanfeng. As they work together to save the restaurant and confront their past misunderstandings, they heal old wounds and find the courage to embrace a new beginning.

items.title: Prelude of the White Snake
items.synopsis: After losing an important memory before ascending to immortality, Bai Suzhen descends to the mortal world with Xiao Qing to find Xu Xian and repay a past kindness. Along the way, they become entangled with demon hunter Xu Xian and Fa Hai, setting the four on a fateful journey.

items.title: President Curtis
items.synopsis: Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

items.title: Private Eyes West Coast
items.synopsis: Now leading different lives from their Toronto crime-fighting days, private investigators Matt Shade and Angie Everett encounter a world of different cases along with a new group of friends while solving cases in Victoria, British Columbia.

items.title: Privileges
items.synopsis: Hoping for a last chance at redemption, a young inmate takes a job inside a luxury Parisian hotel rife with ruthless ambition and betrayal.

items.title: Project Loki
items.synopsis: A troubled new student and an aloof young man make an unlikely investigative pair as they try to uncover the truth behind crimes at their school.

items.title: Pull Strings
items.synopsis: Li Changshou, yang merupakan pasien berat di kehidupan sebelumnya, secara tidak sengaja terlahir kembali ke dunia kuno, menjelma menjadi seorang alkemis kecil yang menghargai kehidupan dan tidak terlibat dalam karma. Untuk menghindari bencana besar yang diramalkan oleh takdir, dia mengikuti jalan "stabil", dengan niat untuk bertahan hidup di surga. Oleh karena itu, dia bertindak dengan hati-hati, tetap tenang seperti anjing tua, dan saat bertindak, dia menciptakan kejutan besar. Dia meyakini bahwa zaman kekerasan telah berlalu. Jika bisa menipu orang, dia tidak akan membunuh, dan jika bisa sendiri, dia tidak akan jatuh cinta. Namun, musuh dan wanita cantik datang bagaikan gelombang, dan tanpa sengaja, dia menjadi tokoh kunci di balik layar, terlibat dalam berbagai pertempuran, mengoperasikan "Klan Naga ke Langit", bahkan bencana besar itu pun semakin dipercepat datangnya...

items.title: Pursuit of Jade
items.synopsis: Dalam badai salju, Fan Changyu, putri tukang jagal, bertemu Xie Zheng, bangsawan yang menyamar demi balas dendam. Mereka menikah demi tujuan masing-masing, namun cinta tumbuh di antara sandiwara itu. Hingga perang memisahkan mereka, Changyu terjun ke medan perang, Xie Zheng kembali sebagai jenderal besi. Saat kebenaran terungkap, mampukah cinta mereka bertahan?

items.title: Quite the Girl
items.synopsis: Lu Mingyu, a seemingly sheltered heiress, hardened by years of humiliation joins forces with Duan Xiuming, who becomes her weapon of revenge as they fight their enemies and pursue freedom.

items.title: Raakh
items.synopsis: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

items.title: Rack 'n' Roll Delivery
items.synopsis: Mantan ahli biliar Cheng Ye menghilang setelah kekasihnya tewas. 10 tahun kemudian, ia hidup sebagai kurir dengan identitas baru, hingga menemukan petunjuk bahwa kematian sang kekasih bukanlah kecelakaan. Demi mengungkap kebenaran, ia kembali ke dunia biliar dan mencari kebenaran atas kematian sang kekasih.

items.title: Radioactive Emergency
items.synopsis: Para fisikawan dan doktor berpacu untuk mengendalikan bencana radiologik masif dan menyelamatkan ribuan nyawa dalam serial drama yang terinspirasi oleh kisah nyata ini.

items.title: Rafa
items.synopsis: RAFA retraces Nadal's remarkable journey with cinematic scope, combining testimonies from those who know him best—on and off the court—with unseen moments that reveal what lies behind the legend.

items.title: Rak Rak: Sense of Love
items.synopsis: A dating reality that captures the process of forming connections through the senses, rather than relying on languages or physical appearances. Set in the culturally rich and unfamiliar landscape of Thailand, the program brings together ten young adults from Korea and Southeast Asia with completely different backgrounds and cultures to find the answer to the question. They reconnect and share forgotten emotions through the five senses — taste, sight, hearing, smell, and touch — which had been dulled by the fast-paced routines of urban life.

items.title: Ravalear: Not for Sale
items.synopsis: In Barcelona’s Raval neighbourhood, the family-run restaurant “Can Mosques” faces eviction after an investment fund buys the building. The family’s fight to survive escalates, pushing them to cross any and all boundaries.

items.title: Ready or Not: Texas
items.synopsis: No plans, just vibes. When two best friends and their crew set off for Texas on an entirely unscripted adventure, there's no telling what's coming next.

items.title: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model
items.synopsis: What started as a glamorous launchpad for aspiring models became a pop-culture juggernaut defined by explosive drama, public meltdowns, and controversies that still fuel viral moments today.

items.title: Rebirth
items.synopsis: Chu Qiao, a slave girl, is rescued by Yan Xun, the heir of Yanbei, forming a strong bond with him. However, as ambitions clash and trust is betrayed, Chu Qiao finds herself entangled in power struggles and a quest for justice. Amid political turmoil and personal sacrifice, she rises as a symbol of hope, fighting to protect her people and homeland.

items.title: Reboot
items.synopsis: A regular pastry chef, framed for his wife's murder, embarks on a suspenseful journey to prove his innocence by manipulating the detective in charge of the case and uncovering the truth.

items.title: Reborn
items.synopsis: An arrogant IT tycoon is reincarnated as a struggling dry cleaner in the past, using his future knowledge to find his killer while rediscovering his humanity.

items.title: Reborn Rookie
items.synopsis: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

items.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
items.synopsis: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

items.title: Remnants of Gold
items.synopsis: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

items.title: Ren Yu
items.synopsis: Kasus hilangnya seorang gadis menyeret tiga perempuan dengan kehidupan yang sangat berbeda ke dalam pilihan-pilihan sulit yang mengubah takdir mereka. Di balik wajah tenang sebuah kota, rahasia kelam tersembunyi di lorong-lorong bawah tanah. Saat satu per satu kebenaran terungkap, mereka harus menghadapi luka masa lalu, menebus diri, dan menemukan secercah harapan.

items.title: Revenge from a Wife
items.synopsis: After her husband is brutally murdered by a powerful consort, a grieving woman disguises herself as a physician and infiltrates the imperial city to build an intelligence network and seek revenge.

items.title: Reverse
items.synopsis: After spending 15 years consumed by revenge, a woman loses all her memories in a sudden accident, and as she searches for her past, she’s drawn toward a dangerous truth she never expected.

items.title: Ride or Die
items.synopsis: Debbie dan Judith yang bersahabat terpaksa melarikan diri setelah Debbie tahu bahwa Judith bukanlah akuntan forensik, melainkan pembunuh bayaran internasional! Dengan sosok misterius yang memburu mereka dan suami Debbie terlibat sesuatu yang sangat korup, mereka harus berpacu melawan waktu dan melakukan perjalanan keliling Eropa untuk mengungkap kebenaran dan bertahan hidup.

items.title: Rising Justice
items.synopsis: A principled lawyer rebuilds her career in her hometown by forming an unconventional team to fight for justice while reconciling with her estranged father.

items.title: River Sunset
items.synopsis: After an Allied plane carrying a top-secret WWII bombing plan is shot down behind enemy lines, a wounded survivor hides on a Japanese-occupied island while military intelligence races to recover the documents before they doom the entire operation.

items.title: RJ Decker
items.synopsis: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

items.title: Road to Success
items.synopsis: When Lin Wanxing returns to her hometown and takes a job at a local high school, she’s unexpectedly tasked with reviving its long-disbanded soccer team. With help from her mysterious tenant, former coach Wang Fa, they work to rebuild the team, guide the students toward their dreams, and face the shadows of their own pasts along the way.

items.title: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
items.synopsis: Serial ini menceritakan kehidupan dan karier bintang sepak bola Brasil, Ronaldinho, dengan menyusuri perjalanan si anak ajaib ini sampai menjadi ikon olahraga dunia.

items.title: Rooster
items.synopsis: On a college campus, an author navigates a complicated relationship with his daughter.

items.title: Route 187
items.synopsis: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

items.title: Royal Betrothal
items.synopsis: Rescued from the brink of death a decade ago, Meng Tinghui has transformed from a nameless survivor into the Daping Dynasty’s first female scholar to enter the prestigious Hanlin Academy. Known for her sharp wit and cunning nature, she has spent years navigating the treacherous waters of the imperial court. While her peers see only a ruthless official, she harbors a secret devotion to the man who saved her – Emperor Ying Gua. Tinghui is intent on helping Ying Gua become the greatest ruler in history, no matter what it takes. But amidst the power struggles and political schemes, Meng Tinghui remains blind to the one truth that could change everything: the Emperor’s heart has belonged to her all along.

items.title: Run Away
items.synopsis: Seorang ayah putus asa mencari putrinya yang kabur, tetapi terjebak dalam kasus pembunuhan—dan menemukan beragam rahasia yang bisa menghancurkan keluarganya selamanya.

items.title: Running Man Thailand
items.synopsis: Alliances are formed and friendships tested as seven top celebrities compete in thrilling missions to win the race.

items.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
items.synopsis: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental SWAT unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities, and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city and saving the program that made him who he is.

items.title: Saint Love Survivors
items.synopsis: A devoted fan quits her stable job to pursue her dreams and finally marries her rockstar crush, Ouji Kazuhiro. But on their wedding day, she learns their marriage comes with one unexpected condition—a sexless arrangement.

items.title: Salcedo, Leather, and Boogaloo
items.synopsis: Martín Salcedo is rarely swept off his feet — until Verónica Pinilla and Quiebra Canto turn up the party, booze and danger.

items.title: Salvador
items.synopsis: During a violent confrontation arranged between radical fans of two football clubs, Salvador Aguirre, an ambulance driver, rescues his injured daughter Milena, a member of the ultra group, which defends racist, violent and homophobic values, totally opposed to those he instilled in her.

items.title: Salvation, Swallowed by the Nest
items.synopsis: A bullied rookie idol crosses paths with a famous actor who approaches her as part of a cruel bet. Attraction mutates into obsession as secrets and showbiz darkness unravel them both.

items.title: Santita
items.synopsis: Left in a wheelchair after a crash, Santita leaves the love of her life at the altar. Twenty years later, he returns with a request that changes everything.

items.title: Scarpetta
items.synopsis: Dokter Kay Scarpetta, ahli patologi forensik ternama, kembali ke posisi lamanya sebagai Kepala Pemeriksa Medis Virginia, di mana dia menyelidiki pembunuhan mengerikan yang mengingatkan pada kasus pertamanya beberapa dekade sebelumnya. Pada tahun 1998, Scarpetta bekerja bersama Detektif Pete Marino dan Agen FBI Benton Wesley saat mereka menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan dengan pencekikan brutal.

items.title: Scrubs
items.synopsis: J.D. & Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time–medicine has changed, interns have changed, but their bromance has stood the test of time. Characters new and old navigate the waters of Sacred Heart with laughter, heart and some surprises along the way.

items.title: Secret by My Name
items.synopsis: Tan Jianfei, CEO baru Grup Tan, tengah terjebak dalam krisis besar. Di saat yang sama, mantan kekasihnya, Li Shujing, tiba-tiba masuk ke perusahaan dan terlibat persaingan kekuasaan dengannya. Di balik pertentangan mereka, benih cinta lama kembali muncul. Namun Tan Jianfei tidak menyadari bahwa Li Shujing datang dengan tujuan tersembunyi, yaitu menyelidiki kematian ayahnya sebagai bagian dari rencana balas dendam. Ketika kebenaran terungkap, hubungan mereka terjebak dalam konflik keluarga dan sebuah kisah cinta yang ternyata telah dirancang sebagai jebakan.

items.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!
items.synopsis: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.title: See You Later... Maybe
items.synopsis: After being pushed to fake his death by a manipulative manager, fallen writer Fang Haowen teams up with obsessive fan Bie Fan as the "Jiongtu Duo", embarking on a chaotic redemption journey through fame, betrayal, and surreal reality.

items.title: Shadow Punisher
items.synopsis: Lord Qingyang's son, Li Si, devised a plan to infiltrate the Imperial Detective Division to uncover the truth behind the death of the Fourth Prince. There, he met and joined forces with Bai Zhenzhu, the finest female forensic expert in the land; and Meng Rui, a ghost-catcher renowned for his martial prowess but burdened with a deep-seated vendetta. Together, they formed the Divine Detectives. With seamless teamwork and unwavering determination, this trio ventured through perilous challenges, solving eight enigmatic and bizarre cases.

items.title: Shall We Dance
items.synopsis: Putra Mahkota Chu Ying menjalin persahabatan polos dengan kasim muda bernama Xiao Man sejak kecil. Namun setelah naik takhta, Chu Ying harus kehilangan Xiao Man yang diusir dari istana. 10 tahun kemudian, Xiao Man kembali dengan menyamar sebagai pria. Meski terlihat dekat, keduanya saling mencurigai. Di tengah konflic dan perebutan kekuasaan istana, hubungan mereka pun perlahan berubah...

items.title: Sharp Blade in the Snow
items.synopsis: Falsely accused of murdering her father, Princess Feng Li returns from exile as a feared ruler to uncover the truth behind the crime. At a decadent banquet designed to flush out her enemies, she draws close to Yun Zhan, a mysterious slave who is secretly a fallen prince. As their hidden motives collide and political conspiracies close in, Feng Li and Yun Zhan must choose between revenge, power, and the love that threatens to undo them both.

items.title: She's Wild Fire
items.synopsis: Reborn in 1991 Shenzhen, entrepreneur Xie Nanfeng faces family hardships and the uncertainties of a rapidly changing era. Armed with determination and business acumen, she sets out to reshape both her own destiny and the future before her.

items.title: Single's Inferno Reunion
items.synopsis: "Single's Inferno" contestants reunite to reveal honest feelings and relationship updates — revisiting standout moments from their time on the island.

items.title: Sins of Kujo
items.synopsis: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

items.title: Siren's Kiss
items.synopsis: Ace insurance investigator Cha Woo-seok hunts a fraud ring tied to mysterious deaths and becomes dangerously entangled with Han Seol-ah, a flawless art auctioneer whose lovers all seem to die. As attraction and suspicion blur, he must uncover whether she’s a killer or a victim, before the truth costs him his life.

items.title: Six Singles Under One Roof
items.synopsis: An unfiltered observational reality show where same-aged singles with strong, distinct personalities—who have lived alone for a long time—come together to share a house while supporting each other’s fabulous lifestyles.

items.title: Sixth Sense: B-Side
items.synopsis:
Bigger in scale, with twists even more cunning, Sixth Sense returns for a brand-new season!

Is what you saw actually real?

Beyond the frame, it’s time to uncover the hidden truth beneath.

The moment you let your guard down, your entire deduction is flipped upside down!

From unpredictable personalities to spaces beyond imagination, fakes that seem real, and reals that seem fake!

The answer is always hidden on the flip side.

At the end of a deduction filled with twist upon twist, lies a truth you will never find unless you broaden your perspective.

Will the Six-Sensers discover the meticulously hidden B-side and distinguish the 'real' from the 'fake'?

items.title: Slo Pitch
items.synopsis: A determined coach leads their ragtag LGBTQ+ softball team through ups and downs on and off the field as they chase their dreams.

items.title: Slumbering with Wolves
items.synopsis: Criminal psychology expert Gu Yan and his partner Shen Yu work together to solve mysterious cases and uncover the truth while confronting questions of morality, justice, and self-protection.

items.title: Small Prophets
items.synopsis: Sejak pacarnya menghilang tujuh tahun sebelumnya, kehidupan Michael menggantung. Namun, suatu resep mistis di sebuah jurnal lama menjanjikan jawaban yang dia tunggu-tunggu.

items.title: Soda Master
items.synopsis: Three former middle school friends who reunited after 37 years to pursue the mystery behind their former club advisor's disappearance.

items.title: Sold Out on You
items.synopsis: A work-obsessed cosmetics CEO and a top home-shopping host struggling with insomnia cross paths, and through an unexpected romance, begin to heal the emptiness in their lives.

items.title: Somebody Knows Something
items.synopsis: Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.

items.title: Someone Has to Know
items.synopsis: A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

items.title: Someone, Someday
items.synopsis: When the CEO of a dating app unknowingly befriends someone out for revenge, old wounds resurface—threatening her company, family, friendships, love life, and even her dream of finding “someone, someday.”

items.title: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
items.synopsis: Seorang calon mempelai wanita memiliki firasat bahwa sesuatu yang mengerikan akan terjadi pada hari pernikahannya, dan makin dekat harinya, firasat itu makin kuat.

items.title: Sounds of Winter
items.synopsis: After past breakups and unfulfilled romances leave novelist Ayana reluctant to truly fall in love, she tries to face her current relationship sincerely.

items.title: Space Rice Cake Shop
items.synopsis: From rice cakes to cooking! Thanks to Torong's scheme, the Jilak brothers become part-timers at the Space Rice Cake Shop. A full-scale forced employment restaurant labor adventure!

items.title: Spark of the Long March
items.synopsis: Amid route disputes and harsh conditions during the Long March, the Red Army struggles to preserve unity while forging solidarity with ethnic minority communities.

items.title: Spider-Noir
items.synopsis: Detektif swasta Ben Reilly awalnya menerima beberapa kasus sederhana... sampai akhirnya terjebak dalam pusaran para mafia, monster, dan seorang wanita misterius yang membawanya kembali ke masa lalunya sebagai satu-satunya pahlawan super New York: The Spider.

items.title: Spring Fever
items.synopsis: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

items.title: Spring of the Blade
items.synopsis: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

items.title: SQUALL
items.synopsis: After losing four years of her memories, Sakura moves to Singapore with her fiancé, Eita, and begins building a new life while working as a guide at a wildlife park. But when she encounters a mysterious Singaporean man named Lun and feels an inexplicable sense of familiarity, an old key engraved with “203” may hold the answers to the memories she has lost, and the life she no longer remembers.

items.title: Stand Up for Love
items.synopsis: Jiang Lai rela mendonorkan ginjalnya demi cinta, tetapi justru dikhianati oleh kekasihnya. Ia bahkan dijebak agar dianggap mengalami gangguan mental dan nyaris dibunuh. Setelah lolos dari maut, ia mengubah wajah dan menyamar sebagai Zhao Ke. Bersama Zhao Mai, seorang wanita misterius, ia kembali untuk menyusun jebakan demi jebakan dan membalikkan keadaan.

items.title: Star City
items.synopsis: Masuki sebuah babak menegangkan yang terinspirasi oleh For All Mankind. Dunia sejarah alternatif yang sama. Perspektif: Uni Soviet. Jelajahi negeri Tirai Besi dengan para kosmonaut, rekayasawan, dan agen intelijen yang bertaruh segalanya untuk ke Bulan.

items.title: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
items.synopsis: A young group of cadets come together to pursue a common dream of hope and optimism. Under the watchful and demanding eyes of their instructors, they will discover what it takes to become Starfleet officers as they navigate blossoming friendships, explosive rivalries, first loves and a new enemy that threatens both the Academy and the Federation itself.

items.title: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
items.synopsis: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

items.title: Steal
items.synopsis: Hari yang normal di Lochmill Capital berubah ketika para perampok bersenjata menyerbu dan memaksa Zara dan sahabatnya, Luke memenuhi tuntutan mereka. Usai perampokan, detektif Rhys harus segera menemukan para pelaku dan alasan mereka mencuri 4 miliar paun dana pensiun.

items.title: Sterling Point
items.synopsis: Setelah mengetahui dia mewarisi sebuah pulau terpencil di Kanada dari kakeknya yang tak diizinkan menemuinya, Annie Jacobson yang berusia 17 tahun pergi menyelidikinya hingga memasuki dunia penuh rahasia, persaudarian tak terduga, dan sejarah keluarga rumit yang disembunyikan darinya.

items.title: Still Shining
items.synopsis: Jatuh cinta di masa remaja, dua orang yang beranjak dewasa berpisah. Bertemu lagi 10 tahun kemudian, mereka menghadapi patah hati, perubahan, serta tantangan baru mereka.

items.title: Straight to Hell
items.synopsis: Sebagai peramal kondang dari Jepang, Kazuko Hosoki mendominasi TV dan daftar buku laris, tetapi siapa dirinya di balik rumor penipuan spiritual dan kaitan dunia kriminal?

items.title: Street World Fighter: Directors’ War
items.synopsis: Ten talented performance directors battle through high-stakes choreography challenges for the ultimate prize of directing a K-pop music video.

items.title: Strong Will
items.synopsis: A gifted, humbly born musician and a wealthy student fall for each other amid personal rivalries and a life-changing accident.

items.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
items.synopsis: Stuart Bloom diberi tugas memulihkan realitas setelah menyebabkan Kiamat multisemesta.

items.title: Suddenly Amish
items.synopsis: Six non-Amish individuals on a rare journey leave behind their modern "English" lifestyle and step into a deeply traditional Amish community in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

items.title: Sugar and Lies
items.synopsis: Menjelang pertunangannya, Ding Dang kembali bertemu cinta pertamanya yang kini hidup dengan nama dan identitas baru setelah mengalami gangguan kepribadian akibat kegagalan eksperimen. Demi menyembuhkannya, Ding Dang bersama teman-temannya diam-diam menjalankan sebuah rencana untuk membantunya menghadapi luka masa lalu dan keluar dari trauma yang selama ini menghantuinya.

items.title: SUMBAKKOKJIL 2
items.synopsis:
SUMBAKKOKJIL is back for the summer of 2026, with even more sophisticated horror and suspense!

Building on the signature hide-and-seek gameplay from Season 1, the new season weaves in eerie Korean urban legends to create a horror variety experience that goes beyond traditional entertainment.

In this expanded horror universe, the cast must immerse themselves in each ghost tale, survive massive suspense, and find a way to escape.

With massive locations and urban legends brought to life, SUMBAKKOKJIL delivers an immersive horror experience unlike anything before.

items.title: Summer Serendipity
items.synopsis: Su Wan, a university student majoring in animal psychology, follows a trail of clues to rescue a group of trafficked dogs and ends up in grave danger. She is unexpectedly rescued by Ye Tianyu, her long-lost childhood companion, whose sudden reappearance reconnects them after sixteen years apart.

items.title: Sunset in Winter
items.synopsis: Prince Rawi, forced into a loveless marriage, is betrayed by his wife’s affair and her deadly plot against him. After falling into an abyss during the confrontation, he wakes with amnesia in a village, starting a new life as Tawan under Lukjan’s care.

items.title: Sunsets Secrets Regrets
items.synopsis: A mysterious body by the Tong River resurfaces clues to a five-year-old case, bringing together three childhood friends—now a criminal investigator, a detective, and an undercover agent. As they pursue the truth behind multiple unsolved crimes, they navigate hidden dangers and unravel deep conspiracies.

items.title: Surviving Earth
items.synopsis: Meet the bizarre, amazing and breathtaking creatures and landscapes of a vibrant lost world; and discover how life not only survived during the cataclysmic events of this prehistoric era, but thrived.

items.title: Suspicious Neighbor
items.synopsis: A suspenseful urban tale where seemingly ordinary neighbors hide dark secrets, leading to a web of distrust and hidden truths.

items.title: Sword God
items.synopsis: Left crippled and betrayed after his sect is destroyed, a fallen cultivator rebuilds his power and rises to challenge his enemies, his fate, and the heavens themselves.

items.title: Tagusari Bros.
items.synopsis: Two brothers become police officers to hunt down their parents' killer, who escaped justice by just two days before the statute of limitations was abolished.

items.title: Take a Hike!
items.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

items.title: Take Charge of My Heart
items.synopsis: Pria ahli waris perusahaan dengan jantung buatan bertemu wanita bermuatan listrik. Mereka membuat kesepakatan yang membuat jantung si pria berdetak sekaligus deg-degan.

items.title: Tang Dynasty Occult Mysteries
items.synopsis: During the Tang Dynasty, gifted forensic investigator Li Jinglan joins forces with the mysterious “ghost detective” Jueming and skilled constable Su Yu’an to solve a string of shocking cases. As they uncover hidden conspiracies behind each crime, danger, justice, and romance become deeply intertwined.

items.title: Tatsuki: Too Kind for School
items.synopsis: At an unconventional school for kids who avoid traditional classrooms, Tatsuki's carefree approach baffles strict Shizuku as they learn to reach students.

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.synopsis: Saat rasa hormat tidak ada lagi di sekolah, para inspektur tak biasa tiba demi memperbaiki situasi—dengan berbagai pelajaran keras dan lugas yang tak ada dalam buku teks.

items.title: The 300 Loyal Ghosts
items.synopsis: Zhang Yi, pejabat muda Pengadilan Kekaisaran, menyimpan dendam dan menunggu waktu yang tepat dalam diam. Di luar, ia bekerja sama dengan Shen Youzhi, memburu kejahatan, namun diam-diam Zhang Yi adalah dalang di balik layar dari rencana balas dendam besar. Sebuah jebakan yang dirancang dengan cermat tertutup rapat, dimana setiap pilihan bisa menentukan nasib hidup atau mati…

items.title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
items.synopsis: A successful entrepreneur with a seemingly perfect life sees everything fall apart after discovering her husband covering up a murder allegedly committed by their daughter. As the family scrambles to hide the truth, an anonymous blackmailer claims to have recorded everything, pulling them into a dangerous web of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

items.title: The Airport Chaplain
items.synopsis: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

items.title: The Apartment Job
items.synopsis: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

items.title: The Art of Sarah
items.synopsis: Sebuah jasad ditemukan di pusat kota. Sebuah label mewah tengah naik daun. Seorang detektif menguji kisah seorang wanita yang terus berubah. Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi?

items.title: The Audacity
items.synopsis: Inside the bubble of Silicon Valley, a data-mining CEO strives to turn insight and influence into profit and power in this darkly comedic look at the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future.

items.title: The Beauty
items.synopsis: The world of high fashion turns dark when international supermodels begin dying in gruesome and mysterious ways. FBI Agents Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett are sent to Paris to uncover the truth. As they delve deeper into the case, they uncover a sexually transmitted virus that transforms ordinary people into visions of physical perfection, but with terrifying consequences.

items.title: The Blame
items.synopsis: Detectives Tom Radley and Emma Crane fall in love while investigating the small-town murder of a figure skater, until one becomes a suspect.

items.title: The Boroughs
items.synopsis: Di komunitas pensiunan yang tampak sempurna, sekelompok hero tak terduga harus menghentikan ancaman dari dunia lain yang ingin mencuri hal yang tak mereka miliki: waktu.

items.title: The Cop: Spy on Stage
items.synopsis: A young police officer goes undercover with a traveling music truck band to investigate corruption and expose a powerful local figure.

items.title: The Cruel Tribunal
items.synopsis: A modern lawyer transported to an ancient kingdom defends the powerless and reforms its laws before becoming entangled with a prince in a dangerous struggle over the succession.

items.title: The Cult of the Real Housewife
items.synopsis: Ex-members and family speak out about The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City star Mary Cosby and the troubling inner workings of Faith Temple Pentecostal Church.

items.title: The D Dorm
items.synopsis: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

items.title: The Dark Romance
items.synopsis: While investigating her best friend’s suicide, single mother Yan Ling is drawn into a dangerous web of emotional manipulation. As love and betrayal become entangled, she begins to recognize the truth, break free from control, and reclaim her life.

items.title: The Devil Between Us
items.synopsis: In a quiet coastal town, a missing bag of drugs ignites a chain of chaos, pulling together a detective, a desperate father, an ambitious young woman, and two siblings caught in addiction. As their lives collide, a risky rescue mission begins—one that no one will walk away from unchanged.

items.title: The Doomies
items.synopsis: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

items.title: The Dream Maker
items.synopsis: Di awal 1980-an, Pingchuan membangun kota Yuehai demi mengejar kemajuan. Li Qiuping dan Zheng Decheng memimpin ribuan petani membangun kota modern dari lahan kosong tanpa dana negara, lewat gotong royong dan kemitraan. Sebuah keajaiban pembangunan yang mengubah nasib ratusan ribu orang dan menorehkan sejarah di masa reformasi.

items.title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
items.synopsis: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

items.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
items.synopsis: Masuki seluk-beluk program paling dominan dalam sejarah basket kampus saat Geno Auriemma mendorong para pemainnya hingga batas maksimal untuk memenangkan 12 gelar. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, dan lainnya mengungkapkan apa yang dibutuhkan untuk bertahan di UConn dan membangun sebuah dinasti.

items.title: The Early Spring
items.synopsis: Di awal perantauan ke Beijing, Shang Zhitao berpapasan dengan "genius aneh" Luan Nian. Dengan keberanian dan semangatnya, Shang Zhitao perlahan tumbuh dan berubah, hingga mampu meruntuhkan dinding hati Luan Nian yang keras dan penuh perhitungan. Keduanya saling tertarik, terlibat dalam tarik‑ulur cinta di rimba kota, berpisah dan bersatu berulang kali. Cinta adalah mengerahkan seluruh keberanian tanpa menyisakan penyesalan. Kasih adalah saling menyembuhkan dan tumbuh bersama. Namun di antara cinta dan kasih, dia memilih untuk bertahan hidup. Saat dia sudah bisa berdiri sendiri, dia menahan sisi agresifnya, mereka yang sepadan akan menuliskan akhir baru bagi satu sama lain...

items.title: The East Palace
items.synopsis: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

items.title: The Epoch of Miyu
items.synopsis: Pernikahan sempurna Xu Miyu runtuh tepat di ulang tahun ke-10, mendorongnya memilih bercerai dan memulai hidup baru. Bekerja sebagai petugas kebersihan di Purong Hotel, ia bertemu kembali dengan Ji Feng, manajer baru sekaligus kenalan lama. Di tengah tantangan kerja, cinta tumbuh dan bersama mereka mengubah Purong Hotel menjadi ikon kota yang baru.

items.title: The Eternal Fragrance
items.synopsis: Bencana besar tiba, Pohon Primodial muncul, yang mendapatkan Titisan Pohon Primordial bisa mengendalikan segalanya. Suku Dewa, Siluman dan Iblis terjerumus ke dalam perang berdarah. Ratusan tahun kemudian, Lei Xiuyuan sengaja mendekati Bangchui dari Qingqiu (Jiang Lifei) demi menyelamatkan kakaknya. Keduanya kemudian berkultivasi di Akademi Chufeng karena suatu kebetulan. Teman yang sangat melindunginya menjadi teman pertama bagi Bangchui dan menanamkan benih cinta di dalam hatinya. Hubungan Jiang Lifei dengan Lei Xiuyuan pun berkembang dari sahabat menjadi saling mencintai. Pada akhirnya mereka masuk ke perguruan yang sama. Di saat hati keduanya makin mendekat, rahasia identitas juga perlahan-lahan mulai terungkap.

items.title: The Evil Lawyer
items.synopsis: Dijebak atas kejahatan brutal yang tak dilakukannya, seorang pengacara muda memasrahkan nasibnya kepada pembela kejam untuk membersihkan namanya dan menemukan kebenaran.

items.title: The Ferry Man 10th Anniversary
items.synopsis: At Mirage City's 444 Convenience Store, Xia Dongqing and Ya join forces with a cryptic Night Watcher to maintain the balance between realms—until a crimson moon exposes a hidden conspiracy. Though peace returns, new anomalies stir in the shadows.

items.title: The Final Problem
items.synopsis: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

items.title: The First Jasmine
items.synopsis: Putri sulung Keluarga Ye, Ye Li, menikah dengan Pangeran Mo Xiuyao, yang hidup terasing dan lumpuh. Namun di balik wajah tenangnya, Ye Li menyusun rencana balas dendam atas tragedi masa lalu. Saat rahasia mulai terkuak, siapa yang lebih dulu akan berkhianat—atau sebaliknya?

items.title: The Five-Star Weekend
items.synopsis: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.

items.title: The Fixers
items.synopsis: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

items.title: The Forbidden Land
items.synopsis: Zhang Chao, a quiet and withdrawn student, finds himself at odds with a school bully while seeking the truth behind his roommate’s mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he unravels a hidden secret about his past, embarking on a transformative journey of friendship, redemption, and self-discovery.

items.title: The Gift
items.synopsis: Boonsita, who has always seen the future, suddenly gains the ability to glimpse the past when she meets Warat, a man haunted by dreams of a mysterious woman. Together, they uncover long-hidden secrets of love and destiny, confronting truths that have been concealed across time.

items.title: The Grand Tour
items.synopsis: Selamat datang di The Grand Tour. Seri kendaraan bermotor paling hebat di dunia yang kembali dengan pembawa acara baru - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman, dan Francis Bourgeois - serta perpaduan khas petualangan globalnya, kendaraan menakjubkan, aksi epik, dan opini yang kuat.

items.title: The Grand-ish Tour
items.synopsis: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

items.title: The Great Queen
items.synopsis: Xi Yuan, seorang gadis modern yang tak sengaja memasuki Dunia Xuanji dan terseret ke dalam perang saudara di Negeri Huyun. Di tengah berbagai bahaya yang mengancam nyawanya, jati diri Xi Yuan perlahan terungkap, sementara kekuatan Dewa Phoenix yang tersegel di dalam dirinya pun terbangkitkan oleh takdir. Demi melindungi seluruh Dunia Xuanji, Xi Yuan mengesampingkan keselamatannya sendiri, bangkit menantang hukum ilahi tertinggi, dan pada akhirnya berhasil menyelamatkan seluruh makhluk di Dunia Xuanji berkat kecerdasan serta keteguhan hatinya.

items.title: The Guilty
items.synopsis: A kidnapping case uncovers a decade-old murder hidden in an old phonograph recording. As the investigation reveals shocking secrets, three young people, once full of potential, form an unbreakable bond, facing their dark pasts and protecting each other from fate’s grip.

items.title: The Hawk
items.synopsis: Di penghujung kariernya, sang legenda golf Lonnie "The Hawk" Hawkins mengejar satu turnamen mayor terakhir dan menyeret orang-orang terkasihnya ke dalam kekacauan.

items.title: The Heir
items.synopsis: Pada pertengahan Dinasti Ming, sebuah kasus tinta upeti mengguncang industri tinta Huizhou dan menjatuhkan keluarga pembuat tinta Li yang telah berjaya selama berabad-abad, sementara keluarga Luo bangkit hingga mencapai puncak kekuasaan sebelum akhirnya ikut hancur akibat intrik pemerintahan. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Li Zhen, putri bungsu keluarga Li, bertekad menghidupkan kembali usaha pembuatan tinta keluarganya dan perlahan menjadi sosok baru yang diperhitungkan di industri tinta Huizhou. Di saat yang sama, Luo Wenqian, putra kedua keluarga Luo, berusaha memulihkan kejayaan keluarganya dengan mengubah tatanan industri tinta. Bersama, mereka menghadapi persaingan sengit dan tantangan perdagangan luar negeri demi mengembalikan nama besar tinta Huizhou, dalam kisah tentang ambisi, cinta, dan warisan budaya yang bertahan melintasi zaman.

items.title: The Hidden Shadow aka Prakan Saengjan
The Hidden Truth
items.synopsis: Polisi muda Tang Tang menyelidiki kembali kasus 15 tahun lalu saat pelaku utamanya kembali ke Qingcheng. Penyelidikan membuka jaringan kejahatan dari penipuan hingga kasus pembunuhan misterius. Saat kebenaran hampir terungkap, sahabat masa kecil Tang Tang diculik, dan dalang di balik semuanya ternyata adalah seseorang yang tak pernah ia duga...

items.title: The Hillside Strangler
items.synopsis: For the first time in over 40 years, Frank Salerno tells his story of the Hillside Strangler manhunt, revisiting the case that changed him forever. Kenneth Bianchi shares his story on camera for the first time of his role as one of the two people behind the Hillside Strangler.

items.title: The House of the Spirits
items.synopsis: The epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

items.title: The Hunt
items.synopsis: Saat sekelompok sahabat yang sedang berburu terlibat bentrokan mematikan dengan pemburu lain, mereka bersumpah untuk merahasiakannya. Namun ketika paranoia mulai merasuki dan sebuah geng kejam hendak membalas dendam, mereka harus berhadapan dengan moralitas, keluarga, dan insting liar mereka sendiri.

items.title: The Husband
items.synopsis: Taeju and Seyun are on the verge of divorce. But when a drunken comment from Taeju gets Seyun kidnapped, everything changes. Even worse, he's now the prime suspect. Forced to go on the run, Taeju must rescue his wife on his own. To save her, he pushes himself to the absolute limit.

items.title: The Judge Returns
items.synopsis: The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

items.title: The Lament of Autumn
items.synopsis: In the turbulent era of the Republic of China, student Ye Pingjun takes a job at a Western Hunan meeting house to fund her mother’s medical care. However, she's unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of an assassination attempt against the powerful Yu family’s fifth son, Yu Changxuan, and ends up accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Pingjun strikes a bold bargain: if Changxuan cannot identify the true culprit within ten days, he must clear her name. What begins as a high-stakes investigation quickly evolves into a calculated courtship as Changxuan maneuvers to win her heart while hiding a complex web of secrets. Will their blossoming romance survive the encroaching shadows of war, or will the secrets of their past pull them apart?

items.title: The Lead
items.synopsis: Secara tak terduga, Yi Qin’e dibawa pamannya masuk ke dunia opera Qin. Dari seorang gadis penggembala biasa, ia perlahan tumbuh menjadi legenda panggung yang disegani. Di tengah perubahan zaman, jatuh bangun dunia seni, dan pergolakan hidup selama puluhan tahun, Qin’e harus bertahan menghadapi cinta, ambisi, dan kehilangan. Namun saat sorotan panggung mulai meredup, apakah ia masih mampu mempertahankan tempatnya sebagai sang bintang utama?

items.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
items.synopsis: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

items.title: The Legend of Rosy Clouds
items.synopsis: In the legendary Nine Cities, noblewoman Fan Yun and cunning lord Qi Zheng join forces to overcome a looming crisis. As they fight for the people's welfare, their bond deepens into friendship and love to bring peace and prosperity to the realm.

items.title: The Long Snake Takes a Wife
items.synopsis: Ibu Bai Zhongtian tewas secara misterius sejak lama. Warga desa percaya ia “dibawa pergi” oleh siluman ular panjang. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, Bai Zhongtian kembali ke Desa Baiyun dan mendapati desanya diselimuti berbagai legenda aneh: pernikahan siluman ular, ritual guntingan kertas pemanggil arwah, rombongan sandiwara hantu, dan payung kertas merah yang menyeramkan. Saat seorang warga kembali menyaksikan pernikahan siluman ular di hutan, Bai Zhongtian mulai menyelidiki kejadian-kejadian tersebut dan perlahan mengungkap kebenaran di balik semua misteri itu.

items.title: The Long Watch
items.synopsis: A millennium-era leak case shaping cross-strait dynamics hides a covert tug-of-war between foreign forces and Chinese agents. In the late 90s, rookie Chunxiao and star agent Ma Qi foil plots together, but as time passes, the case reshapes all involved amid era-defining shifts.

items.title: The Madison
items.synopsis: The Clyburns uproot their comfortable New York City lives to the wild, untamed beauty of Montana's Madison River Valley on a search for connection.

items.title: The Man Will Burn
items.synopsis: Explores the definitive story of the Burning Man festival, filmed over three years with the co-operation of the Burning Man Project, the non-profit behind it, and featuring archive from the last 30 years.

items.title: The Map of Longing
items.synopsis: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

items.title: The Masked Lover
items.synopsis: A bandit leader's deputy and an opera troupe orphan seeking revenge become unlikely allies when they uncover a plot to trade a family treasure for opium and join forces to seize it.

items.title: The Naive Leader
items.synopsis: Fan Sha'er, putra kaya yang polos dan ceroboh, nyaris tewas setelah dikubur hidup-hidup oleh ayahnya sendiri akibat menyerbu lumbung pangan. Dalam pelarian, ia bertemu Xiugu dan ayahnya, lalu tanpa sengaja terseret ke dunia perampok. Dari buronan menjadi pemimpin, Fan Sha'er membangun persaudaraan, menegakkan keadilan, hingga akhirnya bangkit sebagai komandan yang memimpin perlawanan melawan penjajah Jepang.

items.title: The Old Story of Yu Hong
items.synopsis: A series of bizarre, seemingly unrelated murders in a declining industrial town in 1990s Northeast China reveal the intertwined fates of their victims, ultimately uncovering hope and humanity amid brutal survival.

items.title: The One
items.synopsis: A successful lawyer who has shut herself off from love after enduring betrayal and painful experiences finds her guarded life changed when a young man from her past returns after five years.

items.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.synopsis: Seorang pegawai kantoran biasa memenangkan lotre, tapi kehidupannya yang tenang justru mulai berantakan.

items.title: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
items.synopsis: Merlin, the immortal son of the bard Taliesin and Atlantean Princess Charis, is followed through his tragic upbringing, descent into madness, and shocking disappearance, leading to the legend that surrounds him. Set before King Arthur's birth, Merlin, assumed dead or a myth, reemerges in sub-Roman Britain to unite the fractured kingdoms under threat from Saxon invaders.

items.title: The Practical Guide to Love
items.synopsis: A woman determined to finally open her heart goes on a blind date with two very different men, and through the chaos and charm of it all, she ends up figuring out what love actually means for her.

items.title: The Program: Texas Tech
items.synopsis: The Program: Texas Tech gives unprecedented access into the Texas Tech University Red Raiders College Football Program - including exclusive interviews with head coach Joey McGuire, former quarterback Brendan Sorsby, Chairman of the Texas Tech University System Board of Regents Cody Campbell, and more - through one of the most consequential off-seasons in the history of the sport.

items.title: The Red Cradle
items.synopsis: Drama ini menceritakan peristiwa pada musim gugur dan dingin tahun 1946, ketika situasi perang berubah dan Panti Asuhan Kedua Yan’an diperintahkan membentuk sebuah tim untuk mengawal 136 anak ke daerah yang lebih aman. Perjalanan ini dikenal sebagai “Perjalanan Panjang Anak-Anak”. Para pengasuh dan tentara mempertaruhkan nyawa mereka untuk melindungi anak-anak, melewati hujan peluru dan kondisi alam yang sangat berat, hingga akhirnya berhasil menyelesaikan misi besar demi menyelamatkan masa depan anak-anak tersebut.

items.title: The Revolutionaries
items.synopsis: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

items.title: The Rhythm of Revenge
items.synopsis: Singer Puna dreams of stardom and uncovering the truth behind her parents' deaths, forming an alliance with a police officer as the hunt turns personal.

items.title: The Road to Splendor
items.synopsis: Zhao Ling, datang dari latar belakang yang biasa saja, tapi Ia memiliki ambisi yang besar. Kehidupannya berubah sejak tak sengaja bertemu Fu Tingyun, gadis dari keluarga bangsawan yang difitnah berselingkuh. Mereka terpaksa kabur bersama, tapi ujian dari keluarga dan istana terus menghantui mereka.

items.title: The Season
items.synopsis: A group of friends in Hong Kong's elite boating scene find their summer getaway descending into betrayal and power plays as hidden agendas surface.

items.title: The Secret Friends Club
items.synopsis: “The Secret Friends Club” is a reality variety show where cast members secretly prepare a special gift for someone without revealing their identities.

items.title: The Secrets of Hotel 88
items.synopsis: Two estranged families reunite at the reopening of Hotel 88, until the former best friends behind it are found dead. Forced to share the inheritance, their children uncover buried secrets and the truth behind their fathers' mysterious deaths.

items.title: The Shadow Sovereign
items.synopsis: A low-born scholar rises to power to avenge his father, only to find an unexpected alliance and deep love with the defiant princess he once vowed to destroy.

items.title: The Shards
items.synopsis: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

items.title: The Tender Showdown
items.synopsis: Four years after the Jianzhou Tunnel collapse, contractor allegations of corruption trigger a special investigation led by Geng Qing. When the case implicates his former classmate, Geng and his team face mounting resistance as they work to uncover the corruption network.

items.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
items.synopsis: A very scared man navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes, exploring fears that are both deeply personal and strikingly universal.

items.title: The Testaments
items.synopsis: Growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known. As a new generation of young women grapple with the bleak future that awaits them, they will be forced to search for allies, new and old, to help in their fight for freedom.

items.title: The Torment
items.synopsis: Kama returns to her hometown and gets entangled in an old missing case. Family secrets, passions and crime reveal that the past never falls silent.

items.title: The Trap
items.synopsis: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

items.title: The Trembling of Cicada
items.synopsis: Three legal professionals with troubled pasts become entangled in complex criminal cases, where psychological warfare, hidden agendas, and long-buried secrets blur the line between hunter and prey.

items.title: The Tribute
items.synopsis: The story follows Adolfo Novak, a powerful family patriarch, whose 80th birthday celebration uncovers decades of secrets, betrayals, loyalties, and a thirst for revenge.

items.title: The Truth
items.synopsis: Di Yunxi, Divisi Teknologi Kriminal menangani kasus-kasus paling rumit dan tak biasa. Dipimpin Leng Qiming, tim elit muda ini memadukan profiling tajam, forensik canggih, dan naluri berpengalaman. Saat mereka mengurai kematian demi menegakkan keadilan, kebenaran kelam pun terkuak, namun setiap kasus menyisakan satu pertanyaan besar...

items.title: The Underworld
items.synopsis: In the thriving but crime-ridden city of Shicheng, undercover officer Ling Che reluctantly joins forces with gangster Shen Yanlin. As they pursue the truth behind a series of criminal conspiracies, they uncover corruption, betrayal, and secrets that blur the line between law and crime.

items.title: The Unseen
items.synopsis: Saat menyelidiki dugaan bunuh diri sang kakak, blogger Shen Man terseret ke dalam kasus aneh yang melibatkan seorang dokter kandungan bernama Ai Xia dan operasi pengangkatan rahim yang kontroversial. Tanpa diduga, Shen Man justru menjadi tersangka utama. Seorang polisi wanita, Jiang Li, membantu membersihkan namanya. Sebuah kartu pos misterius yang menghubungkan kedua kasus memaksa mereka bekerja sama. Namun, sebelum kebenaran terungkap, pembunuhan kedua terjadi, membuat misteri ini semakin gelap dan rumit.

items.title: The Vanishing Beauty
items.synopsis: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

items.title: The Village Barber
items.synopsis: Actor Park Bo-gum, who has a license in barbering, opens a barbershop in a remote village in South Korea together with fellow actors and real-life friends Lee Sang-yi and Kwak Dong-yeon, creating bonds and memories with the villagers

items.title: The Westies
items.synopsis: As the Javits Center construction project ignites a battle for profit in early 1980s Hell's Kitchen, a generational rift threatens the uneasy peace between violent Irish gang the Westies and the Mafia, and draws FBI heat.

items.title: The Wonderfools
items.synopsis: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

items.title: Thunder Chaser
items.synopsis: When drug trafficking becomes rampant along the border, an anti-narcotics captain leads a team of young officers into dangerous undercover operations.

items.title: Tientsin Mystic
items.synopsis: Gu Deyou and his master Cha investigate a series of murders in Republican-era Tianjin, uncovering a revenge plot amid a struggle between justice and evil.

items.title: Tigers Sniff the Rose
items.synopsis: Princess Danyang, Mu Wanyao, a formidable and arrogant royal, is married to Yan Shang, a cunning scholar of humble origins. Amid court intrigues, they move from rivalry and mutual suspicion to reconciliation, becoming powerful allies who join forces to break political deadlocks and safeguard peace.

items.title: Time Rescue
items.synopsis: After losing her husband and daughter in an explosion, full-time housewife Wen Xin discovers the ability to reverse time. With a twelve-day time gap, she races against fate, making relentless attempts to save her family.

items.title: To Love & Cherish
items.synopsis: To help support her family, Daran gave up her dreams of higher education to start working immediately after high school. Unfortunately, she struggles to find work, eventually taking a job as a security guard at a broadcasting company. But unexpectedly, she runs into her ex-boyfriend Rangsiman, now a powerful television executive. Daran and Rangsiman were deeply in love in their teens, but separated over painful misunderstandings and secrets kept from each other. Rangsiman himself is now engaged to another woman, but he finds himself drawn back to Daran, wanting to understand why she broke up with him and what led her to her current life circumstances. Can they find a way to forgive each other – and will they rekindle their old spark?

items.title: To My Beloved Thief
items.synopsis: Hong Eun Jo leads a double life: a servant and healer by day and a Robin-Hood-like thief named Gil Dong by night. Grand Prince Do Wol, brother to the King, begins to investigate the case. An encounter with a monk leads to them swapping souls, and they are forced to navigate each other's complex worlds.

items.title: To the Stars
items.synopsis: Wu Wei dreams of working in aerospace, but a failed interview leaves him assigned to the archives rather than the Flight Control Center. After earning a place on the elite Mu Xing team, he reunites with his longtime rival Ying Ziqi, and together they navigate the challenges of major space missions while growing from competitors into trusted teammates.

items.title: Too Young To Love
items.synopsis: Gifted cellist Yi Lan, inspired by her mother’s influence and her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, forms a trio in her first week of high school to challenge the school orchestra and perform at the annual festival. Her fiery passion for music reignites Tong Xiaole’s own dream, and as they chase their ambitions together, love, friendship, and youth blend into a heartfelt symphony of growth and hope.

items.title: Tracks in the Snow
items.synopsis: Seorang influencer palsu yang mengaku bisa meramal tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus penculikan aneh. Dalam waktu 24 jam, misteri mulai terungkap dan membuka rahasia mengerikan. Tiga kelompok orang yang saling terhubung perlahan membongkar rencana tersembunyi. Seorang influencer, penculik, dan bankir licik terlibat dalam kekacauan ini, masing-masing berjuang untuk bertahan hidup atau menyelamatkan keadaan, namun justru memperlihatkan sisi memalukan mereka.

items.title: Treasure Island
items.synopsis: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

items.title: Turbulent Love
items.synopsis: Hao Yu, anak angkat seorang komisaris polisi, menyusup ke dunia kriminal sebagai informan dan menjalin hubungan dengan putra bos mafia, Ji Zhijie. Meski tahu identitasnya, Ji Zhijie tetap melindunginya dengan taruhan nyawa. Saat mantan kekasih Hao Yu, Zhou Ziheng, kembali, kemanakah hati mereka memutuskan antara cinta, kebenaran dan keadilan?

items.title: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team
items.synopsis: A look inside the United States Men’s National Soccer Team in the leadup to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America in June. Filmed over the course of four years, the series follows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah, Weston McKennie, and an array of U.S. players on their personal and collective journeys toward their sport’s biggest stage.

items.title: Umthetho
items.synopsis: To keep their youngest brother alive, a state prosecutor becomes a double agent in her imprisoned older brother's gang.

items.title: Unchosen
items.synopsis: Saat seorang ibu muda dalam kultus tertutup bertemu orang tak dikenal yang misterius, ia memulai hubungan gelap berbahaya yang membangkitkan hasrat serta rahasia kelam.

items.title: Unconditional
items.synopsis: Liburan ibu dan anak ke luar negeri berubah jadi mimpi buruk ketika Gali ditangkap karena narkoba. Menolak percaya pada tuduhan itu, Orna nekat mempertaruhkan segalanya demi kebebasan putrinya hingga terseret ke dalam jaring rahasia Gali sendiri.

items.title: Under Salt Marsh
items.synopsis:
Morfa Halen is a tight-knit Welsh town precariously nestled between towering mountains and a fast-encroaching sea that threatens its very existence. As a once-in-a-generation storm begins to gather far out at sea, former detective turned teacher Jackie Ellis discovers the body of her 8-year-old pupil, Cefin, seemingly drowned.

The discovery sends shockwaves through the community, reviving the ghost of an unsolved cold case that rocked the town three years prior - the disappearance of Jackie’s niece, Nessa, which cost her career.

items.title: Under the Rainbow
items.synopsis: Seven touching stories that happen in Choi Hung Estate. Depicting different emotions and regrets, the stories reflect Hongkongers’ sentimental feelings towards public housing estates. Each of them reminds the viewers that the iconic estate is nearing its end as the characters intersect.

items.title: Undercover Chef: Korea
items.synopsis: Korean celebrity chefs go undercover as junior chefs and must prove their skills to their bosses in only five days.

items.title: Undercover Miss Hong
items.synopsis: A retro office comedy depicting the chaotic events that unfold in the late 1990s when Sammo Hung, a 30-year-old elite securities supervisor who only cares about work, goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate employee at a securities firm where suspicious money flows are detected.

items.title: Unexpected Loves
items.synopsis: What do a thief, a tennis coach, a nurse, and a tollbooth worker all have in common? Coming from unique plots and a variety of characters, in each episode Martín Bossi plays a different protagonist, someone in search of an unexpected love story.

items.title: Unfamiliar
