items.synopsis: Saat masa lalu menghantui dua mantan mata-mata, tantangan terbesar mereka bukan kejar-kejaran mobil, baku tembak, atau perkelahian, melainkan saling mengatakan kebenaran.

items.title: Unplanned Trip: Limited Edition
items.synopsis: Several years after Jung Yu Mi, Park Seo Jun, and Choi Woo Shik became successful restauranters in another show, they've reunited to enjoy some time off of their normal jobs. The trio will travel all across South Korea, but there's a twist: they don't know exactly where they're going or how they're getting there, and they must travel to a new city every day. Loosely chaperoned by legendary television producer Na Yeong Seok, affectionately known as "Na PD," these actors are in for a journey they'll never forget as they're forced to make tough, yet entertaining choices along the way.

items.title: Unsoiled Starlight
items.synopsis: Eleven years after her father’s death destroys her family, a woman who changed her identity reunites with a tech entrepreneur and becomes entangled in a relationship that may be part of his decade-long plan or her own quest for revenge.

items.title: Until the T-Shirt Dries
items.synopsis: A sudden summer accident shatters the peaceful lives of two couples, dragging a happily married editor into a web of grief, human selfishness, and her husband's hidden secrets.

items.title: Unveil: Jadewind
items.synopsis: A stern officer and a sharp-witted investigator form a detective duo that solves eerie murders and uncovers corruption within the Tang Dynasty.

items.title: Vanished
items.synopsis: When a romantic getaway to Paris takes a dark turn with the sudden disappearance of her boyfriend Tom aboard a train to the south of France, Alice is plunged into a web of intrigue and danger, uncovering shocking secrets about the man she thought she knew.

items.title: Veil of Shadows
items.synopsis: Lu Wuyi adalah Rubah Ekor Sembilan termuda dari organisasi misterius bernama Bulan Baru. Dalam misinya bersama sang kakak, Wu Wangyan, untuk mencari Xiaowei yang merupakan seekor siluman rubah yang melarikan diri, dia menyusup ke Kediaman Wei di Kota Luo’an. Secara bersamaan, beberapa orang lainnya juga menyusup ke kediaman tersebut, ada Wu Shiguang yang memikul dendam kesumat yang mendalam, serta Ji Ling dan Li Jie, penyihir dari sekte Shilin. Dalam upaya mengungkap kebenaran, mereka terlibat dalam aksi saling menguji sekaligus bekerja sama. Meskipun masing-masing memiliki tujuan tersembunyi yang berbeda, melalui perebutan demi perebutan atas Kekuatan Dewa Naga, mereka berulang kali mengubah alur nasib. Demi menjaga perdamaian dunia manusia, mereka harus membuat pilihan sulit dan pengorbanan yang berat.

items.title: Viral Hit
items.synopsis: Setelah tak sengaja jadi viral karena berkelahi, seorang remaja miskin korban perundungan memulai saluran streaming untuk mendapatkan uang dan keluar dari keputusasaan.

items.title: VisionQuest
items.synopsis: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

items.title: Vitrerie Joyal
items.synopsis: A determined immigrant builds his way up from zero in Quebec's competitive 1990s business landscape, navigating challenges and opportunities while creating a successful enterprise.

items.title: Vladimir
items.synopsis: Ketika seorang profesor Bahasa Inggris terobsesi dengan kolega barunya yang tampan, kondisi karier dan pernikahannya yang sudah bermasalah menjadi kacau balau.

items.title: Walid
items.synopsis: Lanjutan dari series Bidaah. Setelah lolos dari penangkapan, mantan pemimpin sekte Walid bersembunyi di pegunungan untuk membangun kembali pengikutnya. Ia bersekutu dengan Habiburrahman, seorang pendakwah Indonesia yang kesalehannya menyembunyikan ambisi yang setajam ambisi Walid sendiri. Kerjasama mereka segera berubah menjadi persaingan halus untuk dominasi. Sementara itu, istri Walid yang telah berpisah, Ummi Hafizah, mencoba mengarahkan Jihad Ummah kembali ke jalan yang benar, tetapi ia mendapati dirinya tertarik pada kekuatan palsu yang pernah merusak Walid. Ustadz Fateh, guru lama Walid, kembali dari Kairo, bertekad untuk menyelamatkan mantan muridnya dan Ummi Hafizah sebelum mereka tersesat dalam kesombongan dan ilusi. Kisah mereka bertemu dalam konflik antara iman dan ego, memaksa masing-masing dari mereka untuk merenungkan makna kepercayaan, pengampunan, dan penebusan.

items.title: WANNA ONE GO: Back to Base
items.synopsis: Seven years later, Wanna One returns! In the dream hideout "Wanna-Base,” filled with Wanna One’s long-held wishes, a new chapter of their story begins. Members who had been active individually in their own paths gather at Wanna-Base laughing, playing, and making new memories together— becoming a stronger “us."

items.title: War
items.synopsis: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

items.title: We Are All Trying Here
items.synopsis: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

items.title: Welcome back, First love.
items.synopsis: A quiet office worker reunites with her former high school delinquent classmate, only to discover that his polished new life hides a mysterious secret.

items.title: Where Colors Dream
items.synopsis: Di Shanghai era Republik Tiongkok, pelukis yatim piatu Xu Yanzhen bertemu Jiang Xinyu, kepala pembukuan bank yang dijebak dalam sebuah konspirasi. Demi menyelamatkan lukisan nasional dari tangan asing, mereka bersekutu dan menjalankan rencana berani dengan memalsukan karya seni. Di tengah intrik dan perebutan kepentingan, mampukah mereka menjaga kebenaran?

items.title: Where the Mask Ends
items.synopsis: Chou awalnya adalah gadis rendahan pengangkat kotoran malam di jalanan yang bisa diinjak-injak dan ditindas oleh siapa saja. Namun, hanya karena memiliki wajah yang sangat mirip dengan Wei Rao, putri kediaman bangsawan, dia secara tidak terduga menjadi pengantin pengusir kesialan bagi Lu Zhuo, sang putra pewaris dari Kediaman Adipati. Chou memiliki ambisi yang besar dan bertekad memanfaatkan kesempatan itu untuk naik pangkat. Suami yang hampir mati mendadak siuman dan tindakan mengambil alih posisi secara tidak sah ini memicu serangkaian bencana bertubi-tubi. Wei Rao membencinya karena merebut posisinya dan ingin menyingkirkannya secepat mungkin. Sementara itu, Lu Zhuo memandangnya sebagai wanita berhati kejam serta mewaspadai dan memperhitungkan setiap gerak-geriknya. Kediaman Adipati yang tampak harmonis di permukaan sebenarnya penuh dengan jebakan di setiap langkahnya.

items.title: Whisper of Desire
items.synopsis: Two families share a close bond, but beneath the surface lies a series of concealed truths. As relationships evolve and tensions rise, each character’s hidden past and motivations begin to emerge.

items.title: Whispers of Southern Song
items.synopsis: During the Republican era, the theft of a jade Buddha relic and the murder of an opera troupe leader draw a young marshal, a celebrated opera performer, and a wealthy heiress into a deadly conspiracy. As long-buried secrets and an old murder case come to light, they uncover unexpected ties that reshape their relationships and destinies.

items.title: Widow's Bay
items.synopsis: Wali kota sebuah kota kecil New England bertekad menjadikannya destinasi wisata populer, terlepas dari peringatan warga akan kutukannya.

items.title: Wild & Fiery
items.synopsis: Twenty years after a baby-switching scheme separated the Mu family’s true heir from his birthright, Shen Jibai grows up in hardship while Mu Zhiyu returns as a renowned auctioneer determined to reclaim the family auction house from her stepmother. Manipulated into opposing each other, Shen Jibai and Mu Zhiyu are drawn into a web of power and deception, ultimately joining forces to uncover the truth and seek revenge.

items.title: Wild Boys: Strangers in Town
items.synopsis: In 2003, two young men emerge from the forests of British Columbia claiming to have been raised entirely off the grid. As a small town tries to help them, a mystery unfolds, testing how far people will go to believe the unbelievable.

items.title: Wonder Man
items.synopsis: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

items.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
items.synopsis: Explores WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age, examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt, and the human cost of total war.

items.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
items.synopsis: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

items.title: Xiao Fang
items.synopsis: It tells the story of Yang Xiaofang and Qi Xiaowei from the same village, who become pregnant before marriage. Yang's family rushes back to the village to strategize for Xiaofang. The Qi and Yang families have completely different attitudes, unexpectedly sparking a "marital storm." After negotiations between the two families fail, Xiaofang starts "blind dates while pregnant" — and surprisingly finds herself courted by the whole village, setting off a series of hilarious and laugh-out-loud events.

items.title: Yaga
items.synopsis: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

items.title: You Have My Heart
items.synopsis: A materialist scholar strays into a demon's realm, only to rediscover a century-old soul-bond and a love predestined by fate.

items.title: You're Killing Me
items.synopsis: In a quaint New England town, bestselling novelist Allie forms an unlikely alliance with aspiring writer and podcaster Andi to find the killer of a close friend.

items.title: Young Sherlock
items.synopsis: Saksikan kisah asal-usul Sherlock Holmes yang legendaris dalam misteri penuh aksi yang menggelikan sajian Guy Ritchie pada masa awal petualangan sang detektif yang ikonis ini.

items.title: Your Dear Daddy
items.synopsis: Exiled from home, a man finds solace in Chiang Rai, where a guarded man helps him heal—and teaches him how to love in return.

items.title: Your Love Is Invincible
items.synopsis: Anna Kusakabe had it all: a high-powered career at a prestigious management consulting firm and a reputation for excellence. But when she abruptly resigns, she claims it’s to pursue financial independence and early retirement. In reality, her life is a chaotic patchwork of whims and temporary gigs. While organizing receipts for a struggling design studio, Anna crosses paths with Mizuki Seo, a brilliant yet notoriously ill-tempered character designer. Though she tries to keep her distance, she can’t ignore his tendency to accept exploitative work from shady clients. What begins as a simple attempt to intervene quickly spirals into an unexpected partnership. As Anna steps into the creative world to help Mizuki, the two polar opposites find their lives – and their professional futures – inextricably linked. Can Anna find the true independence she seeks, or will this messy collaboration change her life forever?

items.title: Your Summer, My Storm
items.synopsis: A heartbroken high school senior falls for his sister’s boyfriend during a summer of tutoring, first love, and self-discovery.

items.title: Youth
items.synopsis: A 50-year-old divorcee searches for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

items.title: Zenigata Heiji
items.synopsis: When a man is found dead within the grounds of a shrine carrying a fragment of what appears to be a building blueprint, Heiji Zenigata begins investigating. While others dismiss the case as a simple robbery, Heiji suspects a much larger conspiracy. Meanwhile, the arrival of a popular traveling troupe in Edo brings new mysteries that may be connected to the murder.

items.title: Zhan Zhao Adventures
items.synopsis: Zhan Zhao, a fourth-ranked imperial guard, embarks on a solo investigation after receiving evidence of a cold case. Along the way, he encounters the strong-willed Miss Huo Linglong and the justice-driven Bai Yutang. The three like-minded companions join forces to uncover clues, uphold justice, and capture criminals. Together, they work to expose a dangerous web of power that has infiltrated both the court and the martial world, ultimately restoring peace to the people.

items.title: #1 Happy Family USA
items.synopsis: Dari kreator Ramy Youssef, hadir #1 Happy Family USA, sebuah serial animasi untuk dewasa tentang keluarga Hussein yang amat ceria - keluarga Muslim paling patriotik, paling damai, dan paling tak mencurigakan di "Amreeka" pasca-9/11. Dengan satire dan absurditas, film ini mendefinisikan kembali cara menemukan humor di masa sulit awal tahun 2000-an di bawah pengawasan ketat para tetangga yang takut.

items.title: 119 Emergency Call
items.synopsis: Yuki Kasuhara, a command officer in Yokohama's Fire Department, handles 119 emergency calls, balancing high-pressure crises and workplace challenges. Known for her quick thinking, she often defies norms by visiting accident scenes, sparking friction within the team.

items.title: 24-Hour Health Club aka Pump Up the Healthy Love
9-1-1: Nashville
items.synopsis: Follow heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour, in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities: Nashville, Tennessee.

items.title: 911: Did the Killer Call?
items.synopsis: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they’re innocent — but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.

items.title: A Dream Like the True Love
items.synopsis: Lahir dalam kemiskinan, Chen Pan’er dipaksa masuk ke rumah bordil oleh pejabat dengan dalih ritual dewa sungai. Ia melarikan diri, mengganti nama jadi Bao Yin, dan menjual diri sebagai pelayan untuk bertahan hidup. Ia bertemu Wen Su, pria yang pernah menyelamatkannya. Bersama, mereka menghadapi bahaya dan meraih sukses tertinggi.

items.title: A Dream within a Dream
items.synopsis: Song Xiaoyu tanpa sengaja masuk ke dunia naskah dan menjadi tokoh utama wanita yang ditakdirkan disakiti dan dibuang oleh pemeran utama pria; meski mencoba mengubah alur dan melarikan diri, ia terus terjebak dalam lingkaran kematian berulang, hingga akhirnya menyadari bahwa satu-satunya jalan keluar adalah melawan takdir dan menulis ulang kisah hidupnya sendiri.

items.title: A Farmer's Fortune
items.synopsis: He Qingqing, seorang food blogger, tanpa sengaja terlempar ke masa lalu dan hidup di desa sederhana. Ia harus bekerja keras melunasi hutang, menjalani pernikahan tak terduga yang berubah jadi cinta, serta membesarkan anak yang manis. Saat karier, cinta, dan keluarganya berjalan sempurna, ia dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit: tetap di masa lalu atau kembali ke dunia asalnya.

items.title: A Fleeting Dream
items.synopsis: Lian Xinruo, putri saudagar kaya, kehilangan segalanya setelah keluarganya hancur dan ia hampir dikubur hidup-hidup. Diselamatkan Pei Yuze, ia bersumpah balas dendam. Lima tahun kemudian, kembali sebagai penyanyi Du Youmeng, ia bekerja sama dengan Pei Yuze untuk mengungkap kebenaran dan memulai permainan dendam yang gemilang.

items.title: A Graceful Liar
items.synopsis: Depicts the story of two lustful women, a mother and daughter who were bound by blood and now meet as mother-in-law and fight a war of lies to take over the golden palace.

items.title: A Head Coachs Turnover
items.synopsis: A losing basketball coach turns to a fierce online hate commenter to help improve the team's prospects.

items.title: A Hundred Memories
items.synopsis: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama-comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

items.title: A Killer Among Friends
items.synopsis: The murder of one of their own changes groups of friends forever. The tragic loss of a member of their inner circle — and their terrifying closeness to the killer — haunt them as they uncover secrets and confront the painful truth.

items.title: A Lifetime of Happiness
items.synopsis: After a car accident leads Jin Daxi to be mistaken for his estranged twin brother Tong Sheng, the two switch lives, triggering clashes, unexpected romance, and tests of family loyalty. With the help of Jin Dahuan and Yan Yan, they work together to expose a dangerous scheme.

items.title: A Love Never Lost
items.synopsis: After the Gengzi Kingdom changed, the land of China was devastated, and young people with aspirations rose up to save their homeland. Aristocratic youth Liang Xiang, revolutionary party Yang Kaizhi, and Beiyang Wuyou Guardian Li Renjun became the first batch of progressive young people who went to Japan to study at a non-commissioned officer’s school. They met revolutionary exiles Yu Tianbai and Qiu Hong on a cruise ship. Since then, the five people have been fatefully linked.

items.title: A Moment But Forever
items.synopsis: Dalam pertempuran antara dewa dan siluman, dewa pertama, Taihe, menggunakan mestika "Tangan Kiri Dewa" untuk menyegel dewa siluman. Namun, mestika itu jatuh ke dunia manusia dan para dewa tertidur panjang. Klan Hantu Perang memanfaatkan kekacauan ini untuk bangkit, memicu perang besar. Yuan Zhong dari Klan Rubah memperoleh mestika tersebut, mengalahkan Klan Hantu Perang, dan menciptakan era baru. Wu Shuang, yang disuruh langit untuk menjelma menjadi gadis manusia dan melayani Yuan Zhong, berusaha melindunginya dan membantu membuka segel, tanpa menyadari niat jahat Yuan Zhong. Setelah banyak rintangan, mereka akhirnya bersatu untuk mengalahkan kejahatan dan mengembalikan ketertiban dunia.

items.title: A Nation of Tteok
items.synopsis: For every celebration and season, tteok is a staple. Discover how this traditional rice dessert weaves through Korean life, heritage and culture.

items.title: A Sample Family
items.synopsis: During a historic Bangkok flood, Tui secretly moves his family-Nok and their daughter Gib-into a luxury show house. As they fake a perfect life online for Gib's elite school dream, their lies begin to unravel.

items.title: A Thousand Blows
items.synopsis: Hezekiah and Alec, two friends from Jamaica, finds themselves thrust into the criminal underbelly of London's East End. Here they meet Mary Carr, Queen of an all-female criminal gang known as the Forty Elephants, and run afoul of Sugar Goodson, criminal kingpin and notorious boxer.

items.title: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
items.synopsis: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

items.title: A Vow in the Dark
items.synopsis: Tiga ratus tahun lalu, seorang dewi menyegel Raja Iblis Jie Chuan. Ratusan tahun kemudian, Jin Li tanpa sengaja membuka segel itu dan dibawa ke Dunia Iblis karena kekuatannya. Dari hubungan yang penuh konflik, keduanya perlahan saling jatuh cinta, hingga terungkap rahasia besar tentang asal-usul Jin Li yang memicu kisah cinta dan kebencian.

items.title: A Week Before I Die aka Way Back Love
Above the Clouds
items.synopsis: Lu Anning dan Ling Cang, terikat oleh seribu kehidupan penuh cinta tragis, adalah boneka takdir, dari musuh sengit menjadi jiwa yang terbangun. Mereka bersatu dalam jalan kultivasi ilahi, berjuang untuk melepaskan diri dari permainan kejam takdir.

items.title: Abyss Dweller
items.synopsis: Liang Shuo, a Communist underground operative with a head wound, awoke in a snowbound mountain, and his memory was gone. Facing multiple threats, he must navigate a dangerous path to reclaim his identity. With help from unexpected allies, he embarks on a quest to uncover and confront an impossible mission.

items.title: Abyss Live
items.synopsis: To revive the struggling film industry, Yiping Films launches a live-streamed cave exploration reality show. Actor Li Kaixuan and a group of participants set out on the adventure but soon encounter eerie events and deadly traps set by a mysterious figure. As they fight for survival, they face tests of human nature, leading to the shocking truth hidden within the darkness.

items.title: Accidental Firing
items.synopsis: Untuk membalaskan dendam orang tuanya, Lu Yan diam-diam merencanakan pembalasan dedam. Namun, Mu Lan terus menggagalkannya. Setelah penyelidikan, Lu Yan menyadari bahwa Mu Lan adalah gadis yang disukainya saat masa kecil. Dari musuh menjadi sekutu, mereka menargetkan "Lu Changhe". Namun, "Lu Changhe" telah mengetahui semua gerakan mereka...

items.title: Adolescence
items.synopsis: Remaja berusia 13 tahun dituduh membunuh teman sekelasnya. Keluarga, terapis, dan detektif yang menangani kasusnya mempunyai satu pertanyaan: Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi?

items.title: Adults
items.synopsis: A group of twenty-somethings in New York trying to be good people, despite being neither "good" nor "people" yet.

items.title: Aema
items.synopsis: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

items.title: Alien: Earth
items.synopsis: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

items.title: Aligned Reverence
items.synopsis: Su Jinyuan, seorang yatim piatu, kabur dari pernikahannya, namun keputusan itu justru menghancurkan hidupnya. Saat kembali, ia mendapati keluarga yang pernah menolongnyate lah dibantai. Untuk menebus kesalahannya, ia bekerja sama dengan Xie Yunyan, putra angkat keluarga Xiao yang menggantikan saudaranya di hari pernikahan itu. Mereka berjuang bersama melawan para musuh, hingga tumbuh kisah cinta yang membara.

items.title: Alison Hammond's Florida Unpacked
items.synopsis: Former tour rep Alison and son Aidan head to the Sunshine State - on a quest for family adventure in true American style. Can they go full-on Florida without breaking the bank?

items.title: All Her Fault
items.synopsis: In Chicago, Marissa Irvine arrives at 14 Arthur Avenue, expecting to pick up her young son Milo from his first playdate with a boy at his new school. But the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes. She isn't the nanny. She doesn't have Milo. And so begins every parent's worst nightmare.

items.title: All In
items.synopsis: You Haoyun, an amnesiac gambling prodigy, is taken in by a kind family, but his hidden skills spark conflict and uncover buried secrets. As his past unravels, he’s forced to gamble again to expose the truth and seek justice.

items.title: All Rise
items.synopsis: Di firma hukum bergengsi Jun'an, para intern harus saling bersaing. Ren Jia Tong, sosok dingin namun tegas, bertemu kembali dengan Jiang Chen, pria cerdas yang pernah berseteru dengannya karena urusan sewa rumah. Kini mereka bergabung di firma hukum yang sama, dan menjadi rival terbesar satu sama lain. Tapi di antara ambisi dan persaingan, mungkinkah muncul rasa yang tak mereka duga?

items.title: All's Fair
items.synopsis: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

items.title: Always My General
items.synopsis: Disguised as a man, commander Zhou Chu is betrayed by Xu Hanzhi upon her return. Rescued by rival Shang Kefeng, she becomes Xue Shisan, infiltrating Dengying Tower to uncover the truth and exact revenge.

items.title: American Primeval
items.synopsis: Seorang ibu dan anak yang kabur dari masa lalu membentuk sebuah keluarga baru sambil menghadapi lanskap kebebasan dan kekejaman yang keras di wilayah barat Amerika.

items.title: Amsterdam Empire
items.synopsis: Saat perselingkuhan Jack terkuak, istrinya, Betty, membuat rencana jahat untuk merebut hal yang paling Jack cintai: The Jackal, perusahaan coffeeshop besarnya.

items.title: Angry Wind
items.synopsis: Dikhianati dan kembali ke tahun 1990, Zheng Nanfeng kehilangan segalanya dan harus memulai dari nol. Dengan pengetahuan masa depan dan dukungan istrinya, Zhou Zhiyi, ia bangkit menghadapi musuh, membongkar kejahatan penyelundupan, dan menemukan makna sejati kekuatan serta cinta.

items.title: Anti-Fraud
items.synopsis: Qin Lang ingin jadi polisi narkoba, tapi justru ditempatkan di Unit Anti-Penipuan. Ia dipasangkan dengan Gao Man yang dingin dan cerdas. Saat mereka membongkar kasus demi kasus, Qin mulai tertarik dengan pekerjaannya—hingga ia menyadari bahwa dalang penipuan terhubung dengan musuh utamanya.

items.title: Apple Cider Vinegar
items.synopsis: Dua wanita muda mempromosikan pengobatan untuk menyembuhkan penyakit mematikan, mengungkap kehidupan mereka saat mereka tanpa sadar—dan dengan sadar—menyesatkan dunia.

items.title: Arabia Kadali
items.synopsis: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

items.title: As You Stood By
items.synopsis: Saat dua wanita bersekongkol untuk mengakhiri pernikahan yang penuh KDRT lewat pembunuhan, seorang tamu tak terduga hadir dan berpotensi merusak semua rencana mereka.

items.title: Ashita wa motto, Ii Hi ni naru
Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
items.synopsis: Ketika dukun mereka lupa cara membuat ramuan ajaib, Asterix dan Obelix harus melindungi Galia saat Caesar berencana memanfaatkan hukum kuno untuk melawan mereka.

items.title: Asura
items.synopsis: Di Tokyo tahun 1979, empat saudari yang amat berbeda mengetahui perselingkuhan sang ayah yang sudah tua. Sandiwara bahagia dan emosi terpendam mereka perlahan terbongkar.

items.title: Atomic
items.synopsis: When the path of free-spirited drug smuggler Max collides with JJ, an enigmatic outsider on the run, an unlikely friendship is formed. They're swept into a chaotic, high-stakes mission they never signed up for, trafficking highly enriched uranium across North Africa and the Middle East, with the CIA, MI6, and a global web of opposing forces closing in fast.

items.title: B:MY BOYZ
items.synopsis: B:MY BOYZ aims to create a new global boy group. The show will feature 30 talents selected from Korea, Japan, China, Thailand, and beyond, with the goal to debut as the next generation idols. The participants will compete against each other in various fields including vocals, performance, and producing, with the current top idol seniors selecting the next idols.

items.title: Back for You aka Reversing Time
Back to School
items.synopsis: Six employees are sent back to primary school for a retraining program, joining real fourth-grade students in Class 4S. As unlikely friendships form and personal growth unfolds, a rule-breaking incident threatens it all.

items.title: Bad Thoughts
items.synopsis: Kumpulan cerita yang sangat vulgar dan mendobrak berbagai batasan kesopanan dengan cara-cara yang hanya bisa dibayangkan oleh Tom Segura.

items.title: Badly in Love
items.synopsis: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

items.title: Ballard
items.synopsis: Detektif Renée Ballard terlibat ke dalam jaringan pembunuhan dan korupsi saat dia memburu seorang pembunuh berantai yang kejam dan mengungkap konspirasi polisi yang mengancam semua hal yang dia perjuangkan. Dengan masa lalu kelam yang terus mengintainya, Ballard harus mengalahkan penjahat dan komplotannya untuk memberikan keadilan yang telah lama ditunggu para korban dan keluarga mereka.

items.title: Bastard Wargod
items.synopsis: Chu Beichi, Dewa Perang Kunlun, terbangun dari koma dan menyamar sebagai anak selir di Keluarga Chu. Diam-diam ia bangkit, membela keluarga, melawan bandit, dan membongkar misteri besar. Saat kerajaan gemetar, empat wanita kuat memperebutkan hatinya—dunia pun takluk di bawah kekuasaannya.

items.title: Bat-Fam
items.synopsis: Film animasi aksi-komedi berdurasi 22 menit ini dibintangi oleh Damian dan Bruce Wayne. Film ini mengisahkan saat mereka dan keluarga mereka yang erat, yang terdiri dari orang-orang buangan, menghadapi tantangan kehidupan sehari-hari sembari melindungi jalanan Gotham.

items.title: Be Not Meant to Be
items.synopsis: Dikhianati mantan suami dan kehilangan putrinya, Ye Nanzhao diculik dan terpaksa mengambil identitas wanita mati sebagai istri kedua keluarga Lu. Tak disangka, sang mantan kini jadi menantu keluarga itu—dan identitas barunya menyimpan segudang masalah yang harus ia hadapi.

items.title: Be Passionately in Love
items.synopsis: Pada ujian masuk perguruan tinggi, Xu Zhi menjadi pemenang di Sekolah Menengah Ruijun. Namun, siapa sangka bahwa dia akan menghadapi kekalahan terbesar dalam cinta?

items.title: Be Yourself
items.synopsis: Seorang master tua berlatih selama 100 tahun dan gagal saat hendak naik ke alam lebih tinggi. Jiwanya menyatu dengan Zhao Feiyang, anak keempat keluarga Zhao yang dianggap gagal. Tiba-tiba, tiga lamaran pernikahan datang, dan sejak itu, hidupnya berubah drastis dan penuh petualangan.

items.title: Beauty Empire
items.synopsis: It follows rags-to-riches CEO Noreen Alfonso who is out to take revenge on the people who have wronged her. She stakes her claim as a new beauty industry player, tearing down the empire that her enemies have built. Alfonso goes head-to-head against a crass but famous on social media CEO Shari de Jesus, who is being mentored by a powerful industry veteran Velma Imperial. But as she tears her opponent down on social media and they destroy each other's personal lives, it becomes evident that an invisible player is responsible for the bloodshed happening amidst the ongoing beauty wars.

items.title: Beauty Reborn
items.synopsis: Fresh out of college, ambitious cosmetic scientist Sara battles family struggles, office politics and a love triangle while saving a failing beauty firm.

items.title: Beloved
items.synopsis: A small riverside town faces submersion from a water conservancy project just as a heavy storm in 2002 brings forth a bizarre murder case, where a dead lover and a vanished husband both appear to be victim and culprit. As police unravel the mystery, long-buried secrets and the shadows of human nature are brought to light.

items.title: Beneath the Undertow
items.synopsis: At the former Xuri Factory, a dismembered female body is discovered in an abandoned sewage pit. Veteran detective Lian Haiping and rookie officer Shi Qiangfeng, despite their differences, must work together to solve the case. Their investigation reveals unexpected social issues and brings to light an old case that complicates their personal and professional lives.

items.title: Bet
items.synopsis: Di sekolah swasta tempat judi menentukan status sosial, seorang murid baru berbakat dengan masa lalu yang misterius mengguncang segalanya—dan bertaruh demi balas dendam.

items.title: Better Halves
items.synopsis: Shi Fake, the pampered daughter of a high-profile family, encounters Lu Chi, a rugged and versatile second-generation bandit who has come down from the mountains searching for his little sister.

items.title: Better Late Than Single
items.synopsis: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

items.title: Beyond the Bar
items.synopsis: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

items.title: Beyond the Loop
items.synopsis: After being killed in a deadly betrayal, Yu Yingwan is reborn and stays in the City Lord’s manor to uncover the truth—only to discover her husband Mu Yunqing has also returned from death. Together, they must face the hidden mastermind and fight to change their tragic fate.

items.title: Birangana
items.synopsis: Panic grips the city as a ruthless predator targets social media influencers in a wave of terrifying attacks. Inspector Chitra Basu leads a high-stakes manhunt to dismantle a dangerous scheme of control. The ultimate shock strikes when she unmasks the mastermind behind it all.

items.title: Black Rabbit
items.synopsis: Pengusaha restoran yang sedang naik daun terpaksa terjun ke dunia kriminal bawah tanah New York saat saudaranya yang bermasalah—dan dikejar lintah darat—kembali ke kota.

items.title: Blades Amid Blossoms
items.synopsis: Kematian selir di tengah Taman Bunga Persik memicu penyegelan manor. Yan Shiyi, sang pendekar pengembara, jadi tersangka utama. Di balik kelopak yang memesona, tersembunyi dosa dan rahasia yang mengancam segalanya. Kebenaran? Semakin dikejar, kian menghilang...

items.title: Blemish Flaw
items.synopsis: Perjalanan Yang Zhenghui mencari mantan kekasihnya yang telah menghilang selama tiga tahun, mengarah pada seorang seniman keramik bernama Zeng Jie. Sesuatu yang kelam tersembunyi dalam kebakaran misterius di studio Zeng Jie. Namun saat mencari Zeng Jie, Yang Zheng Hui bertemu dengan istri Zeng Jie, Bai Xiao Ling, dan jatuh cinta padanya.

items.title: BLEND FEELINGS
items.synopsis: After being betrayed in both love and career by her boyfriend, a traditional incense maker named Jian Xiangxiang discovers mysterious on-screen messages that predict her grim future. Determined to change her fate and seek revenge, she sets out to seduce Gu Jingshi - her ex’s powerful, wheelchair-bound uncle. What starts as a calculated plan for vengeance turns into an unexpected entanglement of passion and power.

items.title: Bloom Once More
items.synopsis: Yue Qianxue tewas dijebak musuh, lalu setahun setelahnya Hua Qingming juga gagal melindungi ibu kota. Dunia pun kacau dan penuh penderitaan. Seorang tabib sakti mengirim mereka kembali ke masa lalu. Di kehidupan kedua ini, Qianxue dan Qingming berjuang bersama untuk mengubah takdir dan menyelamatkan dunia.

items.title: Boku-tachi wa Mada sono Hoshi no Kosoku wo Shiranai
Bon Appetit, Your Majesty
items.synopsis: Setelah melintasi waktu ke era Joseon, seorang chef berbakat bertemu seorang raja tiran. Hidangan modernnya memikat selera sang tiran, tetapi tantangan istana menantinya.

items.title: Boneka
items.synopsis: A young couple moves into a mysterious bungalow, where the line between warmth and control blurs under the watchful eye of the enigmatic Nona. As secrets unravel, haunted pasts, forbidden rooms, and disappearing tenants, the tenants find themselves trapped in a web of manipulation, obsession, and psychological torment, controlled like a puppet.

items.title: Bookish
items.synopsis: Gabriel Book, proprietor of an antiquarian bookshop, relies on his vast collection to unravel baffling cases. He nurtures a group of lovable yet troubled individuals, providing informal protection and guidance.

items.title: Boots
items.synopsis: Seusai masuk Korps Marinir AS secara impulsif, remaja korban perundungan menemukan tujuan baru, sekaligus persaudaraan tak terduga, dengan tim rekrutan yang amat beragam.

items.title: Born to Die
items.synopsis: Song Dianxin, a female general, is betrayed and wrongfully executed. After being reborn, she seeks revenge and ends her engagement. Her fiancé, also reborn, tries to regain her love while uncovering the truth behind their betrayal.

items.title: Boston Blue
items.synopsis: NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.

items.title: Bound by Sin
items.synopsis: Putri Ketiga Keluarga Jiang yang bertekad menghancurkan prasangka dunia dan mewarisi bisnis keluarga, demi melindungi diri sendiri, mempekerjakan tokoh utama pria dari latar belakang rendah sebagai pengawalnya. Dunia mereka sangat berbeda. Sikap liar tokoh utama wanita terus menguji batas kesabaran tokoh utama pria, sekaligus menggoda hatinya hingga jatuh ke dalam cinta yang mendalam hingga kenyataan memisahkan mereka. Tokoh utama wanita dipaksa menikah dengan orang lain, sementara tokoh utama pria pergi menjadi tentara. Saat negeri hancur dan tokoh utama wanita terpuruk, tokoh utama pria kembali, menyelamatkannya dari penderitaan, dan akhirnya keduanya mengungkapkan perasaan mereka yang sesungguhnya.

items.title: Breaking the Shadows
items.synopsis: Han Qing, polisi wanita dingin dari Tim Investigasi Kriminal Sanhe, menyelidiki hilangnya rekannya, Zhong Wei, yang lenyap saat membuntuti tersangka. Saat menangani kasus pembunuhan baru, ia menemukan benang merah yang mengarah pada jaringan kriminal besar terkait orang hilang, pembunuhan, dan narkoba. Dengan ketekunan dan kerja tim, kebenaran terungkap dan para pelaku berhasil ditangkap.

items.title: Britain's Most Scenic Counties: Cheshire
items.synopsis:
From the amazing views towards the Welsh mountains to the bucolic village byroads around Tarporley; Cheshire is like a picture- postcard.

This four -part series showcases the charms of Cheshire through some of the county's proud residents as they live, work and play in the beautiful county they call home. From traditional cheese makers to the famous zoo we follow the locals as the county pops with wonderful Autumn colour. Exploring the county's industrial and artisanal past, this series reveals a deep history that the residents of Cheshire are proud to be a part of.

items.title: Burning Passion
items.synopsis: Bertahun-tahun lalu, ibu Shen Qingru dihukum mati dengan cara ditenggelamkan oleh pemimpin klan karena perselingkuhan. Sejak itu, Shen Qingru harus hidup dengan julukan "perempuan hina" dan menyimpan dendam atas kematian ibunya. Dia tumbuh dalam penderitaan, dihina dan dicemooh oleh penduduk kota, hingga suatu hari seorang pemuda bisu bernama Shen Cheng muncul dalam hidupnya. Keduanya menjadi penyelamat satu sama lain, tetapi juga kelemahan terbesar satu sama lain. Hubungan mereka terikat dalam batasan "kakak-adik" yang semakin goyah, tetapi tetap tidak bisa dilanggar. Di hadapan semua orang, Shen Qingru bersumpah dengan air mata bahwa ia tidak akan jatuh cinta.

items.title: Butterfly
items.synopsis: Kehidupan David Jung, mantan agen intelijen AS misterius yang bersembunyi di Korea Selatan, hancur berkeping-keping ketika konsekuensi dari keputusan mustahil di masa lalu kembali menghantuinya dan dia mendapati dirinya diburu oleh Rebecca, seorang pembunuh muda yang mematikan, serta Caddis, organisasi mata-mata jahat tempat Rebecca bekerja.

items.title: Buzz until You Die!!
items.synopsis: A 26-year-old waitress's life spirals after her accidental hit-and-run video goes viral, transforming her into a justice-obsessed influencer who sacrifices morals for online fame, only to become the target of a vengeful online hate campaign.

items.title: Capturing Their Killer: The Girls on the High Bridge
items.synopsis: In the bucolic town of Delphi, Indiana, 13-year-old Abigail Williams and 14-year-old Liberty German set out for a walk on a warm February afternoon in 2017 - and never came home. Their bodies were discovered the next day in a wooded area not far from the trail, setting off a five-year-long search that gripped the nation and haunted this close-knit community.

items.title: Cashero
items.synopsis: Pria biasa yang mewarisi kekuatan super mendapati ada pihak jahat yang ingin mencuri kekuatannya. Masalahnya, tiap kali kekuatan itu dipakai, uang di dompetnya terkuras.

items.title: Celebrity Bear Hunt
items.synopsis: Holly Willoughby memadu acara kompetisi yang diadakan di hutan di Kosta Rika ini. Di sana, 12 selebritas menjadi target si ahli bertahan hidup legendaris, Bear Grylls.

items.title: Chad Powers
items.synopsis: Eight years after an unforgivable mistake nukes his promising college football career, hotshot quarterback Russ Holliday tries to resurrect his dreams by disguising himself as Chad Powers - a talented oddball who walks on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish.

items.title: Changes of Heart
items.synopsis: Hijiri has loved Koyori since childhood, and she feels the same, but they’ve kept their feelings hidden. At 26, they finally give in to their emotions, leading to a night together. Hijiri wants to deepen their relationship, but Koyori is torn between love and preserving their close friendship.

items.title: Chef of Antarctica
items.synopsis: Let's raid the Antarctic base's storage shed and serve warm meals to the thousands of researchers living in isolation, separated from their families, in Antarctic stations across more than 30 countries, driven by a sense of mission!

items.title: Chespirito: Not Really on Purpose
items.synopsis: Miniseries that follow the life and career of Mexican actor, comedian and producer Roberto Gómez Bolaños, known for being the creator of El Chavo del 8, El Chapulín Colorado and Chespirito.

items.title: Chief of War
items.synopsis: Dengan empat kerajaan Hawaii terpecah karena perang, prajurit ganas bernama Kaʻiana memulai misi hebat untuk menyatukan rakyatnya di saat ancaman eksistensial mendekati pantai mereka.

items.title: City of Romance
items.synopsis: Bai Xiaoduo, accustomed to protecting herself with lies due to her low self-esteem, meets Su Yancheng, a genius cartoonist who despises dishonesty. Despite their differences, they support each other through a series of events, gradually healing one another's inner wounds.

items.title: City of Shadows
items.synopsis: A gruesome crime has taken place in La Pedrera – Casa Milà: a burned body is found on the facade of Gaudí's iconic building. Inspector Milo Malart, previously suspended for misconduct by the Mossos d'Esquadra (Mossos of the Squadron), returns to Barcelona to find the perpetrator along with Sub-Inspector Rebeca Garrido.

items.title: Coldwater
items.synopsis: A man in the midst of a mid-life crisis moves his family to a remote Scottish village, only to find himself entangled in a dangerous friendship with a sinister neighbour.

items.title: Coming to Court Soon
items.synopsis: Zhong Qinyang and assistant prosecutor Song Su pursue justice in cases involving minors. Along the way, Zhong Qinyang befriends high school student Li Songyan, and together they uncover the truth behind Zhong Qinyang ’s parents' fatal car accident. As the real culprit is brought to justice, they begin a new chapter filled with hope and renewal.

items.title: Common Side Effects
items.synopsis: Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.

items.title: Concrete Market
items.synopsis: Tells the story of an unbroken apartment becoming a place for barter in a world that has been ruined since the earthquake.

items.title: Contenders
items.synopsis: Di tepi Sungai Malaka era 1940-an, para perantau membentuk Geng Shan Hai, kelompok legendaris yang jadi pusat kekuatan. Ketika pengkhianatan, perebutan kekuasaan, dan ancaman kolonial mengguncang, bisakah mereka mempertahankan jalan hidup mereka?

items.title: Cooper & Fry
items.synopsis: Set in the mystery-shrouded Peak District, the series follows two mismatched young detectives: affable local Ben Cooper and guarded newcomer Diane Fry. Thrown together to investigate a string of mysterious deaths they must learn to work together to get results. As their personal lives begin to intertwine, a unique friendship begins to form... but it won't always be easy.

items.title: Coroner's Diary
items.synopsis: Shen Wan, putri dari pejabat tinggi Shen Yi yang keluarganya dibantai karena kasus Pangeran Jin, melarikan diri ke Jingzhou dengan menyamar sebagai Qin Wan, Nona Kesembilan dari Keluarga Qin. Dari gadis lemah lembut, Qin Wan berubah menjadi ahli pengobatan dan otopsi yang cerdas, sekaligus mengendalikan keluarga Qin yang penuh intrik. Dalam penyelidikan kasus, ia bertemu Yan Chi, Putra Mahkota Raja Rui, yang memiliki tujuan sama untuk membersihkan nama Pangeran Jin. Bersama-sama mereka memecahkan berbagai kasus misterius dan akhirnya mengungkap rahasia besar yang tersembunyi di dalam istana.

items.title: Countdown
items.synopsis: Ketika seorang petugas Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri dibunuh pada siang bolong, detektif LAPD Mark Meachum direkrut ke satgas rahasia bersama agen badan penegak hukum lainnya untuk menyelidiki. Namun, pencarian pembunuh itu ternyata mengungkapkan rencana yang jauh lebih mengerikan, sehingga mereka harus berpacu dengan waktu untuk menyelamatkan sebuah kota yang berpenduduk jutaan.

items.title: Crime Night!
items.synopsis: Host Julia Zemiro and an expert team of criminologists and comedians dive beneath the surface of crime to discover the science and psychology behind it all.

items.title: Crime Scene Zero
items.synopsis: In this mystery showdown, players engage in layered scenarios as either suspects or detectives — each striving to outsmart others and uncover the truth.

items.title: Criminal Scene
items.synopsis: Kapten Tim Investigasi Kriminal, Gu Zhen, memimpin timnya menyelidiki serangkaian kasus kejahatan, memecahkan kasus sulit dengan kecerdasan. Di saat yang sama, Gu Zhen mengetahui dirinya menjadi sasaran balas dendam keluarga korban dari kasus lama. Untuk melindungi orang-orang dan keluarganya, dia menghadapi pelaku dan memastikan mereka dihukum.

items.title: Crossing the River
items.synopsis: In 1948, officers from the Third Field Army infiltrate Nanjing to aid the underground Communist Party in protecting intelligence, securing supplies, and undermining enemy forces, paving the way for the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign and the nation’s liberation.

items.title: Crushology 101
items.synopsis: Bunny is a talented sculpture student with a warm personality but struggles with low self-esteem due to a failed first love.

items.title: Culinary Vendetta
items.synopsis: Demi menikahi sang jenderal, Putri Mingzhu berencana mencelakai keluarga Su Qianqian. Namun akhirnya Mingzhu dan Su Qianqian masing-masing menikahi jenderal. Akhirnya, Su Qianqian bersama dengan suaminya, jenderal Chu Junyao bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan rencana balas dendam, dan memenangkan hati semua orang dengan keterampilan memasaknya.

items.title: Dalah: Death and the Flowers
items.synopsis: Saat kliennya tewas di malam pernikahan, penjual bunga ini mencari si pembunuh, menguak rahasia-rahasia kelam masyarakat kelas atas—sambil menyimpan rahasianya sendiri.

items.title: Dangerous Love
items.synopsis: Xu Beisheng menyamar di sisi jenderal musuh demi membalas kematian ayahnya. Untuk menggagalkan perjodohan dua keluarga, ia mendekati Zhou Menghua, namun cinta tumbuh di antara mereka. Saat penyamarannya terbongkar, Zhou membalas dendam. Mampukah cinta bertahan di tengah tipu daya dan kebencian?

items.title: Daredevil: Born Again
items.synopsis: Matt Murdock berjuang memperjuangkan keadilan, sementara Wilson Fisk mengejar ambisi politiknya. Keduanya berada dalam konflik yang tak terhindarkan.

items.title: Date My Friend
items.synopsis: A fun and heartwarming reality show where celebrities introduce their real single best friends and cheer them on as they try to find love. Over five days and four nights, these singles get to know each other, go on dates, and explore romantic connections with their famous friends supporting them every step of the way.

items.title: Dead End
items.synopsis: Two generations of detectives stumble through challenges, unwavering in their pursuit, as they search for a killer in maze-like alleyways, ultimately finding their way out of the dead ends in their own lives.

items.title: Dear Enemy
items.synopsis: Luo Man dan Chen Kai Xi adalah teman sekelas di perguruan tinggi. Setelah lulus, mereka menjauh. Satu menjadi penulis skenario sukses, yang lain menjadi ibu rumah tangga kaya. Setelah sepuluh tahun, mereka bertemu lagi dan saling tidak ingin melihat yang lain gagal atau sukses. Luo Man tidak puas dengan kariernya dan berharap menikah dapat membuatnya setara dengan Chen Kai Xi, yang terjebak dalam pernikahan. Dalam persaingan mereka, Zhong Qing Cheng yang muda dan cantik menjadi sosok "kunci".

items.title: Dear Hongrang
items.synopsis: Ahli waris yang lama hilang ini kembali, tetapi hilang ingatan. Cinta dan kecurigaan pun beradu. Ini Hongrang, atau orang lain yang mau merusak hati dan ikatan keluarga?

items.title: Dear Secretary
items.synopsis: Seorang CEO wanita cantik dan dominan bertemu dengan sekretarisnya yang rapi, berpengalaman, dan lulusan luar negeri. Terpaksa bekerja bersama, interaksi awal di antara mereka justru memicu benih-benih cinta yang tak terduga, membawa keduanya dari rival menjadi pasangan seumur hidup.

items.title: Dear X
items.synopsis: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

items.title: Death by Lightning
items.synopsis: Kisah James Garfield, yang naik dari orang biasa menjadi Presiden Amerika ke-20—dan Charles Guiteau, pria yang membunuhnya.

items.title: Deep Affection Eyes
items.synopsis: Ye Meng, seeking a fresh start after career setbacks, returns to her hometown for a quieter life. There, she meets the mysterious Li Jinyu, whose reserved nature and deeply expressive eyes intrigue her. As their connection deepens, they embark on a journey of mutual healing and unexpected love.

items.title: Deli Boys
items.synopsis: When their convenience store-magnate father suddenly dies, a pair of pampered Pakistani American brothers lose everything and are forced to reckon with their Baba's secret life of crime as they attempt to take up his mantle in the underworld.

items.title: Dept. Q
items.synopsis: Si polisi kasar nan brilian menjadi kepala departemen baru. Ia memimpin tim beranggotakan orang-orang yang tak terduga untuk memecahkan kasus-kasus lama di Edinburgh.

items.title: Destiny and Saving aka Clash of the Titans
Destiny of Love
items.synopsis: Gu Manman, pemilik toko serba bisa yang cerdik dan unik, ditugaskan menggagalkan perjodohan dengan pangeran negeri Xilin. Ia pun terlibat kekacauan kocak dengan Fu Chengjin, pangeran yang pura-pura pincang demi menghindari perebutan takhta. Tapi saat perasaan tumbuh dan rahasia besar terungkap…

items.title: Destiny of the General's Bride
items.synopsis: Gadis muda Su Hua melarikan diri dan jatuh cinta dengan Jenderal Xiao Yun, namun dijebak oleh kakaknya sendiri dan diperkosa serta dikubur hidup-hidup oleh Xiao Ye, adik kedua Xiao Yun. Su Hua “terlahir kembali” sebagai pelacur terkenal bernama Qing Yan, lalu menikah dengan Xiao Yun melalui sebuah kesepakatan untuk masuk ke kediaman keluarga Xiao demi membalas dendam. Dalam perjalanannya, ia berjuang keras menyelamatkan para saudari yang juga menjadi korban, hingga akhirnya keluarga Xiao menerima hukuman. Pada akhirnya, identitas Su Hua dipulihkan dan ia kembali bersatu dengan Xiao Yun.

items.title: Destiny Switch
items.synopsis: Luo Jie, ahli sihir ruang-waktu, tiba-tiba terjebak dalam tubuh Alang, anak haram orang kaya. Kekuatan waktunya jadi jam saku. Saat menyelidiki kematian Alang, ia terseret konflik geng dan diburu banyak pihak. Ia pun menemukan bahwa semua ini terkait dengan sosok misterius dan bencana masa depan.

items.title: Devil May Cry
items.synopsis: Batasan menjadi kabur saat kebaikan bertarung epik melawan kejahatan. Namun, pemburu iblis yang tampan ini mungkin adalah harapan terbaik untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

items.title: Dexter: Resurrection
items.synopsis: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

items.title: Doc
items.synopsis: Dr. Amy Larsen must navigate an unfamiliar world after a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

items.title: Doctor Price
items.synopsis: Former pediatrician Kanenari Naruki runs a secretive doctor job agency while uncovering his father’s death and exposing the dark side of the medical world.

items.title: Dominion and Devotion
items.synopsis: Dinasti Ning berada di ambang kehancuran. Pei Shenzhi mengubah dekrit wasiat dan mengangkat Ning Jinyi sebagai kaisar. Ning Jinyi berpura-pura patuh sambil diam-diam mengumpulkan kekuatan dan meluncurkan kebijakan baru. Pei Shenzhi, yang tertarik dengan kecerdasannya, mendukungnya secara diam-diam. Akhirnya, dia membersihkan istana dan bangkit menjadi permaisuri yang hebat.

items.title: Don't Call Me Ma'am
items.synopsis: Three 41-year-old friends—a former TV host turned housewife, an art center manager in a strained marriage, and a fashion editor chasing love—navigate the messy mix of career, desire, and identity in midlife.

items.title: DOPE
items.synopsis: Rookie officer Saiki Yuto joins a secret narcotics unit and teams up with his tough instructor to take down a dangerous new drug spreading across Japan.

items.title: Dope Thief
items.synopsis: Dua sahabat karib dalam penipuan Philadelphia sebagai agen DEA untuk merampok pengedar narkoba kelas teri. Itu penipuan sempurna, hingga mereka memilih sasaran yang salah dan menjadi incaran organisasi narkotika besar.

items.title: Double Fugue
items.synopsis: Lukisan adalah senjatanya. Luka masa lalu adalah bahan bakarnya. Demi menyelidiki pembunuhan orang tuanya, sang jenius seni, Lu Li, menyusup ke Grup Silun dan mendekati Qin Yuebai, putri tidak sah pemiliknya. Awalnya saling memanfaatkan, perlahan hubungan mereka berubah. Rahasia demi rahasia terkuak, hingga keduanya saling menyembuhkan luka masing-masing… atau justru menambahkannya?

items.title: Double Happiness
items.synopsis: Mengisahkan pertemuan antara seorang ibu tunggal dan ayah tunggal yang masing-masing memiliki dua anak. Seiring waktu, mereka mulai mengenal satu sama lain dan berusaha menciptakan kehidupan yang lebih hangat bersama. Namun, apakah benar keluarga baru ini bisa lebih dari sekadar gabungan dua orang tua dan dua anak?

items.title: Down Cemetery Road
items.synopsis: Ketika seorang anak menghilang setelah terjadinya ledakan di suatu rumah, seorang tetangga yang cemas bekerja sama dengan detektif swasta untuk mencarinya. Seiring terungkapnya berbagai rahasia dan konspirasi militer, kekacauan melanda suburban Oxford Selatan yang sunyi.

items.title: Dragon King's Decree
items.synopsis: Born into a life of scorn as a lowborn daughter, Feng Zhilou dreams of one day fighting alongside the powerful Dragon Clan. Meanwhile, Crown Prince Chu Moshang rejects a political marriage meant to unite forces against the demon tribe, choosing instead to battle alone. When their paths cross, these two kindred spirits defy expectations and forge a bond through hardship, one strong enough to change the course of destiny itself.

items.title: Drifting Away
items.synopsis: Kisah ini menceritakan seorang Kapten Detektif Peng Zhaolin, yang tetap teguh dalam komitmennya terhadap keadilan. Dalam pengejaran selama satu dekade yang mencakup ribuan mil, ia tanpa henti memerangi kekuatan kegelapan, yang akhirnya membawa pembunuh yang sangat obsesif dan kejam ke pengadilan. Drama ini dibintangi oleh aktor dengan keterampilan akting yang hebat, Guo Jingfei, Wang Qianyuan, dan Zhao Jinmai, serta disutradarai oleh Cao Kai dan ditulis oleh Chen Ping. Drama ini menyoroti keyakinan dan kegigihan polisi rakyat yang tak tergoyahkan, yang mewujudkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan dan kekuatan keadilan yang abadi.

items.title: Duster
items.synopsis: In 1972, the first Black female FBI agent heads to the Southwest and recruits a gutsy getaway driver in a bold effort to take down a growing crime syndicate.

items.title: Dynamite Kiss
items.synopsis: A passionate fling in Jeju ends abruptly — until fate reunites an heir and a young woman when she joins his company, disguised as a married mother.

items.title: Eat Run Love
items.synopsis: Campus golden boy Gan Yang falls for the hardworking Ding Zhitong, who has no time for love until his warmth wins her over. Despite their different backgrounds, their romance flourishes—until Gan Yang secretly shoulders his family’s financial downfall and breaks up with her. Heartbroken and feeling betrayed, Ding Zhitong’s life takes a drastic turn, leaving her with deep resentment. Six years later, their paths cross again in the business world, where she must secure investment from his company. With love and resentment intertwined, can they overcome the past and find their way back to each other?

items.title: Echoes of the Self
items.synopsis: Zhou Ruoxi demi ambisi meninggalkan cinta dengan Pangeran Li Yan dan menikah dengan putra mahkota, namun rencana dan intrik istana berujung pada kematian keduanya. Saat hidupnya kembali ke awal, Zhou Ruoxi bertekad memperbaiki kesalahan dan melindungi Li Yan, hanya untuk menghadapi musuh terbesarnya: dirinya sendiri dari tiga tahun lalu.

items.title: Edward Lee's Country Cook
items.synopsis: Edward Lee and his three friends set out on a culinary journey to find the taste of their grandmother's cooking! They travel around the country, taste seasonal winter ingredients, and reinterpret the recipes of country grandmothers. Will Edward Lee's country cooking be recognized by K-grandmas?

items.title: Electric Bloom
items.synopsis: Follow the three members of a mega-famous pop group, Electric Bloom, as they look back and tell the story of their band and friendship, starting with the day they all met in middle school. The girls go on a journey to becoming the biggest band in the world and the best friends in the universe.

items.title: Emerald Hill - The Little Nyonya Story
items.synopsis: Anya, abducted from wealth, endures life in a brothel. Xinniang, once a child beggar, blossoms into a refined lady. Anna, cast away as a jinx, returns to upend their lives. As secrets unravel, love and kinship are tested—will they rise above fate?

items.title: Endless Protection
items.synopsis: Lin Zhitiao, jaksa penuh empati, bersama asistennya Bai Enyu, membentuk tim perlindungan hukum anak. Mereka menghadapi kasus-kasus kelam yang mengguncang nurani. Mampukah mereka menyelamatkan anak-anak di tengah kelamnya sisi gelap manusia?

items.title: Enigma Black Stage
items.synopsis: When the play “The Bloom and a Thousand Bees” is in being remade, it calls for a serious casting for the lead female role. Now, everyone in showbiz scrambles for and it seems they will do whatever it takes. Thus, the watchful eye of a certain group looms over this audition. What no one knows is that there’s a dangerous secret lurking behind the curtain, and whatever black magic is called upon.

items.title: Ensemble
items.synopsis: Lawyer Sena Koyama, a realist disillusioned by love, teams up with idealistic newcomer Yu Matohara, who believes in love and sincerity. Despite their clashing views, the two grow closer as they navigate love-related cases and debates in court.

items.title: Eternal Joy with You
items.synopsis: Setelah dikhianati suami dan kehilangan anak kandungnya, Xu Wanning terlahir kembali untuk membalas dendam dan melindungi anaknya. Dalam usahanya, ia bertemu Pei Heng, pria yang menyelidiki racun misterius. Tanpa disangka, takdir mereka ternyata sudah terikat sejak kehidupan sebelumnya.

items.title: Everything on the Menu with Braun Strowman
items.synopsis: WWE star Braun Strowman travels America, attempting to eat every item on restaurant menus during his WWE tour stops.

items.title: Extraordinary
items.synopsis: Shi Xiaofan, seorang pria sains yang hidupnya tengah jatuh, tiba-tiba terlempar ke dunia lain dan menjadi Shi Feifan, pewaris kaya yang terkenal sebagai pemboros. Demi melindungi keluarganya, ia berpura-pura tetap menjadi pemuda nakal, namun diam-diam memakai pengetahuan modern untuk meraih kekayaan, membangun kekuatan militer, menyelamatkan banyak pihak, dan menggagalkan berbagai ancaman. Berkat izin dari kaisar, ia akhirnya memimpin penataan pasukan di Barat dan berubah dari “pemuda tak berguna” menjadi sosok penting yang diam-diam memegang kekuatan besar.

items.title: Eye See: Shunkan Kioku Sosa Hiiragi Han
Eyes In The Woods
items.synopsis: The forest watches as two sisters confront personal truths - and what lurks in the dark.

items.title: Eyes of Wakanda
items.synopsis: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

items.title: Faith & Fire
items.synopsis: A former national security agent, haunted by his comrade’s death, retreats into a quiet life as a fish vendor. But when duty calls, he goes undercover in a Taiwanese gang to expose a smuggling network, only to find himself caught between violent turf wars and the high-stakes dangers of espionage.

items.title: Fall in You
items.synopsis: Qiao Yan, menjadi yatim piatu setelah kecelakaan tragis orang tuanya, kembali ke keluarga Gu untuk mencari kebenaran dan beradu taktik dengan paman angkatnya, Gu Jingyuan. Dalam perjalanan itu, mereka jatuh cinta meski menghadapi konspirasi dan rintangan, saling melindungi satu sama lain dalam kisah cinta terlarang penuh ketegangan dan emosi.

items.title: Fancy Land
items.synopsis: Dua pembunuhan aneh mengguncang sebuah kota pesisir yang tenang, menghancurkan kehidupan damai seorang ibu tunggal, Li Xiulan, dan putrinya, Li Yan, ketika polisi datang mengetuk pintu mereka...

items.title: Fated Hearts
items.synopsis: After losing her memory in battle, skilled archer Fu Yixiao is taken in by a noble family and unexpectedly reunited with her former enemy, Prince Feng Suige—the man she once struck with an arrow. As they face the dangers of Yujing together, trust replaces suspicion and a deep bond begins to form. Caught in a web of past betrayals and political intrigue, the two must confront their shared history while fighting for survival, freedom, and each other.

items.title: Feud
items.synopsis: Menceritakan tentang Empat Roh Suci Li Qingyue dan Master Agung Bai Jiusi, yang terlibat dalam hubungan cinta-benci, hingga akhirnya menyelesaikan kesalahpahaman dan bersama-sama mengatasi malapetaka untuk menyelamatkan rakyat.

items.title: Film Club
items.synopsis: Friday night. 7pm. Film Club Week 198. Evie hasn't left the house in six months after a 'wobble', and Film Club is her escape. A weekly chance to create a world of wonder, deck the garage out in whatever the movie calls for and spend a few uninterrupted hours with Noa - her best friend and one of the few mates who still shows up. But tonight, things are different. Noa's got big news. A dream job is taking him across the other side of the country, which means that all of this is ending.

items.title: Filter
items.synopsis: Sebuah produk teknologi-super memberikan Su Cheng Cheng kemampuan untuk mengubah penampilannya. Tang Qi, yang memiliki hubungan dengan Su Cheng Cheng, mengungkap kebenaran tentang identitasnya yang berubah. Keduanya harus menghadapi situasi ini bersama-sama.

items.title: Final Draft
items.synopsis: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?

items.title: First Dates Beach Club
items.synopsis: First Dates takes its matchmaking magic to Spain and a stunning beachside setting for cocktails and flirting by the pool.

items.title: First Lady
items.synopsis: Just two months before the president-elect is sworn in, he demands a divorce from his wife – but she dreamed of becoming the first lady.

items.title: Flower Sea
items.synopsis: Suatu pagi, Chen Jing'an dan Zhu Niannian bangun dan menyadari jiwa mereka tertukar. Chen Jing'an kini jadi “putri konglomerat”, sementara Zhu Niannian menjadi “adik perempuan” dari pria yang diam-diam ia sukai. Bersama Chen Changning, mereka pun mulai menyelidiki penyebab pertukaran tubuh ini. Namun tanpa mereka sadari saat semakin dalam mencari tahu, situasinya malah semakin rumit!

items.title: Flying Up Without Disturb
items.synopsis: Kong Hou, seorang putri yang tak sengaja masuk ke dunia para dewa dan menjadi pusat perhatian semua orang. Dari guru hingga murid, semua memanjakannya. Ingin membuktikan dirinya, ia turun gunung dan bertemu Huan Zong, pria lemah lembut yang menyimpan rahasia besar. Siapa sangka, pertemuan itu justru membuka jalan menuju cinta dan kekuatan…

items.title: Forest
items.synopsis: Kaede Ikushima and Jun Ichinose, a couple living together for nearly a year, appear happy but hide lies from each other. Their seemingly perfect life unravels, leading to a dramatic transformation.

items.title: Forget You Not
items.synopsis: An aspiring stand-up comedian turns her struggles into heartfelt humor as she balances work and relationships while caring for her aging father.

items.title: Fortnite x the Simpsons
items.synopsis: Springfield and Fortnite universes converge. Chaos ensues as Homer sets out to transform the world, wielding a powerful alien energy.

items.title: Fortune Awaits
items.synopsis: He Fang, a struggling pig farm owner, and Jin Xiao, a privileged billionaire heir, who accidentally swap lives. He Fang must navigate the luxurious world of wealth, while Jin Xiao is forced to manage the farm. Both men face new challenges as they adapt to their drastically different worlds.

items.title: Fragrance of the Pomegranates
items.synopsis: Ming Liang, lulusan akademi seni, terpaksa menunda impiannya melanjutkan studi karena ibu angkatnya jatuh sakit. Ia pun mengambil alih “Restoran Delima Merah” dan berjuang mengatasi berbagai tantangan untuk menjadikannya restoran berkualitas. Sambil menyalurkan semangat seni dalam setiap hidangan, Ming Liang pun tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang lebih matang. Di tengah perjuangannya itu, ia bertemu kembali dengan teman masa kecilnya, Gulinar, sosok mandiri dan tegas yang perlahan membuka kembali hatinya.

items.title: From Rock Star to Killer
items.synopsis: Pada 2003, Bertrand Cantat si penyanyi rock membunuh pasangannya, aktris bernama Marie Trintignant. Dokumenter ini mengulas lagi kasus yang memecah belah sebuah negara.

items.title: Gadis Masa
items.synopsis: Using a time-traveling umbrella, Maya goes back to the past to save her marriage, but fate has its own plan.

items.title: Games of Two Halves
items.synopsis: When a scam leaves Keung bankrupt, he becomes a taxi driver to support his family. As his wife turns to fraud and his son chases risky ideas to recover their losses, the family must adapt and hustle to reclaim the life they once had.

items.title: Garnachas: Glorious Street Food!
items.synopsis: A flavorful exploration of Mexico's street food scene, where the beloved garnacha takes center stage, sparks debates and unites fans with every bite.

items.title: GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops
items.synopsis:
Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo are back with a hilarious new spin-off of the beloved “GBRB” series!

GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops,” which will follow the trio as they set off on a whirlwind trip to Mexico in search of fresh perspectives and experiences.

The program is a spinoff of “GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria Operation,” where the KKPP Food employees successfully completed their missions and earned the chance to go abroad for an insight trip to help the company grow. It also marks the second spinoff of “GBRB: Reap What You Sow.”

items.title: Genie, Make a Wish
items.synopsis: Setelah seribu tahun, jin unik kembali untuk mengabulkan permintaan wanita yang lahir tanpa perasaan. Bisakah sihirnya menghadirkan cinta dan keajaiban bagi wanita itu?

items.title: Glass Heart
items.synopsis: An aspiring drummer suddenly loses her spot in the band. But when a brilliant musician recruits her for his new band, her life takes a passionate turn.

items.title: Glory
items.synopsis: After being framed in an old murder case, rising magistrate Lu Jianglai loses everything. Rescued by tea magnate’s daughter Rong Shanbao, he is forced into servitude as part of her revenge. As they navigate power struggles and hidden agendas, they uncover secrets, solve mysteries, and transform the tea trade—ultimately forging an unexpected bond that changes their fates.

items.title: Go Up Against the Immortals
items.synopsis: Chen Yuanqi, pemuda miskin yang dikhianati kekasihnya hingga nyaris tewas, terbangun dengan kekuatan ilahi. Ia bersumpah menentang takdir dan menapaki jalan balas dendam. Bersama putri suci yang dingin, ratu iblis memesona, dan gadis roh lincah, ia menghancurkan bangsawan, membasmi sekte iblis, bahkan menantang langit demi membebaskan umat manusia dari belenggu nasib.

items.title: Gold & Greed: The Hunt for Fenn's Treasure
items.synopsis: Forrest Fenn, pria yang eksentrik, memulai perburuan harta karun sungguhan dengan menyembunyikan peti emas di Pegunungan Rocky dan menaruh petunjuk dalam puisi misterius.

items.title: Golden Oldies
items.synopsis: After escaping a troubled past, Sou begins a new life as an administrative manager at a senior care facility, only to discover the residents hold the real power. As he navigates the quirky personalities and tensions within the staff, he must fight to protect his newfound life.

items.title: Golden Scenery of Tomorrow
items.synopsis: Though very different, simple wallflower Via and the charming Arkin have been best friends since they were kids. But when that friendship turns into love, will it be strong enough to keep them together through Arkin’s fame that’s bound to lead them to very different roads?

items.title: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
items.synopsis: Serial kriminal nyata yang menegangkan ini menilik perburuan pembunuh berantai di Long Island dari sudut pandang para korban, orang-orang tercinta mereka, dan polisi.

items.title: Good American Family
items.synopsis: A Midwestern couple adopts who they believe to be a little girl with dwarfism, but gradually start to believe she may not be who she says she is.

items.title: Good Boy
items.synopsis: Setelah 11 tahun, Kepolisian kembali melakukan perekrutan khusus mantan atlet nasional. Dahulu dianggap pahlawan, para peraih medali kelas dunia ini kini menatap kenyataan pahit. Di tengah kesulitan keuangan, tragedi tak terduga, dan diskriminasi dalam kepolisian, para atlet yang kisahnya beragam ini bersatu dalam satgas khusus yang menangani kejahatan besar dengan keberanian dan kepiawaian atlet.

items.title: Good Day
items.synopsis: A music project program where G-Dragon completes the song of the year with people from various fields.

items.title: Gorgeous Dream
items.synopsis: Setelah dipenjara empat tahun dan dicap tidak suci, Shen Wanqing dibunuh demi nama baik keluarga Liu. Ia terlahir kembali sebagai Lan Mengyan dan masuk ke keluarga itu lewat pernikahan, menggunakan pesonanya untuk memikat ayah dan anak Liu demi membalaskan dendam. Saat bahaya mulai mengancamnya, Qin Moxiu yang selalu mengawasinya diam-diam akhirnya turun tangan.

items.title: Got to Get Out
items.synopsis: Participants living in a mansion for 10 days vie for a cash prize that increases by $1 each second they’re in the game. As contestants compete in physical and mental challenges, more money will be added to “the pot,” with up to $1 million at stake.

items.title: Government Cheese
items.synopsis: Saat Hampton dibebaskan dari penjara, reuni keluarga yang telah lama dinantikannya tak berjalan sesuai harapan. Selama ketidakhadirannya, istri dan putra Hampton menjadi keluarga yang tak lazim, dan kepulangannya mengacaukan kehidupan mereka.

items.title: Grosse Pointe Garden Society
items.synopsis: When four members of a suburban garden club get entangled in a scandalous murder, they're forced to bury the body – in their own well-manicured flower beds. In this juicy drama everyone's got dirt… but some secrets never stay buried.

items.title: Had I Not Seen the Sun
items.synopsis: Filmmaker Zhou Pin-yu interviews a serial killer in prison — an encounter that triggers a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.

items.title: Hanging Mirrors
items.synopsis: Sebuah kasus mutilasi mempertemukan dua polisi dengan gaya bertolak belakang: Xu Xiao yang berpengalaman dan Lin Guoqiang yang muda dan impulsif. Saat menyelidiki, mereka menemukan ritual kuno demi keabadian... tapi siapa sangka dalangnya adalah sosok yang paling tak terduga?

items.title: Happy Face
items.synopsis: The story of Melissa Reed, daughter of Keith Jesperson, aka the Happy Face Killer. After decades of no contact, Keith forces his way back into his daughter’s life, and Melissa must find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime her father committed. In the process, she must face a reckoning of her own identity.

items.title: Haunted Hotel
items.synopsis: Setelah mewarisi hotel mendiang abangnya, seorang ibu tunggal pindah ke sana bersama hantu abangnya yang baik hati—dan para tamu ribet yang tidak akan pernah mau pergi.

items.title: He Kills It
items.synopsis: Wu Ming, ahli pengobatan tradisional, turun gunung untuk menyelamatkan tunangannya. Tanpa sengaja, ia bertemu bos besar yang sedang sakit parah dan butuh tabib dengan imbalan besar. Perjalanannya penuh tantangan, kesempatan, dan godaan dari banyak wanita. Wu Ming harus memilih jalan hidupnya.

items.title: Head Over Heels
items.synopsis: Seong-A seorang murid saat siang dan dukun saat malam. Meski diremehkan karena melihat dan berurusan dengan hantu, dia tetap tersenyum dan gigih. Dia terbiasa menjadi berbeda. Gyeon-U yang tampan, rentan bak api lilin diterpa angin dan dibayangi kesialan. Seong-A bersumpah akan melindunginya sejak dia datang ke kuil dalam posisi terbalik. Ini kisah cinta pertama - dan bukti kekuatan cinta.

items.title: Heavenly Ever After
items.synopsis: After life's ups and downs, a loving couple separated by death reunites in heaven — only to discover he's in his thirties while she's in her eighties.

items.title: Heavenly Secrets Bureau
items.synopsis: Seorang pemuda mengikuti petunjuk dari catatan ayahnya dan bekerja sama dengan Putri Kesembilan yang pandai mengobati. Mereka menyelidiki kejadian aneh seperti kutukan, petir gaib, dan bencana alam. Semua petunjuk mengarah pada ramalan kitab langit tentang “Dua Ikan” yang bisa membawa kehancuran negeri.

items.title: Heesu in Class 2
items.synopsis: Hee-su hides his love for his best friend—until that friend falls for someone else, and silence starts to hurt.

items.title: Hell Motel
items.synopsis: A group of ten true crime obsessives are invited to the opening weekend of the newly renovated Cold River Motel, the site of a 30-year-old unsolved satanic mass murder. History repeats itself when the guests get stranded and start getting knocked off one by one during a murder spree that grows exponentially more gruesome than the original with each kill.

items.title: Heo's Diner
items.synopsis: The story follows a character from the Joseon Dynasty who travel 400 years into the future to the modern era and unwittingly open a restaurant, leading to a series of comedic and chaotic events.

items.title: HER
items.synopsis: Petinju jenius Liu Yan kehilangan kariernya karena menolak rekayasa pertandingan. Di saat bersamaan, kabar kematian sang ibu datang dari luar negeri. Saat ia datang untuk mengurus warisan, yang ia temukan justru utang besar dan adik tiri yang harus diasuh. Tapi benarkah ibunya sudah tiada…?

items.title: Her Feast
items.synopsis: Dijebak dan disiksa hingga tewas, Zhang Wange terbangun kembali ke 3 tahun di masa lalu. Dengan ingatan masa lalunya, ia mendekati Kapten Lu Ye yang mimpi-mimpinya menawarkan petunjuk misterius, demi mengungkap kebenaran. Ketika semua ilusi sirna, Lu Ye dihadapkan pada kebenaran yang menghancurkan. Dalam mimpi, satu peluru menembus dua hati, membuat satu terjebak di masa lalu sementara yang lain melangkah menuju masa depan.

items.title: Her Phoenix Majesty
items.synopsis: Xie Yuan terseret ke dalam kerajaan yang dipimpin wanita dan dipaksa menjadi suami Putri Sulung karena ketampanannya. Saat mencoba melarikan diri, ia dibantu oleh Putri Kedua yang tampak baik, namun ternyata justru membawanya ke dalam intrik berbahaya di istana.

items.title: Her Trajecting
items.synopsis: Shu Yan, seorang wanita muda yang selalu mengutamakan orang lain daripada dirinya sendiri, sampai di titik terendah setelah kehilangan keluarga dan kariernya. Ia menghadapi serangkaian perubahan, tetapi saat ia kembali bangkit, ia mulai meyakinkan dirinya dan memulai hidup baru. Melalui perjalanan transformatif ini, ia menemukan cinta sejati dengan Shen Weizhou.

items.title: Hidden Master
items.synopsis: Lahir dengan wajah menyeramkan tapi berhati mulia, Gou Lingfeng bermimpi jadi pendekar. Namun, tanpa sengaja ia malah mempelajari ilmu sesat dan terjerumus ke dunia persilatan. Di tengah prasangka dan segala aral rintangan, mampukah ia membuktikan dirinya sebegai seorang pendekar sejati?

items.title: Hide & Sis
items.synopsis: When Chatfah, the youngest daughter of the wealthy Buppajinda family, mysteriously falls from a vacation home and vanishes just before her wedding, her three older sisters become the prime suspects. As suspicion and tragedy mount, the sisters return to their childhood mansion to uncover the truth behind Chatfah’s disappearance—even if it means confronting the possibility that one of them is responsible.

items.title: Hide Games
items.synopsis: Follows the investigation into the murder of an anti-narcotics officer, exploring the darker and lighter sides of human nature.

items.title: Higher
items.synopsis: Instruktur Jiang Zhen menyamar ke Zijing Group demi mengungkap kecelakaan mobil tanpa pengemudi yang menewaskan adiknya. Ia dipertemukan kembali dengan mantan rekan yang kini jadi musuh, Bai Fan. Bersama Nong Qianya, mereka membongkar konspirasi dan menggagalkan rencana jahat ketua Zijing Group.

items.title: His Chosen Favor
items.synopsis: Lulusan baru Lu Zhener terjebak ke dalam sebuah cerita sebagai selir korban pemakaman hidup. Tanpa diduga, ia menemukan bahwa Kaisar Xiao Wenjing ternyata berasal dari kampung halaman yang sama dengannya. Dihadapkan pada takdir berbahaya yang telah ditentukan, ia menolak menyerah dan bersumpah untuk melawan nasib. Namun, tanpa ia sadari, justru Xiao Wenjing lah yang memegang pena atas jalan hidupnya…

items.title: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator
