items.synopsis: For the first time ever, experts identify Hitler’s DNA. What do his genes reveal about Hitler's heritage and origins, his neurology and drives?

items.title: Holy Light
items.synopsis: Intellectual Yi Gaoyuan and Tibetan girl Gesang Meiduo fall in love while studying at Tibet’s first modern school, against the backdrop of Tibet’s peaceful liberation and the region’s transformative journey into a new era.

items.title: Homeland Guardian
items.synopsis: Ho Hofai, polisi legendaris Hong Kong yang terjebak dalam perangkap gangster saat menyelamatkan mentornya, membuatnya jatuh dari puncak karier dan menjadi aib kepolisian. Setelah bergabung dengan Unit Darurat, ia bersama timnya berjuang di garis depan, mengungkap dalang kejahatan besar yang mengancam Hong Kong. Lewat berbagai rintangan, mereka berhasil menggagalkan konspirasi kekuatan asing yang ingin merusak sistem keuangan dan menggoyahkan "satu negara, dua sistem".

items.title: Hook Bait
items.synopsis: Cheng Yu, trapped as a canary under Zhou Jin's control, seeks to break free. During a staged cheating incident, she encounters male model Pei Zheng. She teases him, offering chances to play the hero, while he gradually goes from indifferent to taking charge. Initially, they both use each other for their own purposes, but over time, their feelings become genuine.

items.title: Hostage
items.synopsis: Ketika suami perdana menteri Inggris diculik dan presiden Prancis mulai menerima berbagai ancaman, kedua kepala negara itu harus menghadapi pilihan yang pelik.

items.title: Hotel Costiera
items.synopsis: Shortly after Daniel, or DD as everybody knows him, starts working at the hotel, one of the owner’s daughters disappears. He must do whatever it takes to find her and bring her home while still solving the ever-changing problems of the exclusive hotel guests.

items.title: House of David
items.synopsis: House of David Musim Satu menuturkan kisah tentang kebangkitan tokoh Alkitab, Daud, yang akhirnya menjadi raja Israel paling terkenal. Raja Saul yang pernah berjaya menjadi korban kesombongannya sendiri. Atas firman Tuhan, nabi Samuel mengurapi seorang remaja buangan sebagai raja baru. Ketika seorang pemimpin tumbang, bangkitlah pemimpin baru.

items.title: House of Guinness
items.synopsis: Dublin, 1868. Kepala keluarga Guinness meninggal dunia, dan keempat anaknya—masing-masing punya rahasia kelam yang tersimpan—mewarisi nasib pabrik bir di tangan mereka.

items.title: How to Cheat Death
items.synopsis: Two people struck by lightning at the same time gain the ability to see the future and use their gift to help people cheat death.

items.title: Humraaz
items.synopsis: A tragic event intertwines the lives of Sara, Ahmer, and Saim. When Saim becomes victim of an incident, he suspects Sara's involvement despite her denials. Their paths merge as they face truths and seek answers.

items.title: Hunter with a Scalpel
items.synopsis: A prominent female forensic investigator suffers from antisocial personality disorder and the process in which the shadow of the father she killed threatens her honor and life.

items.title: Hunting
items.synopsis: After a large-scale police crackdown, narcotics officer Yang Yipeng seizes a critical lead with captured but defiant ringleader Mou Haidong. Alongside rookie officer Zhi An and informant Duo Zai, Yang follows a trail back to Mou Sen’s new synthetic drug operation, uncovering a complex web of drug networks. But as they delve deeper, the true mastermind remains elusive, hidden behind layers of secrecy

items.title: Hyper Knife
items.synopsis: Seok, an eager yet genius neurosurgeon is reunited with Deokhee, the professor who ruined her life long ago. Once, the two surgeons cared for each other more than anyone else. But now with nothing but hatred toward each other, Seok is furious that he is back in her life and vows to take revenge.

items.title: I am a Running Mate
items.synopsis: The story of model student Se-hoon, who goes to the student council elections as a running mate to renew his image, and gradually becomes the core of the election.

items.title: I Am Boxer
items.synopsis: Don Lee's extreme boxing survival. Who will survive to be the champion standing in the ring?

items.title: I Am Married...But!
items.synopsis: Setelah pertemuan manis yang berujung pada romansa penuh liku, pasangan ini harus menjalani pahitnya realitas pernikahan, yang jauh berbeda dengan kalimat akhir dongeng.

items.title: I Love Filipino
items.synopsis: Embark on a journey to celebrate all things Filipino — from art and architecture to culture and cuisine — in this immersive series.

items.title: I Love LA
items.synopsis: Sekelompok teman yang ambisius menjalani kehidupan dan cinta di LA.

items.title: I'm Nobody
items.synopsis: After losing his memory in an accident, martial arts heir Ye Wuming works as a driver until fate pairs him with top actress Song Yiran. As her bodyguard, he helps fight off powerful enemies and gradually uncovers the truth behind his forgotten past.

items.title: I, Kill
items.synopsis: Set in 1635, 35 years after the Battle of Sekigahara, Japan appears peaceful. But a monstrous creature called 'Gun-kyo' that devours humans disrupts this calm. The shogunate burns down villages where Gun-kyo appears to hide the truth. Orin, a former ninja living quietly with her stepdaughter, is drawn back into battle after encountering Gun-kyo while seeking medicine. Meanwhile, Shiro, a Gun-kyo who retains human consciousness, sets out to uncover his origins and the creature's secret.

items.title: Idol I
items.synopsis: Maeng Se-na, a top star criminal lawyer who has been a fangirl for fifteen years, tries to prove her favorite idol’s innocence, who is suspected of murder.

items.title: In the Name of Justice
items.synopsis: In Haidong Province, prosecutors uncover a false accusation against Zhang Wenqing while reviewing the “Wan Group Gang Case,” exposing deep corruption among judicial officials. Using a whistle-blower tip as their entry point, the team dismantles the criminal network and brings the corrupt officials behind it to justice.

items.title: In The Name of Loyalty
items.synopsis: Seorang pembunuh bayaran ulung bernama Cheng Ge menyamar sebagai pelayan sederhana untuk Kaisar Shi Yu demi menjalankan misi paling mematikan dalam hidupnya. Namun, saat ia terjerat dalam perebutan kekuasaan istana yang mematikan dan rahasia masa lalu yang kelam, rencananya mulai berantakan. Kini, sang pemburu yang terperangkap dalam permainannya sendiri harus membuat pilihan terakhir: menyerang atau melindungi.

items.title: Inside: USA
items.synopsis: Para kreator konten membuat rencana, menyabotase, dan menguras uang di tantangan liar demi meraup hingga $1 juta di serial Amerika pertama grup YouTube Inggris, Sidemen.

items.title: Islanders
items.synopsis: A wealthy entrepreneur's tangled love life with his wife, mistress, and girlfriend spans four decades and generations. But when a social media scandal costs him everything, their true values and worldviews are put to the test.

items.title: It: Welcome to Derry
items.synopsis: Pada tahun 1962, sepasang suami istri beserta putra mereka pindah ke Derry, Maine, tepat saat seorang anak laki-laki menghilang. Sejak kedatangan mereka, hal-hal buruk mulai terjadi di kota tersebut.

items.title: Jasmine
items.synopsis: Yasemin is a young woman battling a fatal heart condition, with her obsessive stepbrother Tufan as her only support. Her struggle to make it onto the transplant list draws them into dark networks and morally fraught choices.

items.title: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
items.synopsis: Dokumenter mencengangkan ini menguak kejadian di balik layar talk show paling kontroversial di Amerika dan mengungkap skandal terbesarnya—di depan dan di belakang kamera.

items.title: Juan Gabriel: I Must, I Can, I Will
items.synopsis: Video langka dan wawancara eksklusif menguak kegeniusan, pengorbanan, dan dualitas antara kehidupan publik dan pribadi sang penyanyi-penulis lagu ikonik, Juan Gabriel.

items.title: Just a bit Espers
items.synopsis: A down-and-out salaryman, fired and divorced, lands a bizarre job requiring him to fake a marriage with a stranger to save the world.

items.title: Just Wanna Be with You
items.synopsis: Dewi Cangyun Jiang Zhiyu dan siluman rakun Jiang Jinghuai saling jatuh cinta, tetapi karena perbedaan, mereka ditentang oleh pemimpin suku Cangyun Nangong Xiao, yang memasang jebakan agar cinta mereka berubah menjadi kebencian. Namun seiring berjalannya waktu, mereka perlahan-lahan mengetahui kebenarannya. Cinta sejati di antara mereka akhirnya muncul kembali?

items.title: Justice is Mine
items.synopsis: Upright and incorruptible Judge Chun Yue is forced to cover up the truth after his son causes a hit-and-run that injures the son of a notorious gang leader. Seeking vengeance for his son's injuries, the ruthless crime boss unleashes a wave of bloodshed across the city. Meanwhile, determined police officer Tong Huen remains resolute in her pursuit of justice, relentlessly chasing the truth behind the web of corruption and revenge.

items.title: Justifiable Defense
items.synopsis: Duan Hongshan, jaksa senior di Kejaksaan Kota, menangani kasus seorang perempuan yang membunuh suaminya setelah mengalami kekerasan dalam rumah tangga. Untuk membantu penyelidikan, jaksa muda Fang Lingyuan dari Kejaksaan Provinsi ditugaskan mendampingi. Dalam proses penyidikan, keduanya menemukan bahwa kasus ini berkaitan erat dengan kasus "pembelaan diri berlebihan di lingkungan sekolah" yang pernah ditangani Duan Hongshan empat belas tahun silam, melibatkan Li Mufeng, Mei Zheng, dan Jiang Ting. Berlandaskan fakta dan hukum, mereka bersama-sama menimbang keadilan, kemanusiaan, dan aturan negara, hingga akhirnya berhasil memberikan klasifikasi hukum yang tepat atas kasus tersebut.

items.title: Kaarzar-e-Dua
items.synopsis:
Kaarzar-e-Dua is a timeless love story about two people who are deeply in love but are torn apart by conspiracies and unexpected twists of fate. Despite everything, their love stays strong and keeps pulling them back to each other.

Raazi is a kind and sincere young man who lives with his uncle and aunt. Their daughter, Tanno, is deeply in love with him and dreams of spending her life by his side. Although they are already married, the family is waiting for Raazi to become financially stable before holding the final wedding ceremony.

items.title: Kaseifu Kuromi wa kusatta kazoku wo yurusanai
Keeping Up with Beauty
items.synopsis: Karena sebuah janji ribuan tahun lalu, seorang jenderal wanita bereinkarnasi menjadi istri muda dari keluarga kaya, Fu Yunyun. Untuk membersihkan namanya, ia berpura-pura lembut di depan suami CEO-nya yang dingin, sambil menghadapi adik ipar licik dan prajurit setianya yang ikut melintasi waktu. Di tengah perebutan cinta dan intrik keluarga, ia berjuang menemukan kebenaran dan cinta sejatinya.

items.title: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
items.synopsis: Ketika melawan Bagha dan para kaki tangannya yang ditakuti di Kolkata, Arjun Maitra si polisi jujur harus memerangi sistem yang buruk dan menghadapi perang geng berdarah.

items.title: Khauf
items.synopsis: Madhu pindah ke asrama di Delhi untuk memulai hidup baru, tetapi kamarnya menyembunyikan sosok menyeramkan yang makin hari makin kuat, membuat wanita lain di lantainya khawatir. Mereka tahu yang disembunyikan kamar itu dan sangat ingin Madhu pergi sebelum terlambat bagi mereka semua.

items.title: Kian's Bizarre B&B
items.synopsis: On a remote island, Kian84 hosts a quirky B&B escape, where BTS' Jin and Ji Ye-eun lead guests through playful exploits and delightful chaos.

items.title: Kill Lover
items.synopsis: Youyou kehilangan ibu dan ayah karena An Guoxuan. Ia tanpa sengaja membuat Qi Dong buta, lalu diselamatkan dan dibawa ke luar negeri. Qi Dong bangkit dan mendirikan perusahaan untuk melawan An Guoxuan. Kembali sebagai arsitek ternama, Youyou mendekati Qi Dong untuk balas dendam, namun keduanya menyadari musuh yang sama. Bersatu, mereka melawan An Guoxuan, namun ancaman lebih besar mengintai.

items.title: Kill Lupercal
items.synopsis: Set in the siege of Terra itself, Kill Lupercal follows a Warlord Titan and its crew as they seek to end the war for the Throneworld in a single devastating blow.

items.title: Kill to Love
items.synopsis: A Southern prince and a Northern assassin, bound since childhood, struggle with love and betrayal as political intrigue threatens to tear them apart.

items.title: Kimora: Back in the Fab Lane
items.synopsis: Kimora Lee Simmons, the single mom of five, who runs the Baby Phat brand, will be dealing with the whims of her model daughters, cheering at her sons’ championship games and celebrating her own major milestones.

items.title: King & Conqueror
items.synopsis: Harold of Wessex and William of Normandy are two men destined to face each other at the Battle of Hastings in 1066. Two former allies, neither of whom had aspired to the British throne, are forced, by circumstances and their personal obsession, to wage war over possession of the crown.

items.title: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
items.synopsis: Rasakan suka dan duka ketika para koki terbaik dunia mengejar penghargaan tertinggi: Bintang Michelin. Para inspektur anonim ini tidak pernah memberitahukan metode misterius mereka, hingga sekarang.

items.title: Koisuru Caster
items.synopsis: An assistant director at a news station faces the challenges of pursuing his dream of becoming a reporter while navigating personal growth, work struggles, and moments of romance with his colleagues.

items.title: Lambaian Huda
items.synopsis: Haunted by her past, a nightclub singer begins to rediscover her worth and faith through an unexpected bond with a devout new neighbour.

items.title: Last Samurai Standing
items.synopsis: Di awal era Meiji, Shujiro—yang dulu dikenal sebagai samurai tak terkalahkan—nekat mengikuti permainan bertahan hidup yang mematikan demi keluarga dan para penduduk desa.

items.title: Last Summer
items.synopsis: Every summer reunion between twin brothers and their neighbor blossoms into unspoken love, until adulthood and a past tragedy change their lives forever.

items.title: Law and the City
items.synopsis: Story of a lawyer who is known for his good appearance and straightforward personality and is working with Gyeongmin Law Firm for 9 years.

items.title: Leanne
items.synopsis: Saat sang suami meninggalkannya demi wanita lain, seorang ibu tangguh dari Selatan memulai lembaran baru dengan dukungan keluarga yang penuh kasih, tetapi blak-blakan.

items.title: Leap Day
items.synopsis: Two young men born on February 29 try to uncover the secret behind their leap year birthday curse before they lose people close to them.

items.title: Learning to Love
items.synopsis: This romance follows two unlikely souls bridging vast differences through secret lessons. A strict high school teacher, raised in a rigid household, begins tutoring a kind-hearted but illiterate nightclub host. As their bond deepens, societal judgment, jealousy, and prejudice threaten their forbidden connection.

items.title: Legacy of the Storm
items.synopsis: Set in the early Ming Dynasty, martial arts factions battle to claim the Four Sacred Artifacts. Hero Gao Lingfeng, while uncovering the truth about his past and a city's destruction, teams up with Sun Chenxi. Together, they thwart a conspiracy, recover one of the artifacts, and take on the mission to find the remaining ones to protect the world.

items.title: Legal Boy
items.synopsis: Migrant worker Li Gouwa suddenly finds himself in the world of the wealthy, seeking justice for his brother. What begins as revenge becomes a deadly conspiracy that sparks a fierce battle for the Dongcan Group inheritance. As an unlikely underdog, Li navigates the treacherous power struggle, ultimately toppling the corrupt system and uncovering the truth behind the plot.

items.title: Legend of the Female General
items.synopsis: Seorang jenderal wanita dengan penampilan lembut namun memiliki semangat yang kuat di dalam, bertemu seorang jenderal pria dengan sikap dingin tetapi memiliki kemampuan bertarung yang lebih kuat. Keduanya bergabung untuk melawan kezaliman, membantu yang lemah, dan menghancurkan ancaman.

items.title: Legend of Zang Hai
items.synopsis: "Legend of Zang Hai" follows the son of Imperial Astronomer Kuai Duo. Consumed by vengeance, he spends a decade honing his skills. Assuming the name Zang Hai, he ventures into the capital to uncover the truth, avenge his family, and restore justice.

items.title: Les Belles
items.synopsis: Luo Lingyu, a fallen noblewoman, travels to Yuezhou with her sister to seek refuge. On the way, she rescues a destitute man but later forces him to jump overboard due to societal norms. Unaware that the Lu family's third young master is the man she pushed into the water, she tries to win his favor—only to be repeatedly thwarted. He watches her struggle, exposing her every move, yet when she turns to someone else, he refuses to let her go!

items.title: Lies Never Lie
items.synopsis: Psychological expert Li Mochou joins the Baizhou Police Department, enhancing criminal team leader Ding Wei’s investigative skills. Together, they solve a series of bizarre cases and uncover the long-hidden truth behind a major crime.

items.title: Life Is a Choice
items.synopsis: Gu Nian gets a chance to rewrite her past through a high-tech life reboot. She’s shocked to wake up in the body of a strange man. As she faces her younger self from seven years ago, Gu Nian must navigate life in her new form and guide her past self through a series of life-changing decisions.

items.title: Life Like
items.synopsis: Menyamar sebagai penyanyi terkenal, pembunuh bernama Zhen Xu bertemu Zhou Musheng, anggota kamar dagang yang punya misi rahasia. Awalnya saling memanfaatkan, mereka justru jatuh cinta dan bersama-sama melawan kejahatan untuk memulai hidup baru.

items.title: Light Beyond the Reed
items.synopsis: Ye Sibei terus mengalah pada orang tuanya yang pilih kasih, hingga suaminya Qin Nan tak tahan dan minta cerai. Namun saat Ye Sibei mengalami kejadian tragis, Qin Nan kembali mendukungnya mencari keadilan. Mampukah mereka bangkit dan menata hidup dari awal?

items.title: Live or Love?
items.synopsis: Rivals Fang Li and An Hang accidentally get trapped in a virtual world, becoming a married couple. With opposing system missions, they must defeat each other to return to reality. As they battle it out, they start to fall for each other. Can they rewrite the system's rules and find a way out?

items.title: Lock Her
items.synopsis: Untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik tuduhan palsu ayahnya, ia berhadapan dengan dua saudara: Sheng, yang beralih dari obsesi kejam menjadi cinta; dan Dai Shiyao, yang kecurigaannya berubah menjadi gairah. Saat perang berkobar, mereka menentang takdir: Sheng memilih cinta, Dai Shiyao mengorbankan cinta demi tugas, dan Qin Shiyue menemukan kebenaran di tengah pertumpahan darah.

items.title: Lockerbie: A Search for Truth
items.synopsis: Dr Jim Swire tragically loses his daughter when Pan Am Flight 103 exploded over a small town on 21 December 1988. Travelling across continents and political divides, Swire embarks on a relentless journey that not only jeopardises his stability, family and life, but completely overturns his trust in the justice system. As the truth shifts under his feet, Swire's view of the world is left forever sullied.

items.title: Long Planned Love
items.synopsis: Dikhianati oleh tunangannya, Jian Cheng memutus pertunangan dan secara impulsif menikah kilat dengan paman sang mantan. Pernikahan yang awalnya hanya demi membalas budi perlahan berubah menjadi cinta sejati, di tengah konflik keluarga dan rahasia kelam masa lalu. Di bawah perlindungan Zhou Tingyan, Jian Cheng tumbuh dari gadis manja menjadi wanita mandiri, sementara cinta yang lama terpendam akhirnya menemukan jalannya.

items.title: Long Story Short
items.synopsis: Kreator "BoJack Horseman" mempersembahkan komedi animasi tentang sebuah keluarga yang mengisahkan hidup kakak-beradik dari masa kecil hingga dewasa, dan kembali lagi.

items.title: Long Way Home
items.synopsis: Dua sahabat Ewan McGregor dan Charley Boorman bersiap untuk seri Long Way keempat mereka, kali ini berangkat dari rumah Ewan di Skotlandia ke rumah Charley di Inggris. Tentu, mereka mengambil rute pemandangan, melalui 17 negara Eropa dengan motor tua yang penggerutu.

items.title: Love Again
items.synopsis: After his wife’s death, retired professor Shen Zhuoran reluctantly returns to dating. He meets four very different women: a compassionate nurse, a brilliant but ill scientist, a strong-willed union leader, and a woman who reminds him of his late wife. Through these encounters, he faces love, loss, and personal growth, ultimately transforming his perspective on life and deeply affecting his family.

items.title: Love and Strife
items.synopsis: After her family is massacred, General’s daughter Xu Chuyun enters the capital to uncover the truth. Suspecting the wheelchair-bound Crown Prince Jiang Yunsheng, she marries into his household to investigate. As they work together, misunderstandings fade, and they join forces to solve mysteries and ultimately uncover the truth, united by their shared quest for justice.

items.title: Love and Sword
items.synopsis: Fang Yi si gadis rumahan tidak sengaja masuk ke dalam novel yang dikeluhkannya. Di dalam novel ia bertemu Chu Tianyao, pemilik pondok di buku itu. Setelah beberapa tikungan dan belokan, Fang Yi mengubah hidupnya melawan langit berbekal kecerdasannya sendiri. Dia dan Chu Tianyao juga saling menyembuhkan dan tumbuh dalam cinta. Keduanya akhirnya menulis kisah cinta yang indah.

items.title: Love Behind the Mask
items.synopsis: Si Yichen, son of King Zishang, loses his entire family in a massacre on his wedding day. To seek revenge, he assumes the identity of Mu Han and gains the trust of the Eldest Princess. Meanwhile, his fiancée, Hang Anning, believing him to be dead, infiltrates the palace by swapping faces with the princess. Under the same roof, their hidden identities lead to unexpected emotions, love and vengeance become inseparable.

items.title: Love Beyond the Curse
items.synopsis: Chong Yang dari Klan Yongye sudah lelah hidup abadi. Untuk melawan keabadiannya, ia menanam bunga Noctrose agar bisa mengakhiri hidupnya. Tapi bunga itu tak pernah mekar—sampai ia bertemu Ji Nanxing, gadis dari Klan Yan. Ji Nanxing dikutuk akan mati muda, dan satu-satunya cara untuk bertahan hidup adalah menikah dengan Chong Yang. Satu ingin mati, Satu ingin berjuang untuk hidup, bagaimana kelanjutan nasib mereka?

items.title: Love Blossoms with the Wind
items.synopsis: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Song Qiyue returns to Wuxi to reclaim their guesthouse and start over. With the unexpected help of Gu Cian, a mysterious businessman, she renovates the inn and rediscovers purpose and love. But when she learns Gu Cian is the executive behind a redevelopment project threatening the guesthouse, their growing bond is put to the test.

items.title: Love Casting
items.synopsis: On a 7-day journey, eight boys face BL tasks, real emotions, and one big question: who will they choose when it’s time to confess?

items.title: Love Formula
items.synopsis: Gadis desa bernama Jian Dan bertemu jenius matematika Han Yansheng di kampus. Saat Yansheng mengalami trauma, Jian Dan hadir memberi kekuatan. Di tengah perjuangan dan dukungan itu, tumbuhlah benih cinta… Tapi apakah cinta cukup untuk menyembuhkan segalanya?

items.title: Love in Pavilion
items.synopsis: Menceritakan tentang bagaimana Dongfang Huaizhu dan Wangquan Hongye sebagai juru mudi dari masing-masing keluarga yang berada dalam situasi di mana manusia dan siluman tidak dapat hidup berdampingan, mereka berusaha dan berjuang untuk menghidupkan kembali aliansi Yiqi dan menstabilkan situasi. Pada hari ketujuh bulan ketujuh lunar, ada paviliun Bambu di Sungai Huai; akan mengandalkan satu sama lain dan tidak akan pernah berubah walaupun menghadapi rintangan. Menceritakan sebuah janji yang paling menyentuh dan sebuah kisah yang lebih panjang.

items.title: Love in the Clouds
items.synopsis: Pada "Turnamen Qingyun" tahunan Enam Alam Hexu, Ji Bozai (diperankan oleh Hou Minghao), seorang petarung Jurang Jixing yang berasal dari latar belakang narapidana, secara mengejutkan mengalahkan Ming Yi (diperankan oleh Lu Yuxiao), seorang dewi perang dingin yang telah memenangkan pertandingan selama tujuh tahun berturut-turut. Dalam semalam, dia menjadi bintang paling bersinar di Jurang Jixing. Sementara itu, Ming Yi menyembunyikan jati dirinya dan menyamar sebagai penari untuk mendekati Ji Bozai. Keduanya, dengan identitas tersembunyi, terlibat dalam pertarungan penuh semangat dan romansa, memperjuangkan keadilan, dan akhirnya mendapatkan cinta yang mengharukan.

items.title: Love in the Edge of Divorce
items.synopsis: Dalam pernikahan bisnis tanpa cinta, dua orang yang belum pernah bertemu berencana mengakhiri pernikahan mereka setelah tiga tahun. Namun, Fu Yancheng tahu bahwa Sheng Mian adalah Penny, lalu berusaha memperbaiki hubungan mereka dan memutuskan untuk bersama selamanya.

items.title: Love is Always Online
items.synopsis: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan secretly joins a virtual game to track down his first love, Yao Yuan, rekindling their relationship and bringing it into the real world. Just as their wedding plans begin, long-standing family grudges and unexpected hardships threaten to break them apart. Facing misunderstandings and illness, they must fight for each other and their future to prove that true love can withstand even the deepest grudges.

items.title: Love Is Blind: Italy
items.synopsis: A group of singles who want to be loved for who they are will have the opportunity to search for their soulmate without the distractions of the outside world and will choose someone to marry without ever meeting them face-to-face. When their wedding day arrives, will real-world realities and external factors push them apart, or will they marry the person they fell blindly in love with?

items.title: Love is for the Dogs
items.synopsis: A divorce lawyer Aiko and vet Kai bond over their dogs, while Korean conglomerate heir  Seo-ha approaches Kai on a mission. Their paths collide in a love story about connection and growth sparked by their pets.

items.title: Love Island: Beyond the Villa
items.synopsis: Following everyone’s favorite Season 6 Islanders around Los Angeles as they navigate new careers, evolving friendships, newfound fame, and complex relationships outside of the Love Island villa.

items.title: Love Lurking
items.synopsis: Surgeon Gu Nian saves a drug dealer and is pulled into a deadly underworld, where they fall in love. After he vanishes in an explosion, she later meets a man who looks just like him but claims to be someone else. As she searches for the truth behind her mother’s death, hidden identities and buried secrets slowly unravel.

items.title: Love Never Fails
items.synopsis: Menceritakan kisah Dewa Jin Xiu yang mencoba membantu roh bunga kamelia, Hong Ning, untuk mencapai keabadian. Namun, terbentuk ikatan selama seribu tahun di antara mereka dan pada akhirnya, Hong Ning membantu Jin Xiu berubah menjadi manusia.

items.title: Love of Petals
items.synopsis: Di kota Ping, "Ibu Kota Bunga," Gu Qingcheng, seorang penanam bunga, tanpa sengaja menghirup roh peony putih yang ternyata adalah Lyu Gengyun, makhluk setengah siluman berusia seribu tahun. Sejak kecil, Gu Qingcheng bertekad menghidupkan 9.999 bunga demi memenuhi pesan terakhir ayahnya—menanti Dewa Bunga untuk membawanya ke langit.  Ketika Lyu Gengyun terbangun dari dalam peony raksasa, Gu Qingcheng yakin dialah Dewa Bunga yang dinantikannya dan memohon menjadi muridnya. Sementara itu, Lyu Gengyun menyembunyikan identitasnya demi menemukan cara melepaskan roh bunga dari tubuh Gu Qingcheng serta mengungkap tragedi keluarganya. Namun, Gu Qingcheng ternyata adalah "Pencuri Bunga" yang ditakuti banyak orang.  Di tengah perjalanan ajaib mereka, ikatan mulai terjalin, tetapi kemunculan Dewa Bunga yang sebenarnya membawa tantangan dan pilihan yang tak terduga.

items.title: Love of the Divine Tree
items.synopsis: Seorang Pertapa abadi yang memiliki bakat spesial, Su Yishui, diubah takdirnya oleh tuannya, Mu Qingge delapan belas tahun yang lalu. "Iblis Wanita" Mu Qingge, yang selalu memberontak, meninggal karena nama buruk yang ditanggungnya. Delapan belas tahun kemudian, Mu Qingge berubah menjadi Xue Ranran. Su Yishui, yang berhasil menjadi kepala Sekte Xishan, membawa Ranran yang lemah dan sekarat ke dalam sektenya, bersumpah untuk melindunginya seumur hidupnya. Sejak saat itu, identitas guru dan murid tertukar. Kisah lucu apa yang akan terjadi di antara keduanya?

items.title: Love Rewritten
items.synopsis: Setelah upaya pembunuhan, Xiao Jingyang dan Lin Mingxuan yang hendak bercerai justru bertukar jiwa dan kembali ke masa sebelum mereka menikah. Mereka bekerja sama mencari cara kembali, tapi setelah semuanya hampir terselesaikan, Jingyang justru memilih untuk menjauh. Saat rahasia terungkap dan bahaya mengintai, Mingxuan memilih bertahan di sisinya.

items.title: Love Scout
items.synopsis: Yoo Eun-ho, a single dad armed with perfection, becomes the secretary of Kang Ji-yun, the CEO of a popular headhunter company, who doesn't do anything except work.

items.title: Love Sea
items.synopsis: Rakumoto Ai, a romance novelist, meets Muto Kaishin, a free-spirited islander, during his stay. Their unexpected encounter stirs something in Ai he can’t quite ignore.

items.title: Love's Ambition
items.synopsis: Xu Yan, seorang pembawa acara terkenal, dan Shen Haoming, seorang elit, adalah pasangan yang dikagumi banyak orang. Meskipun terlihat sangat serasi, perbedaan latar belakang mereka membuat sulit untuk benar-benar menyatu. Xu Yan, dengan identitasnya yang glamor dan latar belakang yang "dipoles", berhasil menikah dengan Shen Haoming, yang sebenarnya telah mengendalikan segalanya. Ketika konflik muncul, Xu Yan memutuskan untuk meninggalkan Shen Haoming dan tidak ingin kembali. Namun, Shen Haoming menyadari perasaannya pada Xu Yan, akankah mereka menemukan satu sama lain?

items.title: Love, Take Two
items.synopsis: A single mom and her medical student daughter have entered an unexpected second act in their lives. A story of love that is not an end but a beginning that comes to them as they decide to live happily today instead of tomorrow.

items.title: LOVE.exe
items.synopsis: After a university merges its modeling and computer engineering departments, the charming model Min-hak and the perfectionist coder Yeon-san, polar opposites in every way, unexpectedly fall for each other.

items.title: Love: Track
items.synopsis: A romance anthology featuring 10 different love stories, each with its own unique tone and charm. It has an ensemble cast.

items.title: Loving the Lie
items.synopsis: Xin Yi, pelukis jenius, kembali ke kampung halaman untuk mengungkap kematian ayahnya dan trauma adiknya akibat pabrik seni palsu. Ia berpura-pura bekerja untuk kolektor Guan Shanhai. Saat mencari kebenaran, putra Guan, Guan Huai, membantunya demi ambisi pribadi. Mereka pun terlibat dalam konspirasi berbahaya.

items.title: Low Life
items.synopsis: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

items.title: LuBan Mysteries
items.synopsis: Li Mudun, tukang kayu terbaik di Kota Kabut, dituduh sebagai pelaku hilangnya para pengantin. Bersama seorang detektif dan ahli forensik, ia menyelidiki kasus yang dipenuhi perangkap mekanis dan misteri gelap, hingga akhirnya jejak itu mengarah pada saudaranya sendiri. Mereka harus mengungkap kebenaran di tengah kota yang semakin kacau

items.title: Luminosity Behind the Palace
items.synopsis: Drama ini bercerita tentang Su Leyu, putri bangsawan yang dipaksa menikah dengan Kaisar Yin Changyan, berjuang melawan sistem kekuasaan lama untuk memperkenalkan reformasi, termasuk ujian pegawai negeri untuk perempuan, sekaligus menantang dominasi empat keluarga bangsawan yang menindas rakyat.

items.title: Lying
items.synopsis: On a quest for vengeance, a young woman infiltrates a wealthy real estate family, plotting to destroy them as their wary matriarch grows suspicious.

items.title: Lynley
items.synopsis: Tommy Lynley, an aristocratic detective, and Barbara Havers, a working-class maverick sergeant, share little in common; except a passion for justice. His intellect and her instincts make them an unlikely but formidable team.

items.title: Mad Unicorn
items.synopsis: Seorang calon pengusaha memulai langkah baru dengan meluncurkan layanan kurir baru yang menghadirkan peluang baru dan musuh-musuh yang kuat.

items.title: Made in Korea
items.synopsis: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

items.title: Maigret
items.synopsis: Jules Maigret is a rising star in the Police Judiciaire, relentless in his investigations, with an uncanny ability to get under the skin of the criminals he is chasing and a matchless knowledge of Paris and its inhabitants

items.title: Malditos
items.synopsis: In the south of France, the leader of a gypsy community and her two sons fight to save their clan, threatened with eviction by rising waters. To survive, they must cross the lines of legality and fight in a dark and dangerous world... all while hiding the unspeakable secret that has haunted their family for seven years.

items.title: Malice
items.synopsis: A charming tutor infiltrates a wealthy family's life, revealing a sinister agenda.

items.title: Man Vs Baby
items.synopsis: Menjelang Natal, seorang ayah yang ceroboh harus menjaga griya tawang mewah di London sambil menghadapi sebuah masalah yang tak terduga: mengurus bayi yang tersesat.

items.title: Manbo Destiny
items.synopsis: While expanding her e-commerce business abroad, Chinese entrepreneur Guan Mengmeng is swept into royal intrigue in the Kingdom of Manbo. A contract marriage with Crown Prince Song Pai turns into a powerful partnership, as she helps him fight for the throne and he backs her mission to bring digital change to his country.

items.title: Mandala Murders
items.synopsis: When a series of ritualistic murders shakes a small town, a detective and an ex-cop must investigate a mystery with deep ties to their pasts.

items.title: Marcial Maciel: The Wolf of God
items.synopsis: A docuseries that reveals the decades of abuse and deception of Father Marcial Maciel, the infamous leader of the Legionaries of Christ.

items.title: Marie and Her Three Daddies
items.synopsis: Kang Ma Ri has always longed for her father, but her search takes an unexpected turn when three men suddenly step into her life. This leads to the birth of an eccentric new family, one that proves stronger than blood and more persistent than DNA.

items.title: Marines
items.synopsis: Follow the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they conduct high-stakes combat exercises in the Pacific.

items.title: Marry Him in Her Place
items.synopsis: Pada malam pernikahannya, sang pewaris kaya raya, Liang Yi, disiksa hingga wajahnya rusak dan dibuang ke sungai oleh suaminya. Tak disangka, dia diselamatkan dan dipaksa mengganti wajahnya menjadi Xu Yin, seorang wanita penghibur dari dunia malam. Dengan identitas barunya, Liang Yi kembali ke dunia luar sebagai Xu Yin dan mendekati ketua geng Lin Yun untuk memulai jalan balas dendamnya.

items.title: Marry Me Again
items.synopsis: Untuk menghidupkan kembali perusahaan perhiasan mendiang tunangannya Tang Jingxing, Istrinya Mi Chuxia bekerja sama dengan seleb internet Louis. Keduanya secara bertahap jatuh cinta saat kerja bersama, tetapi kemudian Mi Chuxia menyadari bahwa Louis adalah Tang Jingxing, dan kebenaran tentang kecelakaan mobilnya tiga tahun lalu akhirnya terungkap.

items.title: Marry to the Enemy of My Enemy
items.synopsis: Xia Nuan yang baik hati pergi ke luar negri untuk membantu adik tirinya yang sakit ginjal. Namun ternyata ginjal yang dibutuhkan adalah miliknya sendiri. Saat nyaris diambil paksa, ia diselamatkan oleh Zhong Xinyang. Xia Nuan lalu kembali secara mengejutkan di pemakamannya sendiri!

items.title: Marvel Zombies
items.synopsis: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

items.title: Mary Kills People
items.synopsis: A black comedy about a doctor who illegally helps terminally ill patients with euthanasia and a detective who tracks down her illegal activities.

items.title: May Your Heart Be Like Mine
items.synopsis: Xie Tianxing, a chivalrous thief from a fallen noble family, unexpectedly finds himself thrust into a new life when he takes on a mission that leads to him assuming the identity of a wealthy merchant. As he navigates his sudden transformation, he discovers that beneath his newfound fortune, danger and deception lurk at every turn.

items.title: Maya
items.synopsis: Maya has waited 15 years. Now, she’s back to take down the family that destroyed her—one by one, no one escapes the fire she’s bringing.

items.title: Me late que si (How To Win The Lottery)
Medusa
items.synopsis: Dapatkah Bárbara Hidalgo, sang CEO, menemukan pelaku yang ingin membunuh dirinya saat keluarganya dengan kejam berencana mengendalikan kerajaan bisnis mereka di Kolombia?

items.title: Melo Movie
items.synopsis: Seorang penyuka film jatuh hati kepada calon sutradara, menyulut api asmara yang padam terlalu dini. Ketika mereka bertemu lagi, bisakah cinta menemukan jalan kembali?

items.title: Members Only: Palm Beach
items.synopsis: Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.

items.title: Mercy for None
items.synopsis: Setelah putus hubungan dengan gengnya, seorang mantan gangster kembali untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian adik lelakinya—memulai balas dendam yang tiada henti.

items.title: Metro Medico
items.synopsis: After being attacked while trying to cure a plague, Gu Xiaofeng wakes up in the modern world. Determined to uncover the truth behind her time travel, she stays close to Dr. Ren Yi, the man whose figure she glimpsed before losing consciousness, unfolding a story that bridges two worlds.

items.title: Mid-Century Modern
items.synopsis: Three best friends — gay gentlemen of a certain age – decide after an unexpected death to spend their golden years living together in Palm Springs where the wealthiest one lives with his mother. As a chosen family, they prove that no matter how hard things get, there’s always someone around to remind you it would be better if you got your neck done.

items.title: Millennium Storm
items.synopsis: Li Tian, jenius IT, terlempar ke tahun 2000-an dan bangun sebagai pria berutang dengan istri yang tak ia kenali. Bersama sahabatnya, ia bangkit membangun bisnis. Namun, kesuksesan justru memicu perang dengan saudara yang dulu ia percaya, sambil perlahan terkuak misteri pertukaran jiwanya.

items.title: Misaligned Lover
items.synopsis: Amid a crumbling marriage, Yan Lidong and Mu Chenxi face the brink of divorce due to misunderstandings and conflicts. When Yan Lidong is injured saving Mu Chenxi, his memory reverts to his 19-year-old self. As they navigate this unexpected twist, Mu Chenxi reflects on her past neglect and begins to rediscover the love and connection they once shared.

items.title: Miss King
items.synopsis: The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.

items.title: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. The Mafia
items.synopsis: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

items.title: Mobius
items.synopsis: Seorang detektif jenius di Kepolisian Kota Hua’ao dikenal karena kebijaksanaan dan keberaniannya dalam memecahkan berbagai kasus besar. Namun, ketika serangkaian pembunuhan sempurna terjadi tanpa meninggalkan jejak pelaku, ia harus menghadapi misteri yang mengguncang batas kemampuannya, di tengah kota yang dipenuhi intrik dan ancaman tersembunyi.

items.title: MobLand
items.synopsis: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

items.title: Mohra
items.synopsis: After a tragedy strikes her family, Alizay seeks revenge against the wealthy Hamdani family, whose pride and greed have caused irreparable damage to her modest but once-happy life with her mother and sister.

items.title: Money Honey Brainy
items.synopsis: Seorang Ratu Part Time tanpa sengaja menjadi pacar kontrak pewaris konglomerat, lalu terjebak dalam kisah cinta pura-pura yang berubah jadi nyata di tengah pengawasan ketat orang tua dan situasi kocak yang tak terduga.

items.title: Money Is Coming
items.synopsis: Seorang mahasiswi tanpa sengaja terjebak ke dalam novel dan menjadi peran pendukung kejam, Putri Yue Xi, yang tewas dalam tiga bab. Untuk menyelamatkan hidupnya, dia menjauh dari plot. Namun, setelah beradaptasi, Ning Chuxi malah terlibat lebih dalam dan berusaha menyelamatkan karakter lain yang mati. Berhasilakh ia kembali ke dunia nyata?

items.title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
items.synopsis: Kisah nyata mencengangkan tentang Ed Gein, pembunuh dan penjarah makam terkenal yang menginspirasi banyak karakter pembunuh paling ikonis di layar Hollywood.

items.title: Moon River
items.synopsis: In Joseon, a vengeful crown prince and a memory-lost merchant mysteriously swap bodies, unraveling a web of chaos, secrets, and unexpected fate.

items.title: Moonlight Mystique
items.synopsis: Bai Shuo, the youngest daughter of the General's Mansion, aspires to cultivate immortality in order to repay a favor. On her journey to seek immortality, she accidentally rescues the great demon god Fan Yue. As the saying goes, healthy fights strengthen relationships, and they go from mutual manipulation to mutual affection as they fall in love with each other, navigating a love affair intertwined with sweetness and cruelty. Even though they face countless difficulties, their love is strong enough to overcome all limitations, allowing them to truly embrace each other.

items.title: Moonlit Order
items.synopsis: Feng Zuoren, pimpinan pasukan rahasia, mendapat perintah untuk menyusup ke keluarga bangsawan dan membasmi sisa pewaris kekaisaran lama. Namun saat berhadapan dengan Xue Hexu, putra keluarga itu, keduanya saling menantang hingga benih cinta tumbuh di antara pertarungan dan tipu daya. Tapi di balik semua itu, ada konspirasi yang jauh lebih besar menunggu untuk terungkap.

items.title: Moonlit Reunion
items.synopsis: Mei Zhuyu, a calm and reserved nobleman from a lesser branch of the Mei family, arrives in Chang'an as an official at the Bureau of Mystic Investigations. During a banquet, he meets Wu Zhen, the bold and unruly younger sister of the Empress and secret Guardian of the Demon Underworld. Both hide their true identities. Wu, a half-demon striving to keep peace, and Mei, a skilled demon slayer, seek the truth behind the fire 18 years ago. As bone demons rise and unrest grows, they fight side by side, forming a bond that deepens into love until the Changxi Palace launches a purge, forcing them to face each other's secrets and the past they share.

items.title: Most Wanted: Teen Hacker
items.synopsis: The unbelievable true story of a boy once named by the FBI as one of the most dangerous hackers in the world.

items.title: Motel California
items.synopsis: A woman with a unique upbringing in a motel in the countryside leaves her hometown at 20 to pursue her career in Seoul. Twelve years later though, she returns home to heal her heart and experiences twists and turns as she reunites with her first love, a now eligible bachelor and veterinarian.

items.title: Motorheads
items.synopsis: Motorheads: Taruhan Mobil, Taruhan Cinta bercerita soal cinta pertama, patah hati pertama, dan memutar kunci mobil pertamamu. Berlatar belakang kota yang dulu makmur dan kini mencari secercah harapan, serial ini adalah kisah penuh adrenalin tentang sekelompok orang luar yang membentuk persahabatan unik karena kecintaan yang sama akan balap jalanan, sambil menavigasi hierarki dan aturan SMA.

items.title: Mr. Mikami's Classroom
items.synopsis: Takashi Mikami, a University of Tokyo graduate, joins the Ministry of Education to reform Japan's education but is disillusioned by its reality. Transferred to a private high school, he takes a stand against the authorities, using his role as a teacher to push for change.

items.title: Ms. Incognito
items.synopsis: A bodyguard hides in a village as a kindergarten teacher to avoid her boss' enemies – but faces a new challenge in a skeptical strawberry farmer!

items.title: Murdaugh: Death in the Family
items.synopsis: Maggie and Alex enjoy a lavish life of privilege as members of one of South Carolina's most powerful legal dynasties. But when their son Paul is involved in a deadly boat crash, the family is faced with a test unlike any they've ever encountered. As details come to light and new challenges emerge, the family's connections to several mysterious deaths raise questions which threaten everything Maggie and Alex hold dear.

items.title: Murder on Trial
items.synopsis: Detectives chase leads, prosecutors face defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with decisions.

items.title: Murderbot
items.synopsis: Dalam suatu masa depan futuristis, robot sekuriti pemberontak diam-diam mendapatkan autonomi. Agar tak ketahuan, ia terlibat misi melindungi ilmuwan di planet berbahaya, padahal ia hanya ingin menonton opera sabun.

items.title: My Boyfriend
items.synopsis: Yi Ning harus menikah untuk mewarisi bisnis keluarga, jadi ia membuat pernikahan kontrak dengan Shen Qianze, koki tampan yang dianggap suami idaman. Yi Ning bekerja sebagai CEO sedang Shen Qianze jadi bapak rumah tangga. Seiring waktu, perasaan mulai tumbuh. Namun, Qianze menyimpan rahasia besar. Apakah itu?

items.title: My CEO in Disguise
items.synopsis: Gao Feng, bos besar dunia finansial, menyamar jadi kurir dan pura-pura jadi suami CEO Su Qingyan. Diam-diam, ia pakai kekuasaannya untuk melindungi Su dari berbagai masalah. Meski awalnya hanya sandiwara, benih cinta tumbuh di antara mereka, hingga Su mulai curiga pada identitas asli sang "kurir".

items.title: My Dearest Nemesis
items.synopsis: Baek Su-jeong leads a planning team at a renowned department store. She meets her new boss, Ban Ju-yeon, her first love from an online game 16 years ago, stirring up memories of when he confessed his feelings but she rejected him.

items.title: My Destined Consort
items.synopsis: Malam pernikahan Shen Jiangli berubah jadi aib saat dijebak tidur dengan Lu Jingming, lalu dikurung dan difitnah. Saat melahirkan, nyawanya nyaris melayang—dan kini, demi menyelamatkan anaknya yang sakit keras, ia harus kembali ke rumah Lu untuk mendapatkan obat. Mampukah Ia kembali menghadapi luka pahitnya?

items.title: My Family
items.synopsis: Seorang ayah yang sakit parah menyiapkan keluarga besarnya untuk merawat dua anaknya dan menjalani hidup tanpanya—tetapi mereka harus berdamai dengan semua masalah lama.

items.title: My Foxfoe Queen
items.synopsis: Seluruh klan rubah dibantai oleh Pangeran Sayap dari Kerajaan Xiling, Xiling Xuan. Hanya Tushan Yue, sang gadis suci dari klan rubah, yang berhasil mempertahankan sebagian jiwanya. Ia mengejar Xiling Xuan hingga ke istana kerajaan untuk membalas dendam. Jiwa Tushan Yue kemudian bersemayam di tubuh Permaisuri Jiang Xiner, yang meninggal secara misterius. Namun, seiring rencana balas dendamnya berjalan, Tushan Yue perlahan mengungkap sebuah kebenaran mengejutkan yang mengguncang keyakinannya.

items.title: My Frosty Coworker Is Only Sweet to Me
items.synopsis: A cold-natured engineer falls for his kind senior after she warms him up on a rainy day, sparking a sweet office romance.

items.title: My Lovely Journey aka I Will Travel for You
My Name is Zhao Chuxi
items.synopsis: Dibesarkan sebagai yatim piatu di Wan Jing Shan, Zhao Chuxi bertekad mewujudkan impian almarhum ayah angkatnya. Ia meninggalkan desa demi mencari nafkah di kota, tapi justru terseret dalam konflik berbahaya. Ketika segalanya hancur, ia bangkit lebih kuat. Namun, saat kembali ke kota untuk membalas dendam, akankah ia tetap setia pada impian awalnya?

items.title: My Troublesome Star
items.synopsis: A romantic comedy that follows the story of a top actress who, after reaching the peak of her career and even winning the youngest-ever Best Actress award, suffers an accident and finds herself transported 25 years into the future.

items.title: My Youth
items.synopsis: The story of Sun Woo-hae and Sung Je-yun, who reunite after 15 years, struggling and living fiercely in their respective stages.

items.title: Nana Bnb with Seventeen
items.synopsis: As SEVENTEEN is getting ready to celebrate their 10th anniversary, SEVENTEEN will be making some unforgettable memories with HOST NA!

items.title: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
items.synopsis: When his security company is attacked, Tony and Ziva must go on the run across Europe, try to figure out who is after them and maybe even learn to trust each other again so that they can finally have their unconventional happily ever after.

items.title: Necaxa
items.synopsis: Beloved Mexican soccer team Club Necaxa strives to reclaim their place as one of Mexico's top teams, while their Mexican-American owner Eva Longoria tries to breathe new life into the team by enlisting the help of her high-profile friends including new co-owners Rob Mac and Ryan Reynolds.

items.title: Newtopia
items.synopsis: Jae-yoon, a late military enlistee, and his girlfriend, Young-joo, break up over the phone over growing misunderstandings. But a zombie outbreak rocks the world. A national emergency is declared, a plane crashes in the city center, and Jae-yoon and his unit get trapped on top of a Seoul skyscraper. Young-joo risks the zombie-filled streets to find him. Can their love survive the apocalypse?

items.title: Nice to Not Meet You
items.synopsis: A hateful romance between a professional detective actor who wants to become a melodrama master and a female reporter who was demoted from a political reporter who won the Reporter of the Year award to the entertainment department.

items.title: Nine Puzzle
items.synopsis: Ten years after discovering her murdered uncle, Ena and Detective Hansaem must cooperate to stop a series of similar murders - each linked by strange puzzle pieces.

items.title: No Mercy
items.synopsis: One phone call was enough to shatter one's entire world. For unknown actress So Min, everything collapses when a voice phishing scam tears her family apart. She is thrust into the darkest side of technology as her missing mother, father's death, and even the stolen voice of her late mother become weapons in a shocking scheme. With nothing left but the will to take revenge, she turns to deepfake technology as her ultimate weapon, infiltrating a vast and merciless syndicate. Along the way, she encounters Ma Seok Gu, a ruthless boss hungry for power, Jeong Hun, a cop torn between truth and loyalty, and Do Jin, a hacker with a sinister smile. Plunging into a web of betrayal and danger with the fake identities she forges, will she exact vengeance, or will they destroy her?

items.title: No One Saw Us Leave
items.synopsis: Seorang ibu menghadapi stigma dan perpisahan nan pedih saat suaminya membawa anak-anak mereka ke luar negeri, yang mengubah hidupnya selamanya. Terinspirasi kisah nyata.

items.title: No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski
items.synopsis: From Italy, Germany and the UK to Senegal, South Korea and Borneo, Antoni takes celebs on epic journeys to explore their ancestral and culinary roots.

items.title: Nomen Kenji
items.synopsis: A mismatched legal duo uncovers hidden contradictions in a high school girl's murder case while confronting parallel evidence tampering, as an unyielding prosecutor dismantles a web of judicial deceit.

items.title: Northward
items.synopsis: Drama ini bercerita mengenai beberapa anak laki-laki dan perempuan yang tumbuh bersama di tepi kanal, dan bersatu kembali setelah bertahun-tahun meninggalkan tepi kanal tempat mereka dibesarkan. Setelah menghadapi persaingan dan tekanan hidup, mereka mendapatkan kembali harapan untuk kehidupan baru. Melalui para remaja Jiangnan ini: kita tidak hanya melihat pertumbuhan mereka, namun juga merasakan perubahan sejarah Grand Canal dari yang perkembangannya terhenti sampai bangkit kembali menuju kehidupan baru selama seratus tahun terakhir; membuat kita mengapresiasi budaya kanal Tiongkok yang beragam yang terus berkembang di Tiongkok.

items.title: Offline Love
items.synopsis: Para lajang muda yang berada di negeri asing selama sepuluh hari ini hanya mengandalkan takdir untuk jatuh cinta. Mampukah mereka menemukan cinta tanpa perangkat digital?

items.title: Oh My Ghost Clients
items.synopsis: No Mu-jin is a labor attorney who happens to see ghosts. After coming back from the brink of death, he begins solving labor problems requested by ghosts.

items.title: Old Money
items.synopsis: Nihal's affluent life comes under threat when a self-made tycoon with an eye for money — and an even sharper one for love — shakes up Istanbul's elite.

items.title: Once upon a Dream
items.synopsis: Shen Qingtang, yang keluarganya hancur saat dia masih muda, diasuh oleh Pei Congzhi, putra tertua dari keluarga Marquis Chengping, dan menjadi putri angkat di keluarga Pei, hidup sebagai saudara perempuannya. Selama bertahun-tahun, dia mengalami perlakuan tidak adil dan penindasan. Dengan tekanan terus-menerus dari keluarga Pei, Shen Qingtang memutuskan untuk meninggalkan Pei Congzhi, dan melarikan diri dari kehidupan yang penuh bahaya dan ketidakpastian...

items.title: One: High School Heroes
items.synopsis: A former model student, pushed by domestic abuse and bullying, joins a group that stands up to school violence and defends its victims.

items.title: Oops! I’m in Jail
items.synopsis: After a career-ending injury, Taekwondo star Zhiyao falls into gambling and is forced to become a prison administrator, tasked with overseeing the notorious boss Chihuahua under the watchful eye of instructor Jiang Yijie. Amid the harsh, absurd conditions, Zhiyao and his colleagues form bonds of friendship, trust, and love, finding meaning and resilience in their challenging work.

items.title: Our Golden Days
items.synopsis: An interior designer has a one-sided crush on her former college senior – but his best friend is secretly in love with her.

items.title: Our Movie
items.synopsis: A director with no future and an actress with no tomorrow fall into a love story that cannot wait.

items.title: Our Unwritten Seoul
items.synopsis: Twin sisters, whose similarities end with their looks, swap identities amid personal struggles — embarking on a journey to rediscover love and life.

items.title: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
items.synopsis: From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.

items.title: Pabila Dia Tersenyum
items.synopsis: Struggling in poverty, Elina fights to overcome life's obstacles with the help of two men who love her.

items.title: Paradise
items.synopsis: The tranquility in a serene, wealthy community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high stakes investigation unfolds.

items.title: Paul American
items.synopsis: Global sports and entertainment superstars Jake and Logan Paul are pulling back the curtain for their latest venture: a family reality TV show.

items.title: Pehli Barish
items.synopsis:
Pehli Barish is a story of love that spans generations, a tale of joy, longing, and heartbreak that seems to repeat itself.

Years ago in Lahore, strangers Behzad and Maleeha met and a spark of love lit between them. But fate had other plans and tore them apart, leaving hearts scarred.

Decades later, Behzad lives a settled life with a family, yet the past never truly leaves him. His son, Maani, falls for Nimra and the shadows of old heartbreak loom large. As Behzad watches history threatening to repeat itself, he must face his own past to protect Maani and perhaps confront the love he lost long ago.

Will Maleeha return to Behzad’s life? Will Behzad save his son from the same heartbreak he experienced? Can Maani and Nimra’s love win against all odds?

items.title: Perfect Match
items.synopsis: In the bustling capital of Bianjing during the Northern Song Dynasty, Madam Li moves her family in search of better marriage prospects for her five beautiful but quirky daughters, whose love lives have long been her worry. Each daughter, though famous for her beauty and wit, comes with unique quirks: the eldest, Shou Hua, has no interest in remarrying after early widowhood; the third, Kang Ning, is fierce and headstrong; the fourth, Hao De, is well-meaning but blunt; and the youngest, Le Shan, is spoiled and selective.  Challenges abound as they face unexpected setbacks, including a cold reception from the already-married sister they came to visit. As the family reestablishes their business, they navigate a series of humorous and heartwarming misadventures, ultimately finding love and fulfilling their mother’s hopes in this lively tale of family and romance.

items.title: Phoenix's Gambit: Love or Crown
items.synopsis: Bai Xiyue, putri selir dari Kediaman Menteri, terkenal licik dan ambisius. Ia menjebak dan membunuh kakaknya, Bai Xiyao, putri sah dari istri utama, lalu merebut hati Adipati Yun Yichen hingga akhirnya naik tahta menjadi permaisuri. Namun, pada hari penobatannya, ia tewas karena racun. Bai Xiyue terlahir Kembali dalam tubuh kakaknya sendiri, Bai Xiyao. Dengan seluruh ingatan masa lalunya, ia kini harus menghadapi versi muda dari dirinya sendiri: kejam, penuh siasat, dan tanpa belas kasihan. Segala trik yang dulu ia gunakan, kini menimpa dirinya. Di kehidupan barunya, Bai Xiyue harus menjaga diri dengan bijak, menebus dosa, dan menghadapi konflik cinta yang rumit.

items.title: Phoenix's Homecoming
items.synopsis: Ia adalah Putri Agung yang sangat berkuasa, tetapi dikhianati oleh orang yang paling ia cintai hingga tewas terbakar. Setelah terlahir kembali, pria yang dulu ia cintai kini tunduk di bawah kekuasaannya, sementara seorang pangeran dari negeri musuh rela menjadi alat rahasianya. Dianggap permaisuri sebagai musuh yang ditakdirkan, ia kembali bukan hanya untuk merebut kekuasaan, tetapi juga seluruh negeri. Jika dulu ia bermain dengan cinta, kini ia mengendalikan segalanya dengan kekuasaan. Cinta dan dendamnya akan menjadi jalan menuju mahkota.

items.title: Physical: Asia
items.synopsis: Atlet-atlet elite dari 8 negara bersaing demi kebanggaan bangsa. Setelah melewati ujian kekuatan dan ketahanan sejati yang berat, cuma satu negara yang akan jadi juara.

items.title: Playing Go
items.synopsis: Menceritakan hidup seorang guru Go biasa, Cui Ye, yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam sebuah kasus kriminal. Perlahan, ia terjerat dalam dunia kejahatan, sementara sang kakak, Cui Wei, seorang polisi, tak henti mengejarnya. Bisakah saudara ini bertemu di jalan yang sama?

items.title: Playing Gracie Darling
items.synopsis: When Joni was 14, her best friend Gracie Darling disappeared during a séance. Some 27 years on, the local kids in a small town get their kicks with a game of 'Playing Gracie Darling' – but the seemingly innocent game turns sinister when another girl disappears. Joni, by then a child psychologist, returns to the town and partners with a police sergeant Jay to uncover the truth, while Gracie's sister Ruth faces a mother's worst nightmare when her own daughter vanishes under hauntingly similar circumstances.

items.title: Please Die My Beloved
items.synopsis: Three women, each facing troubled marriages, unite after one confesses to killing her husband, leading them on a path of revenge and self-discovery as they fight to reclaim their happiness.

items.title: Pluribus
items.synopsis: Orang paling menyedihkan di Bumi harus menyelamatkan dunia dari kebahagiaan.

items.title: Police Tactical Unit
items.synopsis: Di tengah hiruk-pikuk kota Rongcheng, berdiri Unit Gerak Cepat, tim taktis elit di bawah Divisi Investigasi Kriminal. Mereka selalu menjadi yang pertama tiba di setiap TKP — mulai dari kasus bunuh diri selebritas yang mencurigakan, perampokan besar yang direncanakan dengan sempurna, hingga penggerebekan sarang narkoba yang tersembunyi rapat. Bahkan ketika penjahat menyiapkan jebakan dan tipu daya, para detektif Unit Gerak Cepat selalu mampu membongkar kebenaran dengan ketajaman insting dan strategi mereka.

items.title: Prime Target
items.synopsis: Seorang matematikawan muda brilian berada di ambang terobosan besar ketika dia menyadari musuh misterius mencoba menghancurkan idenya. Bersama dengan agen pemerintah yang telah melacaknya, dia mulai mengungkap konspirasi yang mengganggu.

items.title: Princess Revenge
items.synopsis: Dongfang Xi menyembunyikan identitas dan bekerja demi Ye Yunzhou, tapi dikhianati. Menyadari dirinya hanya tokoh antagonis novel, ia bertaruh dengan sistem untuk mengubah takdir. Di pesta keluarga, ia membongkar Ye Yunzhou dan menemukan kakaknya, Dongfang Yan, ternyata jelmaan sistem. Apa yang kelanjutan yang menanti Dongfang Xi?

items.title: Pro Bono
items.synopsis: When a respected judge's world falls apart overnight, he joins a top law firm's pro bono team — where hope and purpose wait in humble, unexpected places.

items.title: Project UFO
items.synopsis: A smug TV host and a small-town ufologist work to uncover the origins of an alleged UFO sighting, splitting the nation in a storm of doubts and beliefs.

items.title: Pulse
items.synopsis: Sekelompok residen IGD menghadapi krisis medis dan drama pribadi di tengah tuduhan yang memecah belah di rumah sakit mereka yang berlokasi di Miami.

items.title: Qingchuan's Veil of Vengeance
items.synopsis: Pada tahun ke-10 Zhanghe, secara kebetulan Xia Qiguang diatur oleh ayahnya, Raja Jing, untuk berguru pada Mo Wang. Sang Pangeran awalnya meremehkan guru yang disebut-sebut sebagai guru terbaik di dunia. Namun, ia sangat mengagumi Mo Qingchuan, seorang jenderal wanita yang melindungi keluarga dan negara. Tanpa diketahuinya, Mo Wang yang ada di hadapannya tak lain adalah Mo Qingchuan itu sendiri. Dalam proses saling menyelamatkan dan melindungi, guru dan murid ini membangun kembali Pasukan Mo. Mereka memulai perjalanan untuk mengembalikan kehormatan pasukan pahlawan ini.

items.title: Rage: Furia
items.synopsis: Five women face extreme situations that will unleash their rage.

items.title: Rainkissed Fate
items.synopsis: Heiress Bu Yan disappears after a fateful night with boxer He Yuchen. Six years later, she returns with twin children and reunites with He Yuchen, whose career has been derailed by scandal. To save her son, they enter a contract marriage, but their bond deepens as they work together to uncover dark secrets from their past.

items.title: Rangeen
items.synopsis: After discovering his wife's betrayal, a straight-laced husband dives into the hidden world of paid intimacy as a twisted act of revenge. Clueless and out of his depth, he stumbles through misadventures that mix awkward hilarity with raw self-discovery - forcing him to question his notions of love, manhood, and morality.

items.title: Ransom Canyon
items.synopsis: Hasrat menggelora di sebuah kota kecil di Texas saat tiga dinasti peternakan bertarung demi tanah, warisan, serta orang-orang yang mereka cintai.

items.title: Real Madrid: How Can I Not Love You
Recruit a General to Lead the Troops
items.synopsis: A modern deliveryman Li Chengyu is transported to ancient times, where he disguises himself as a farmer to investigate rebels, becoming the son-in-law of village chief Chen Xinrou and unexpectedly finding love while using his modern knowledge to turn the tides.

items.title: Regai
items.synopsis: SI Vetri investigates a medical team that is trying to cover up deaths of clinical trial participants by staging them as accidents. Can Vetri put an end to this sinister plot before it's too late?

items.title: Reopen My Journals
items.synopsis: Qian Jiayue, gadis 15 tahun yang patuh, memulai masa SMA dengan cinta bertepuk sebelah tangan pada tetangganya, Xiao Han. Ia berteman dengan Chen Mo yang pemberani, di tengah konflik dalam keluarganya. Tiga generasi perempuan dalam keluarganya berjuang dengan masalah, kehilangan, dan rekonsiliasi. Mampukah Ia menjaga kehangatan dalam hidupnya?

items.title: Resident Playbook
items.synopsis: First-year OBGYN residents at Yulje Medical Center navigate the chaos of their work and personal lives, all in their quest to become exceptional doctors.

items.title: Restarted Love
items.synopsis: Xu Xin jatuh koma setelah kecelakaan, menyisakan Lu Ming dengan sebuah novel yang penuh rahasia hatinya. Saat membaca, ia menyadari cinta yang dulu ia abaikan. Ia pun menulis ulang kisah mereka, namun apakah kenyataan akan berakhir seindah itu…?

items.title: Return of Fated Love
items.synopsis: Yu Chuxin's once-happy marriage is shattered by betrayal, leaving her devastated and on the brink of death. Determined to seek justice, she fakes selective amnesia, pretending to remember only the early days of her marriage. Returning to the Zhou family, she carefully gathers evidence to bring those who wronged her to justice.

items.title: Return of the Queen
items.synopsis: Xu Haimeng, pewaris Grup Yunhai, mengalami kecelakaan tragis saat berbulan madu namun berhasil selamat dan kembali untuk merebut kendali perusahaannya. Hal ini membuatnya berhadapan dengan keluarga Lu, terutama Lu Siyu, putra kedua yang menyelidiki identitasnya dan kematian sang kakak. Dari pertarungan penuh intrik dan pengungkapan kebenaran mengejutkan, Xu Haimeng dan Lu Siyu yang awalnya bermusuhan perlahan saling bergantung. Namun rahasia kelam keluarga Lu kembali mengguncang segalanya, memaksa keduanya menghadapi pengkhianatan, merebut Yunhai, dan akhirnya menapaki jalan baru bersama.

items.title: Returned Master
items.synopsis: Pada malam Tahun Baru Imlek, keluarga Jenderal Li dibantai, hanya Li Jianwei yang selamat. Ia menyamar dan menyusup ke Lembah Hantu untuk balas dendam, lalu berteman dengan pewaris lembah, Chen Xiaoxi. Saat rencananya berjalan lancar, Jianwei menemukan bahwa musuhnya adalah Pasukan Zhongyong, prajurit setia yang difitnah dua dekade lalu. Kebenaran masa lalu mengguncang keyakinannya, memaksanya memilih antara dendam, kebenaran, dan takdir.

items.title: Returning Pearl
items.synopsis: Lin Suisui is transported into the broken plot of My Fair Princess and becomes a maid in the Empress’s palace. To return home, she must fix the story, while unexpected complications from a mysterious guard threaten to derail everything.

items.title: Revival
items.synopsis: On one miraculous day in rural Wisconsin, the recently deceased suddenly rise from their graves. But this is no zombie story, as the 'revived' appear and act just like they once were. When local officer and single mother Dana Cypress is unexpectedly thrown into the center of a brutal murder mystery of her own, she's left to make sense of the chaos amidst a town gripped by fear and confusion where everyone, alive or undead, is a suspect.

items.title: Ripple
items.synopsis: In New York City, four strangers navigate life's challenges while their separate paths unexpectedly intertwine in ways that change them forever.

items.title: Rise of Her Lady Physician
items.synopsis: Dituduh tanpa alasan dan menjadi korban ketidakadilan, Rong Zelan bertekad menembus lingkaran kekuasaan istana demi membuktikan kemampuannya di dunia medis yang dikuasai para pria. Meski diremehkan oleh tabib-tabib istana, keahliannya membuatnya bangkit melawan segala rintangan. Ia berhasil menyembuhkan Putra Mahkota, menyelamatkan Permaisuri Agung, hingga menghentikan wabah mematikan. Pencapaiannya menjadikannya pejabat perempuan pertama dalam dinasti itu—memimpin para pria yang dulu meremehkannya, sekaligus menorehkan kisah legendaris tentang seorang perempuan yang berani menulis takdirnya sendiri.

items.title: Rise of the Raven
items.synopsis: The story of János Hunyadi is the epic tale of a hero born into modest circumstances, who, in 1456, with relentless determination and against all odds, vanquished the much larger Ottoman army, halting its drive to conquer the Vatican and overrun Western Europe. In so doing, Hunyadi not only shaped the history of Hungary, but that of all Europe.

items.title: Rising from the Ashes
items.synopsis: Xu Cheng, a devoted housewife, battles severe sleep disorders and hallucinations, leading to disturbing behavior. When a tragic car accident strikes, her husband, Lu Yan, survives—but Xu Cheng mysteriously vanishes. As the truth unfolds, hidden secrets come to light, exposing the cracks in their seemingly perfect marriage.

items.title: Robin Hood
items.synopsis: A modern reimagining of the classic tale. After the Norman invasion of England, Rob, a Saxon forester’s son, and Marian, a Norman lord’s daughter, fall in love and unite to fight for justice, challenge corruption, and restore peace to the land.

items.title: Rose and Gun
items.synopsis: Tang Xin, wanita mandiri yang menghindari pernikahan, bertemu Wu Si, tentara disiplin yang hidupnya teratur melalui kencan buta. Meskipun mereka berdua tampak tidak cocok dan sangat bertolak belakang, namun setelah melewati banyak lika-liku yang tidak terduga, keduanya malah jadi semakin dekat. Akankah cinta mereka bertahan di tengah perbedaan dan dunia militer yang keras?

items.title: Rosefinch
items.synopsis: Ceritanya tentang tiga anak muda dengan profesi dan kepribadian yang sangat berbeda, yang dipertemukan oleh serangkaian kasus pembunuhan berantai yang aneh. Mereka bersama-sama mengungkap konspirasi besar di balik Zhuquetang.

items.title: Rotten Legacy
items.synopsis: After a grave illness, a media mogul discovers his children's tactics threaten the empire he carefully built — and he'll do whatever it takes to save it.

items.title: Royal Upstart
items.synopsis: Setelah kecelakaan aneh, Xiao Ning terlempar ke masa lalu dan jadi menantu yang diremehkan. Dengan keahliannya, ia menciptakan teh dan anggur luar biasa, membangun surat kabar pertama, dan membantu putri kerajaan naik pangkat. Dari hinaan, ia bangkit jadi tokoh besar yang mengubah sejarah.

items.title: Ruan Xiaofeng's Royal Love Quest
items.synopsis: Seorang pekerja kantoran modern terlempar ke masa lalu dan menjadi seorang putri bangsawan. Namun, semua orang membencinya, termasuk suaminya, Pangeran Ling. Setelah beberapa kali dijebak, ia sadar bahwa "penjahatnya" adalah dirinya sendiri dan bahkan dicurigai dalang kematian ibu Pangeran Ling! Bersama sang pangeran, ia pun mencari kebenaran.

items.title: Running Point
items.synopsis: Seorang gadis yang tadinya gemar berpesta harus membuktikan kehebatannya sebagai pebisnis saat ia tiba-tiba ditugasi mengurus tim basket profesional keluarganya.

items.title: S Line
items.synopsis: A young woman with the ability to see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers her secret gift is no longer unique when special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market.

items.title: SAAT AKU TAHU
items.synopsis: Ameena is determined to take revenge after finding out about her husband's affair with her best friend, without realizing it will destroy them.

items.title: Sadistic Love
items.synopsis: Helian Zheng sangat mencintai saudara tirinya, He Anran, tetapi ia menyaksikan ayah He memenjarakan ibunya hingga meninggal. Lima tahun kemudian, Helian Zheng kembali sebagai komandan militer, dan ia menangkap ayah tirinya dan memaksa saudara tirinya untuk menikah dengannya demi membalaskan dendam ibunya.

items.title: Sai
items.synopsis: A mysterious man appears before six individuals, each struggling with their own issues, as an impending disaster disrupts their lives, unraveling suspense and psychological tension.

items.title: Salon De Holmes
items.synopsis: Four overlooked housewives, weighed down by daily chores and ignored by those around them, find renewed purpose by solving everyday cases—reclaiming their voices and reigniting long-forgotten dreams.

items.title: Sarcastic Family
items.synopsis: Cai Xiao Ying dan Li Li Li, ibu–anak dari galaksi Andromeda yang hidup tanpa emosi, sudah bertahun-tahun tak bertegur sapa di Bumi. Namun saat Li menikahi pria Bumi bernama Meng demi misi survei antargalaksi, Cai yang bangkrut tiba-tiba datang menumpang. Bersama ayah Meng yang sama kocaknya, keluarga campur aduk ini harus hidup serumah dan kekacauan pun tak terhindarkan!

items.title: Scent of New Dawn
items.synopsis: In Jiangcheng, the prestigious incense-making family is betrayed by their steward. Orphaned Lin Wanyue returns years later, seeking revenge, and joins forces with the steward’s son, Zhang Hanyi. Together, they rise from humble beginnings to confront their enemies and fate.

items.title: Search for Soul Stone
items.synopsis: Lima puluh tahun lalu, energi misterius muncul dari batu giok dan melahirkan manusia berkekuatan khusus. Keluarga Meng yang mampu merasakannya dibantai habis, hanya menyisakan Meng Yan. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, setelah menguasai kekuatannya, ia memulai misi balas dendam yang mengguncang dua generasi.

items.title: Second Shot at Love
items.synopsis: A woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness meets a man who believes alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic.

items.title: Secret Files of XSA
items.synopsis: Proyek riset "Weilan No.1" menarik perhatian dunia. Namun, kelompok mata-mata SAD dan organisasi misterius dari negara musuh mencoba merebut teknologi rahasia ini. Dapatkah Huo Min dan tim keamanan nasional menggagalkan semuanya sebelum terlambat...?

items.title: Secrets Declassified with David Duchovny
items.synopsis: From black ops and bizarre experiments to deadly cover-ups and nefarious gadgets, David Duchovny pulls the curtain back on all the government secrets in modern history we always suspected, but were never given the answers to.

items.title: Secrets of the Penguins
items.synopsis: Over two extraordinary years, National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovered never-before-filmed secret traditions, surprising intelligence and close-knit societies of penguins. This astonishing series reveals they are more like us than we ever dreamed, from their powerful friendships to the courageous risk-takers using ingenuity and innovation in some of the world's most extreme places.

items.title: Secrets of the Royal Traditions
items.synopsis: Revealing how the monarchy uses traditions to maintain a place in the British nation's identity.

items.title: Seducing Drake Palma
items.synopsis: With over 125 million reads on Wattpad, this hit story follows Alys, a bubbly girl who agrees to seduce the mysterious Drake Palma to help her best friend. But as their pretend relationship starts to feel real, Alys is torn between loyalty and unexpected love.

items.title: Serendipity
items.synopsis: Kehilangan ingatan setelah jatuh dari tebing, Jian Ming Shu lolos dari tragedi yang menimpa keluarganya dan mendapat perlindungan dari Lu Chang, kekasihnya. Namun, misteri identitasnya mulai terungkap seiring waktu. Apakah ia akan menemukan jati diri sebenarnya?

items.title: Serial Homicide
items.synopsis: Kota Luzhou diguncang kasus pembunuhan berantai yang mengatasnamakan menegakkan keadilan. Polisi membentuk Tim Khusus 909 untuk menyelidiki. Perlahan, mereka mengungkap rencana tukar-bunuh yang mengerikan…

items.title: Seventeen: Our Chapter
items.synopsis: Answers discovered through endless questioning, never-ending challenges and performances, and the stories shared with CARATs. This 10th-anniversary documentary series captures SEVENTEEN's candid stories.

items.title: Shadow Detective
items.synopsis: Pada awal tahun 1930-an, sebuah kasus kematian misterius yang menimpa seorang mahasiswi di asrama perempuan terjadi di Shanghai. Inspektur Kantor Polisi Pusat, Guan Cen, kemudian berkenalan dengan Lu Yizhen, seorang mahasiswi yang gemar membaca novel detektif. Pertemuan itu tanpa sengaja menyeret mereka ke dalam kasus penculikan anak perempuan yang terjadi tujuh belas tahun sebelumnya.\NDua tahun kemudian, Lu Yizhen mengikuti seleksi untuk menjadi salah satu anggota angkatan pertama polisi wanita di Shanghai, sementara Guan Cen menjadi atasan langsungnya. Di kantor polisi yang terus menghadapi berbagai kasus, keduanya bekerja sama membuka kembali penyelidikan kasus penculikan anak itu, menyingkap kabut dan mimpi buruk yang selama ini menyelimuti mereka.

items.title: Shadow Love
items.synopsis: Drama ini menceritakan tentang Li Shuang, seorang jenderal wanita dari Dinasti Jin yang secara kebetulan menemukan seorang pria yang hilang ingatan, kemudian menamainya Jin An. Jin An dengan sepenuh hati menemani Li Shuang, dan benih-benih cinta pun tumbuh di antara mereka. Namun, tanpa diduga, Jin An secara bertahap mulai mengingat identitas aslinya: ia adalah seorang pangeran dari kerajaan musuh. Kedua insan yang pernah berjanji untuk menghabiskan hidup bersama ini kini terpaksa berhadapan di medan perang. Karena sudah sama-sama lelah dengan peperangan, mereka memutuskan untuk bekerja sama dalam menyelesaikan krisis dan mempertahankan keadilan dalam hati mereka.

items.title: Shark: The Storm
items.synopsis: An action noir about the life of Cha Woo-sol, who was born again after meeting martial arts champion Jeong Do-hyeon in a juvenile prison.

items.title: She Is the Phoenix
items.synopsis: Jiang Leyao dikhianati dan mati tragis setelah menikah ke keluarga kaya. Tapi ia terbangun di masa lalu! Kali ini, sahabatnya merebut tempatnya sebagai pengantin elit. Namun Leyao tak akan diam—ia kembali untuk membalas dendam dan mengungkap rahasia besar di balik semua ini.

items.title: Shendu Fox Detective
items.synopsis: Serangkaian pembunuhan mengejutkan terjadi di kota Luoyang dengan korban para gadis muda. Hu Zhengyi dari Dali Temple ditugaskan menyelidiki, sementara pemuda Li Jianxing mendekatinya untuk mengungkap tragedi keluarganya. Bersama teman-teman baru, mereka menghadapi kasus misterius penuh bahaya dan rahasia.

items.title: Sheriff Country
items.synopsis: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

items.title: Shifting Gears
items.synopsis: Matt is a stubborn, widowed owner of a classic car restoration shop. When Matt's estranged daughter Riley and her teenage kids move into his house, the real restoration begins.

items.title: Shin's Project
