During their journey to Beishuo's capital city, they face numerous assassination attempts. Their connecting jade pendant activates a Time Gate, allowing Yueling and Zhou Shiyu to repeatedly revive and strive to change their destiny while addressing their nation's challenges.

items.title: JK to roppozensho
items.synopsis:
Sakuragi Miyabi is a high school student in Aomori. She lives with her lawyer grandfather and receives special education from him in the field of law. Sakuragi Miyabi soon becomes the youngest person to pass the bar exam on their first try. A decision is then made to send Sakuragi Miyabi to her grandmother in Tokyo, who works as a director of a law office.

Sakuragi Miyabi begins to work as an apprentice lawyer at her grandmother’s law office. Despite her position, she still has the mindset of a teenager and sometimes has disagreements with senior lawyers. Meanwhile, Sakuragi Miyabi begins classes at her new high school in Tokyo. She hides her lawyer job from people at her high school, but she eventually begins to give counseling at her school on law matters.

items.title: Joan
items.synopsis: A penniless mother makes an impulsive decision in the jewellery shop where she works, and is propelled into a different world.

items.title: Jorik
items.synopsis: Jorik (Lil Kleine) was cancelled in 2021 after allegations of assault against his ex-girlfriend. How has his life, personally and as an artist, been ever since? In this three-part documentary, for the very first time we hear Jorik's side of the story as we delve deeper into all the problems he faces and provide a unique glimpse into Jorik's controversial life.

items.title: Judge Dee's Mystery
items.synopsis: Due to government shuffle during the reign of Wu Zetian, the ambitious Di Renjie was relegated to a remote town in the east. Di showed extraordinary talent in case-solving, but as he probed further, more and more secrets were revealed. He embarked on a nationwide journey and solved many mysterious cases. In the end, he returned to Chang'an and reunited with his father. Together, they tackled a crisis that threatened peace and order.

items.title: Jurassic World: Chaos Theory
items.synopsis: Geng Camp Cretaceous berkumpul untuk mengungkap sebuah misteri ketika mereka menemukan konspirasi global yang membahayakan para dinosaurus—dan diri mereka sendiri.

items.title: K-Pop Idols
items.synopsis: Akses langsung untuk melihat perjuangan di balik kemewahan para artis mancanegara. Dengan menempuh suka dan duka, Jessi, CRAVITY, dan BLACKSWAN berjuang keras demi kesenian yang menuntut kesempurnaan.

items.title: Kanojo to Kareshi no akarui mirai
Kaulitz & Kaulitz
items.synopsis: Saudara kembar sekaligus superstar, Tom dan Bill Kaulitz, mengajak kita mengintip kehidupan pribadi mereka di LA dan Jerman dalam serial realitas yang lucu dan intim ini.

items.title: Kayangan
items.synopsis: Habil, television host and lecturer has secrets. One, his father was a movie star. Two, the hero his father played was not fiction and Habil is heir to his father's mystic powers. Along with Ana, Bob and Zain, they assist Captain Jabbar and Vicky from the BASE task force to save citizens from Kayangan's threats.

items.title: Kill Me Love Me
items.synopsis: In a land torn by war, the three kingdoms of Dayan, Xiyan, and Nanyue have battled for years. Prince Murong Jinghe of Dayan, renowned for his military prowess, suffers a devastating betrayal, leading to the annihilation of his army. Determined to uncover the truth behind the treachery, he seeks justice while navigating the treacherous court politics. Amid this turmoil, Mei Lin, a warrior presumed dead, becomes Murong’s only ally in his quest for revenge. As they fight together, a complex bond forms between them, blending love and sacrifice, as they both struggle to survive and seek justice.

items.title: Kimi ga Kemono ni Naru Mae ni
Kiss Me, Save Me
items.synopsis: In the TV show "Fallen Peach Blossoms,” the supporting actress Weiwei, who played the malicious Director Xu, lived through full three episodes, the peak of her acting career. She gathered family and friends to watch the premiere, only to be shocked when she was executed by the eunuch Jiang Yu in the first episode. Furious, Weiwei confronted the producer, who arrogantly explained that everything was for the sake of the lead actress Dai Yao's character development. Weiwei fainted from anger, only to discover that she could travel between the show and reality whenever she fell asleep. Rising from the depths of the palace well as the villainous Director Xu, she vowed to live a long life and take control of her own destiny!

items.title: Kite Man: Hell Yeah!
items.synopsis: Lovable loser Kite Man and his new squeeze Golden Glider moonlight as criminals to support their foolish purchase of Noonan's, Gotham's seediest dive bar, where everybody knows your name, but not necessarily your secret identity!

items.title: Klara
items.synopsis: The crazy girl involved in an affair with a married man? Drinking, smoking and taking pills? Partying with her friend Wronka? Talking to her cat? Arguing with her eternally dissatisfied mother? Klara who has no husband, children or dog? Klara who can’t sleep, Klara, who is many years old and has little time, Klara, who is a little afraid but has great courage to live, Klara, for whom love is more important than reason, and good sex is more important than a good name? Klara’s Great Return!”

items.title: Knuckles
items.synopsis: Knuckles embarks on a hilarious and action-packed journey of self-discovery as he agrees to train Wade as his protégé and teach him the ways of the Echidna warrior.

items.title: Kururi: Dare ga Watashi to Koi wo Shita?
La Maison
items.synopsis: Fesyen berkelas berpadu dengan drama menarik dalam amatan terhadap rahasia di balik rumah mode papan atas Prancis yang ikonis ini. Ketika dinasti keluarga di balik rumah tersebut terjerumus ke dalam suatu skandal, mereka harus menemukan cara untuk mengubah diri mereka... atau mereka akan dihancurkan para pesaing.

items.title: La Palma
items.synopsis: Sebuah keluarga Norwegia yang berlibur di La Palma menghadapi bencana saat seorang peneliti muda menemukan tanda-tanda mengkhawatirkan akan terjadi letusan gunung berapi.

items.title: Lady in the Lake
items.synopsis: Saat hilangnya gadis muda mencekam kota Baltimore tahun 1966, kehidupan dua wanita bersatu dalam suatu benturan yang fatal.

items.title: Lady Revenger Returns From the Fire
items.synopsis: Luo Ailian, the gentle eldest daughter of the Luo family, loses everything in a sudden disaster, plunging her from wealth into despair. Reborn from the ashes as Shen Danqing, she embarks on a journey of revenge against those who wronged her. Along the way, she crosses paths with General Xu, who is searching for a lost treasure, raising his suspicions and complicating her path to vengeance. As their lives intertwine, they form a bond of mutual support, navigating a thrilling battle of wits and courage.

items.title: Laid
items.synopsis: A woman finds out her former lovers are dying in unusual ways and must go back through her sex timeline to confront her past in order to move forward.

items.title: Land of Tanabata
items.synopsis: Yoji Minamimaru, known as Nanmaru, is a university student with a supernatural ability to create small holes in anything. One day, Yoji finds out that the professor of folklore studies has gone missing. Together with his classmates, he decides to search for the professor.

items.title: Land of Women
items.synopsis: Seorang sosialita asal New York terpaksa mengungsi ke kota anggur Spanyol yang menawan bersama ibu dan putrinya. Dia harus menghadapi keanehan di kota kecil tersebut dan rahasia terdalam keluarganya... serta sepasang pembunuh bayaran yang kikuk.

items.title: Landman
items.synopsis: Set in the proverbial boomtowns of West-Texas and a modern-day tale of fortune-seeking in the world of oil rigs, the series is an upstairs/downstairs story of roughnecks and wildcat billionaires that are fueling a boom so big it’s reshaping our climate, our economy and our geopolitics.

items.title: Last Days of the Space Age
items.synopsis: It's the end of an era, and everything is about to change. History is at a turning point, with a global beauty pageant contest creating a media frenzy. But that's nothing compared to the drama three seemingly ordinary families are enduring, in a town which will never be the same.

items.title: Law & Order Toronto: Criminal Intent
items.synopsis: An elite squad of detectives investigate high-profile crime and corruption in metro Toronto.

items.title: Let Wind Goes By
items.synopsis: In 2003, a small mining town in Ningxia faces relocation when a burned body appears, echoing an unsolved case from a decade earlier. Veteran detective Chu Zhiqiang teams up with Zhang Tao, a reassigned investigator, to uncover the truth as the town prepares for relocation.

items.title: Liars in Love
items.synopsis: It tells the story of a girl who, upon learning that the orphanage where she grew up as a child is to be demolished because of a company project, decides to enter the business world to get closer to the Chu family heir.

items.title: Light of My Lion
items.synopsis: The appearance of a mysterious little boy interrupts the quiet, predictable life shared by an artist with autism and his caring older brother.

items.title: Light Shop
items.synopsis: Yang hidup dan yang mati berpotongan seperti dunia ini dan akhirat terhubung melalui toko yang menjual pencahayaaan.

items.title: Like a Dragon: Yakuza
items.synopsis: Berlatar kota fiksi Kamurocho, kisah berlangsung dalam dua garis waktu yang berkaitan - 1995 dan 2005. Tahun 1995, empat sahabat yang ingin lari dari kehidupan yang penuh keterbatasan di panti asuhan dan terjun ke dunia bawah tanah yang dikuasai yakuza di Kamurocho. Sementara itu, tahun 2005, persahabatan mereka memburuk, karena ketegangan Klan Tojo dan Aliansi Omi mencapai puncaknya.

items.title: Like Water for Chocolate
items.synopsis: Tita de la Garza and Pedro Muzquiz are two souls in love who cannot be together due to deep-rooted family customs, which will force Tita to navigate with magical tints and flavors between the destiny dictated by her family and the fight for her love, while we accompany her in her greatest refuge: the kitchen.

items.title: Live Surgery Room (Shou shu zhi bo jian)
Lojja
items.synopsis: Jaya, a meek homemaker, has been subjected to relentless verbal abuse by her husband over the years. As she confronts society's stifling expectations of women to raise her voice against the abuse, her life becomes a battleground in her quest to regain her self-esteem.

items.title: Lost in the Shadows
items.synopsis: In the 1990s, on a night filled with thunder and lightning, a small county town called Zhaoyang witnessed the mysterious pursuit and uncertain fate of a teenager. Two other boys who disappeared with him also vanished without a trace. Three years later, one of the boys reemerged as a "little pickpocket," pretending to have lost his memory and returned to his family. Behind the successful recognition, is it a reunion or a continuation of a mistake? Surprisingly, the seemingly reunited family still harbors secrets and threats. An old police officer conducts a covert investigation, and after a cat-and-mouse chase, clues about the whereabouts of the other two missing boys begin to emerge. The truths behind multiple disappearances, human trafficking, manslaughter, and murder cases gradually come to light. As the mystery unravels, the old police officer and the "missing boy" achieve mutual redemption, wrapping this suspenseful narrative into a story about family ties.

items.title: Love at First Night
items.synopsis: A geologist has an immediate connection with an architect, but when he learns that she's arranged to marry his dad, his life gets even more complicated.

items.title: Love Deadline
items.synopsis: Looking for true love, women meet potential husbands while traveling to scenic locales. The catch? Only women can propose, while men are on the clock.

items.title: Love Game in Eastern Fantasy
items.synopsis: Pulled into the pages of a fantasy novel, a woman is shocked to find herself stuck in the role of a villain. Now, she must battle to rewrite her destiny.

items.title: Love in the Crossfire
items.synopsis: After Sheng’s defeat in war, Princess Sheng Leling is ambushed and dies, leaving her physician, A Yue, to pose as her and infiltrate the Yu royal family. Meanwhile, Prince Chu Ruheng, shamed by his mother’s mysterious death, seeks answers. Amid palace intrigue and betrayal, the fake princess and disgraced prince form a fragile bond to fight for justice, peace, and survival.

items.title: Love in the Desert
items.synopsis: In the vast desert, three cities stand in a delicate balance of power, with a turbulent political landscape filled with constant conflict. The most beautiful woman of the desert, Princess Huang Beishuang of a fallen clan, is unexpectedly chosen as the envoy for a peace marriage and sent to Yunpei City. Along the way, she becomes entangled with three influential men of the desert. What begins as a complex game of mutual manipulation turns into a love-hate struggle between the rebellious "black lotus" and the three powerful figures of the desert. Refusing to be a pawn of fate, Huang Beishuang uses her intelligence, bravery, and unwavering determination to establish her place in the perilous desert. In the process, she develops romantic feelings for the northern lord, Huo Qingyun. The stunning beauty embarks on a dream-like journey through the desert, navigating a web of illusions and dangers as she stirs up the winds of change in her quest for dominance.

items.title: Love Is Blind: Sweden
items.synopsis: Eksperimen kencan yang unik ini hadir di Swedia saat para lajang setempat mencari cinta sejati dan mengajukan lamaran pernikahan—bahkan sebelum saling bertatap muka.

items.title: Love Is Blind: UK
items.synopsis: Emma dan Matt Willis memandu eksperimen sosial tempat para lajang Inggris mencari cinta dan bertunangan sebelum bertemu muka. Siapa yang akhirnya akan menikah?

items.title: Love Lesson 010
items.synopsis: Non, a notorious playboy who avoids commitment, has his life transformed after Kanta, a mysterious woman carrying out a special mission, places a supernatural curse on him.

items.title: Love Next Door
items.synopsis: Arsitek muda terkenal Choi Seung-hyo menjalankan atelier "In." Bae Seok-ryu, teman masa kecilnya, bergabung kembali dengan kehidupannya setelah berhenti dari pekerjaan perusahaannya, memunculkan kembali kenangan yang lebih suka dia lupakan dari ikatan masa kecil mereka yang aneh.

items.title: Love of Nirvana
items.synopsis: Xiao Wuxia, the young lord of Yueluo City, has been living in hiding in Liang Kingdom under the alias Wei Zhao, bearing the shame of being labeled a traitor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his family’s downfall and capture the sole survivor of Prince Qi’s case. However, his plans are derailed by the unexpected arrival of Jiang Ci. Pei Yan takes the injured Jiang Ci into his home, aiming to discover who’s behind the disruption. As they spend time together, Jiang Ci’s innocence and Wei Zhao’s tragic past and sense of national duty spark mutual affection. In the end, Wei Zhao, Jiang Ci, and Pei Yan set aside their personal grievances to unite against the Liang Emperor, achieving their goal of protecting Yueluo City and establishing a just world.

items.title: Love Song for Illusion
items.synopsis: The Crown Prince discovers that his new concubine is actually a vengeful assassin intent on killing the King. But will love intercede – and bring them together?

items.title: Love Song in Winter
items.synopsis: Jiang Chengyi dan ahli anestesi wanita Lu Yan, yang secara tak terduga bersatu kembali setelah delapan tahun berpisah, dan menyelesaikan kesalahpahaman mereka saat mereka bekerja sama untuk memecahkan kasus pembunuhan berantai. Sejak ahli anestesi Lu Yan “bertemu” dengan teman kuliahnya yang telah meninggal beberapa tahun yang lalu, Deng Man saat sif malam, hal-hal aneh terjadi secara berurutan di sekitarnya. Saat penyelidikan berlanjut, polisi kiriminal Jiang Chengyi , mantan pacar Lu Yan bertahun-tahun yang lalu, juga terlibat di dalamnya.

items.title: Love Your Enemy
items.synopsis: Born on the same day and with the same name, Seok Ji-won and Yoon Ji-won have been enemies for generations, and reunite after 18 years.

items.title: Love's Rebellion aka Reborn for Love
Love, Andante
items.synopsis:
Love Andante unfolds in the tranquil yet tense setting of the Korean DMZ, where two contrasting souls find themselves drawn together. Following the formal end of the Korean War, the two Koreas established the Pyeonghwa Village in Goseong, Gangwon Province.

Im Ju-hyeong, a prodigious pianist seeking respite from his demanding career, retreats to this haven. There he encounters Ha Na-gyeong, a holder of Ph.D. in Hydroponics and the pragmatic daughter of a high-ranking North Korean officer. As they navigate their lives in this village founded on hope and peace, their shared experiences and unexpected bond blossom into a poignant love story, bridging the divide between two worlds.

items.title: Lovely Runner
items.synopsis: Tepat setelah Ryu Sun-jae, seorang bintang top, mengakhiri hidupnya, Im Sol, penggemar beratnya, entah bagaimana terlempar ke masa ketika mereka masih duduk di bangku SMA dan mencoba melindunginya. Sebuah kisah romantis fantasi pun terungkap di mana orang-orang yang terpisah di masa lalu akhirnya bertemu.

items.title: Lovesickness
items.synopsis: An ordinary girl, Mo An'an, accidentally travels back a thousand years and meets Xiao Chu, a powerful duke of the Chu state whose influence spans the entire court. To change Xiao Chu's fate of being harmed by treacherous individuals, Mo An'an travels through time three times, experiencing a thousand years of angsty romance with Xiao Chu.

items.title: Maamla Legal Hai
items.synopsis: Kekacauan beradu dengan peraturan hukum di Pengadilan Distrik Patparganj, tempat para pegawai unik bekerja untuk menegakkan keadilan—tetapi bukannya tanpa keberatan.

items.title: Making It in Marbella
items.synopsis: Para agen asal Swedia di firma real estat Homerun Brokers bersaing memperebutkan properti terbaik di destinasi liburan mewah Spanyol, Marbella.

items.title: Married aka Hun nei Hun wai
Marry My Husband
items.synopsis: Kang Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, is killed by her husband and best friend after she witnesses them having an affair. She wakes up 10 years before the incident and decides to seek revenge with the help of Yu Ji-hyuk, a director at the company where she works. Now, she must reclaim her fate and eliminate the trash from her life.

items.title: Marry You
items.synopsis: A civil servant skeptical of marriage on a government team tasked with promoting marriage struggles to find a partner for a rural bachelor in order to escape the team.

items.title: Master of the House
items.synopsis: Terjadi perebutan kekuasaan di sebuah keluarga setelah kepala keluarga mereka wafat meninggalkan kerajaan berlian—dan asisten rumah tangga yang baru dinikahinya.

items.title: Masters of the Air
items.synopsis: Semasa Perang Dunia II, para pilot mempertaruhkan nyawa mereka dengan Grup Pengeboman ke-100, persaudaraan yang ditempa oleh keberanian, kehilangan, dan kemenangan.

items.title: Masters of the Universe: Revolution
items.synopsis: He-Man dan teman-temannya balik melawan kekuatan gelap Skeletor dalam pertarungan epik antara teknologi dan sihir untuk melindungi Eternia.

items.title: Matlock
items.synopsis: After achieving success in her younger years, the brilliant septuagenarian Madeline Matlock rejoins the workforce at a prestigious law firm where she uses her unassuming demeanor and wily tactics to win cases and expose corruption from within. Inspired by the classic television series of the same name.

items.title: Maxton Hall: The World Between Us
items.synopsis: When Ruby unwittingly witnesses an explosive secret at Maxton Hall private school, the arrogant millionaire heir James Beaufort has to deal with the quick-witted scholarship student for better or worse: He is determined to silence Ruby. Their passionate exchange of words unexpectedly ignites a spark...

items.title: Meet Love in Chong Qing
items.synopsis: After her boyfriend cheats and her company fails, Tian Ningmeng returns to her hometown, where she meets Jiaotang, who helps her clear her debts. Together, they embark on an emotional and comedic entrepreneurial journey, unaware that their destinies are already connected.

items.title: Men in Love
items.synopsis:
The self-disciplined and diligent editor-in-chief of a magazine, Ye Han, helped the clumsy and lovely physical education teacher Li Xiaoxiao resolve embarrassing crises again and again by chance. Due to past experiences, it was difficult to take the step of love.

The enthusiastic and direct magazine publisher Xu Jiacheng met their former model sister Tong Yiwen. The two continued to seek balance in their pursuit of love and career.

items.title: Mickey & Minnie's Christmas Carols
items.synopsis: Join Mickey, Santa, & pals for five stop-motion Christmas shorts: "Jingle Bells," "Deck the Halls," "We Wish You A Merry Christmas," “12 Days of Christmas," & “Hot Dog! Christmas."

items.title: Midnight Family
items.synopsis: Marigaby adalah seorang mahasiswi kedokteran pada siang hari, dan pada malam hari, dia menyelamatkan nyawa bersama keluarganya di bisnis ambulans pribadi Mexico City yang berisiko tinggi. Saat tekanan dari kedua dunia membebaninya, Marigaby akan melakukan apa pun untuk tetap bertahan.

items.title: Midsummer Night
items.synopsis: Carina menyatukan keluarganya untuk merayakan tradisi Midsummer Swedia, tetapi acara bahagia itu justru kacau saat berbagai rahasia yang lama terpendam mulai terkuak.

items.title: Misplacement
items.synopsis: Singer Shen Zhiqiu infiltrates the powerful Yin family to uncover the truth behind her sister's betrayal. Unexpectedly engaged to Yin Heng, the third master, she navigates the family's dangers to deliver a masterful act of revenge.

items.title: Miss Night and Day aka She's Different from Day to Night
Miss You Forever
items.synopsis: Li Mengjue and Xie Jingshu, bound by a temporary marriage yet hiding secret agendas, must join forces to unravel dark conspiracies linked to a deadly past and expose the true enemies.

items.title: Missing Crown Prince
items.synopsis: A political drama set in Joseon dynasty about two relationships that fate has set in a tragic path, yet they fought against all odds.

items.title: Moments of Youth
items.synopsis: "Sick Cat" Chen Ting, a freshman at Xicheng Technical School, secretly changes his major from cooking to auto-repairing in order to resist his father's harsh discipline. He thus becomes acquainted with a group of friends, including "Page Boy Hao," a junior who is keen to create avant-garde fashion, and "Shark Zhen," a locomotive girl who is eager to go to Hong Kong to pursue her dream. Seven small partners hand in hand with each other to face difficulties of growth, eventually help "Shark Zhen" achieve distant dreams, and also let "Sick Cat" find his own ideals step by step and grow into a truly responsible teenager.

items.title: Monsieur Spade
items.synopsis: Detective Sam Spade is pulled out of his tranquil retirement in France to investigate a series of brutal murders.

items.title: Moon Love
items.synopsis: Yun Chaoyan, a girl who is haunted by the renegade immortal, happens to meet Ren Shique, the lunar god who recaptures the renegade immortal. In order to get rid of the renegade immortal, Yun Chaoyan tries every possible means to get entangled with Ren Shique, and the two begin a fantastical lifelong journey together.

items.title: Mountains
items.synopsis: Adventurer Zhang Beichen, martial artist Duan Siyan, ghostly healer Wei Linger, and horseman Ma Tianhong set out to uncover the mystery behind the Golden Crow phenomenon. Along their journey, they encounter strange events, confronting the darker sides of human nature—greed, anger, and obsession—while also discovering the deep bonds that connect people.

items.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
items.synopsis: Perkenalkan keluarga Smith: dua orang asing yang kesepian, John dan Jane, yang telah menyerahkan hidup dan identitasnya untuk menjadi pasangan – baik dalam spionase maupun pernikahan.

items.title: Mr. McMahon
items.synopsis: WWE mengalami masa keemasan yang memecahkan rekor & masa terburuk di bawah kepemimpinan Vince McMahon. Serial dokumenter ini mengupas kekuasaan kontroversial sang taipan.

items.title: Mr. Plankton
items.synopsis: Seorang pria yang terus didera kemalangan dan mantannya, calon pengantin yang paling tak beruntung, terpaksa saling menemani dalam perjalanan terakhir hidup pria itu.

items.title: Murder in a Small Town
items.synopsis: Karl Alberg moves to a quiet coastal town to soothe a psyche that has been battered by big-city police work but finds himself needing to call upon all his skills to solve the murders that continue to wash up on his shore.

items.title: My Boss
items.synopsis: Cheng Yao, aspiring to be a lawyer, joins a top law firm and moves into an apartment near work—only to discover her housemate is her new boss, Qian Heng. Initially harsh and suspicious, Qian Heng puts her through rigorous training, believing she got the job through connections. As Cheng Yao proves her talent and determination, she changes his impression, and a reluctant admiration slowly turns into romance.

items.title: My Diary
items.synopsis: Five young people from different backgrounds and facing unique struggles meet by chance and gradually find a place where they truly belong.

items.title: My Lady Jane
items.synopsis: Gird your loins for the tragic tale of Lady Jane Grey, the young Tudor noblewoman who was Queen of England for nine days and then beheaded, back in good ol’ 1553. Actually... f*ck that. We’re retelling history the way it should have happened: the damsel in distress saves herself. This is an epic tale of true love and high adventure set in an alt-universe of action, history, fantasy, comedy, romance, and rompy-pompy. Buckle up.

items.title: My Military Valentine
items.synopsis: After decades of tension, peace has come to the Korean Peninsula. To mark the start of the new North-South Korean peacetime, top South Korean star Lloyd heads to the DMZ to perform a concert, but a misunderstanding forces North Korean special forces soldier Baek Young Ok to step in. Fans capture their interaction and the public mistakes it for a romantic moment. A scandal breaks out, and Lloyd’s fans are outraged. In desperation, he joins the military… only to find himself in a unit led by Young Ok! Could romance bloom between this unlikely pair?

items.title: My Name Is Gabriel
items.synopsis: A program where you live 'the real life of that person' for 72 hours under the name of one of the world's 8 billion people in a place where no one knows you.

items.title: My Piggy Boss
items.synopsis: Junior corporate worker Yang Xiao Zhu unexpectedly became the executive assistant to Zhu Xiao Yang, the president of a color light manufacturing company, who has to be at work every morning at six o'clock.

items.title: My Precious
items.synopsis: A night between an unhappy housewife and her old friend results in her pregnancy, but she tells her husband that the baby's his!

items.title: My Special Girl aka Du yi you er de ta
My Sweet Mobster
items.synopsis: Once a convict, Ji-hwan is now a successful, albeit overly cautious CEO, who has yet to experience any of life’s more enjoyable pleasures: namely falling in love. But all that changes when fate brings beloved children’s content creator Eun-ha into his life. The unlikely pair find love most unexpectedly but Eun-ha’s longtime fan, Prosecutor Hyun-woo isn’t ready to let her go without a fight.

items.title: My Wife's Double Life
items.synopsis: Master thief Liu Rong assumes a false identity to marry straight-laced inspector Xu Muchen and infiltrate the Xu family in search of a priceless jade pendant. But as secrets unravel and suspicions rise, their calculated sham marriage turns into a high-stakes game of deception—and unexpected desire.

items.title: Nafsu
items.synopsis: Searching for a missing teenager, a con artist finds himself battling mystical threats from a shadowy cult led by an enigmatic figure.

items.title: Namib
items.synopsis: Former producer Kang Soo-hyun and discarded trainee Yoo Jin-woo join forces, each pursuing their dreams amid challenges and new opportunities.

items.title: Nautilus
items.synopsis: The origin story of the iconic Captain Nemo: an Indian Prince robbed of his birthright and family, a prisoner of the East India Mercantile Company and a man bent on revenge against the forces that have taken everything from him.

items.title: NCIS: Origins
items.synopsis: In 1991, years prior to the events of NCIS, Leroy Jethro Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office, where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.

items.title: No Gain No Love
items.synopsis: Romansa yang saling menguntungkan antara seorang wanita yang menikah untuk menghindari kerugian dan seorang pria yang menikah untuk menghindari masalah.

items.title: No Good Deed
items.synopsis: Penjualan rumah Paul dan Lydia di LA memaksa mereka untuk menghadapi rahasia keluarga yang memilukan—dan menyembunyikannya dari para pengintai serta pembeli yang kejam.

items.title: No One Will Miss Us
items.synopsis: It's the '90s, and five losers run an illegal business at their high school. They sell homework and assignments to their classmates. The advantage is that no one ever suspects the nerds. Their business brings them money and popularity. But hormones and an unexpected death threaten to ruin everything. If the business collapses, their futures and their friendships are at risk.

items.title: Nobody Wants This
items.synopsis: Penyiar podcast seks agnostik jatuh cinta kepada rabi yang baru melajang. Akankah hubungan mereka berhasil mengingat kehidupan yang berbeda dan keluarga yang ikut campur?

items.title: Nothing Uncovered aka Let's Get Grabbed by the Collar
OceanXplorers
items.synopsis: Traveling aboard the OceanXplorer, OceanX's state-of-the-art scientific research and exploration vessel, to investigate the farthest frontiers of the world's oceans, 80% of which are entirely unknown.  Armed with advanced technology, a hand-picked team of intrepid explorers and scientists, National Geographic Explorers and other ocean experts embark on a global odyssey to solve some of the ocean's greatest mysteries through the lives of its animals and their ecosystems.

items.title: Oderbruch
items.synopsis: The sinister discovery of numerous murder victims shocks the Oderbruch region. The serial murder case brings Detective Roland Voit to his hometown to work with Polish police officer Stanislaw Zajak. Voit’s former colleague and childhood sweetheart, Maggie Kring, is also called in to join the police investigation when her family comes under immediate suspicion. In their investigation, Maggie and Voit delve deep into their own past to finally uncover the true circumstances of the death of Maggie’s brother and the sinister truth of this case, which lies beyond human imagination.

items.title: Okura: Cold Case Investigation
items.synopsis: In a department known as “Okura” where misfits assemble, a pair of detectives with a generational gap work together, using the slightest clues to get closer to the truth behind each case.

items.title: Omnivore
items.synopsis: Dari ladang garam Peru sampai hutan kopi Rwanda, jelajahi dan rayakan bahan pangan yang membangun masyarakat, membentuk kepercayaan, dan mengubah kemanusiaan.

items.title: Omukae Shibuya-kun
items.synopsis:
Shibuya Taikai is a popular young actor with excellent acting skills and a charming smile. Women are crazy about him, but Taikai has never been in love in his life. He has a 4-year-old sister named Rizumu, who attends nursery school.

One day, Rizumu comes back home with a scratch from the nursery school. Taikai is concerned enough that he passes up on a drama series acting offer and decides to take Rizumu to school and pick her up after school. At his sister's school, Taikai Shibuya meets Rizumu's teacher, Aota Aika. He gets attracted to her. Meanwhile, Aika is a devoted nursery school teacher who likes children. She has a warm heart and cares about other people.

items.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
items.synopsis: Di kota Macondo yang tak lekang oleh waktu, tujuh generasi keluarga Buendía menyusuri liku-liku cinta dan kehampaan, tanpa sanggup lepas dari masa lalu dan takdir mereka.

items.title: Only You in My Heart
items.synopsis:
This drama revolves around Ahmad Adif Rayqal, who marries Rian Aulia as part of a revenge plan against Rian’s father, Idris. Rian, on the other hand, easily falls in love with Adif because she sees him as a charismatic and mysterious young man who now works with Idris. Meanwhile, Afeeq, a close relative of Rian’s family, experiences jealousy due to Adif’s presence in Rian’s

life. Adif harbors resentment towards Idris due to past events involving his sister, Adelia. Despite seeking revenge, Adif still finds himself in love with Rian, leading to a dilemma between his feelings and the need to continue seeking justice for Adelia. Eventually, when all secrets are revealed, Rian, who now harbors resentment towards Adif, also faces a dilemma as she is now pregnant.

items.title: Original Sin
items.synopsis: Forensic expert Dai Yu and detective Zheng Ming team up to solve complex crimes involving strange disappearances, mysterious deaths, and an organ trafficking ring. As they confront personal challenges and dark twists, they both are pushed to grow while navigating the dangers of their work.

items.title: Oshinoko
items.synopsis: Two fans of pop idol Ai are reincarnated as her "secret" baby twins, Aqua and Ruby, and grow up supporting her until the tragic day she is stabbed by a stalker. Flash forward a few years later, and Aqua and Ruby are high-school students determined to make it on their own in the cut-throat world of entertainment for personal reasons.

items.title: Our Days
items.synopsis: The three daughters of Xiang Zhijun live in Shanghai, Kunshan, and Suzhou. Xiang Qian, 35, is established in her career; Xiang Zhong, 31, is actively pursuing her goals; and Xiang Nan, 26, is cheerful and optimistic. Despite facing personal challenges, the sisters support each other and grow through their experiences, guided by their parents' advice.

items.title: Our Interpreter
items.synopsis: Lin Xi, a rising star in the translation world, reunites with her ex-boyfriend, tech executive Xiao Yicheng, eight years after their breakup. Forced to work together on a major business deal, old feelings resurface as they confront the past and rediscover their shared dream of serving their country on the global stage.

items.title: Our Living World
items.synopsis: Serial alam memukau yang dinarasikan oleh Cate Blanchett ini menjelajahi inteligensi, kecerdikan, dan saling keterkaitan kehidupan di planet kita.

items.title: Our Parallel Universes
items.synopsis: This comedic anthology mini-series follows the dynamic duo of Long Aotian and Liu Bo as they bring humor and heart to diverse self-contained stories.

items.title: Ourika
items.synopsis: In 2005, in a French suburb, a drug bust shatters the network of a family of drug dealers. Driss, a brilliant student, is forced to take over the family business, setting off on a downward spiral. Facing him is William, an ambitious and idealistic young cop who will do everything in his power to stop him. Their relentless struggle will take them from the suburbs to the Ourika valley.

items.title: Owning Manhattan
items.synopsis: Raja real estat Ryan Serhant memimpin salah satu firma terbesar di New York dan mendorong para agennya untuk menjadi yang terbaik sambil menangani properti termahal.

items.title: Palm Royale
items.synopsis: Pada tahun 1969, seorang wanita ambisius bercita-cita untuk menembus batas antara si kaya dan si miskin untuk mendapatkan kursi di meja paling eksklusif, modis, dan berbahaya di Amerika: sosialita kelas atas Palm Beach.

items.title: Parasyte: The Grey
items.synopsis: Saat berbagai parasit tak dikenal mendapat kekuatan setelah mengambil alih tubuh inang manusia, umat manusia harus bangkit untuk melawan ancaman yang makin membesar itu.

items.title: Parole Examiner Lee aka Gaseogbang Simsagwan Lee Han Sin
Peaceful Property
items.synopsis: A wealthy heir inherits a portfolio of allegedly haunted properties, forcing him to team up with a chef who can see spirits after a near-fatal accident to clear the ghosts and save the family fortune.

items.title: Peacock in Wonderland
items.synopsis: Hua Ni, a physics expert, time-travels to Peacock City and becomes the holy envoy of the Peacock Sect, facing distrust and the assassin group Baihuasha. With help from Li Muyang, she uncovers Baihuasha's mission to protect the city and falls in love with him, only to face shocking truths as they prepare to marry.

items.title: Pegasus
items.synopsis: Zhang Chi, who is a professional racer, suffers a horrible accident at a race and gets seriously injured, leading to his waking up in the 21-year-old body of Lin Zhendong. He tries everything possible to prevent his 24-year-old self from repeating the same mistakes and helps Lin become a professional racer.

items.title: Penelope
items.synopsis: A restless teenager who questions her place in the world embarks on a soul-searching journey into the remote wilderness of the Pacific Northwest.

items.title: Perfect Family
items.synopsis: A seemingly happy and perfect family begins to suspect each other more and more as a result of their daughter's murder.

items.title: Perfect Her
items.synopsis: At the tenth wedding anniversary celebration of Bai Li and her husband, Ye Yun Kai, she meets her college junior, Su Yu. At this time, Su Yu is Ning Mo Chen's boyfriend. Ning Mo Chen schemes to let Bai Li find out that her husband is cheating with her. Later, Bai Li and the mistress fall into the water and their souls are accidentally exchanged. Bai Li wakes up with the mistress' soul and begins her revenge.

items.title: Phoenix Lands in the World
items.synopsis: Meng Xiaotang, an online author, is hired to rewrite her wuxia novel, "The Tale of Nan Xi." After altering the plot, she finds herself transported into the story, becoming the villain Feng Nanxi. Unable to access her powers, she must rely on a charming stranger, Shen Yu, as they navigate the dangers of the wuxia world.

items.title: Please Remember Me
items.synopsis: A Nian, a girl from the Ji tribe, meets a boy named Xiao Zifeng in her hometown of Susui, and they fall in love over time. However, their relationship faces unexpected challenges with the fall of her tribe, causing them to lose their memories of each other. A Nian adopts the name Xiao Man and enters the general’s mansion, where Xiao Zifeng, still without his memories, grows suspicious of her presence. Despite his doubts, he feels a strange sense of familiarity toward her, while Xiao Man begins to uncover secrets about him she never expected.

items.title: Ploy's Yearbook
items.synopsis: The love stories of five girls named Ploy: same name, same classroom, but completely different personalities. 'Ploy's Yearbook' takes viewers back to the era of flared skirts and shorts, an age filled with dreams and the bond of friends. What will happen when the friendgroup members cross paths again fifteen years later? Although many things may have changed, their hearts remain the same.

items.title: Poacher
items.synopsis: A group of Indian Forest Service officers, NGO workers, police constables and good samaritans risk their lives trying to track down the biggest elephant ivory poachers in the history of India and bring them to justice.

items.title: Postcards
items.synopsis: Saat seorang ibu tunggal asal Nigeria ini pergi ke India untuk keperluan pemeriksaan medis, perjalanannya akan menyentuh kehidupan setiap orang yang bertemu dengannya.

items.title: Present, Is Present
items.synopsis: Although Yuan Xia grew up in adversity, she always embraced beauty in her heart, and had a two-way relationship and salvation with Wei Ziqi, through time and space. In countless parallel universes, they saved and fell in love with each other.

items.title: Presumed Innocent
items.synopsis: Pembunuhan yang mengerikan menggaduhkan Kantor Kejaksaan Chicago ketika salah satu dari mereka dicurigai melakukan kejahatan tersebut dan menyebabkan si tertuduh harus berjuang untuk menjaga keutuhan keluarganya.

items.title: Pyramid Game
items.synopsis: Every last Thursday of the month at an all-girls high school, the students of Class 2–5 cast their votes in a popularity poll. The results classify them into Grades A, B, C, D, and F. If they fall into Grade F, they become legitimate victims of school violence.

items.title: Queen of Divorce
items.synopsis: Korea’s most skilled divorce solver and an eccentric lawyer who provides solutions for troubled marriages, punishing unfaithful spouses in the process.

items.title: Queen of Tears
items.synopsis: The queen of department stores and the prince of supermarkets weather a marital crisis—until love miraculously begins to bloom again.

items.title: Queen Woo
items.synopsis: Upon the announcement of the king's death in Goguryeo, a fierce battle ensues among tribes. Queen Woo, who immediately becomes the target of princes and five tribes vying for the throne, struggles to crown a new king within 24 hours. Will Queen Woo be able to transcend the constraints of gender and era to carve out her own destiny?

items.title: Quien lo mato? aka Who Killed Him
Raising Voices
items.synopsis: Ketika seorang siswi berusia 17 tahun melaporkan pelecehan seksual di SMA-nya, sebuah penyelidikan menjungkirbalikkan hidupnya dan menguji hubungan-hubungannya.

items.title: RAP:PUBLIC
items.synopsis:
RAP:PUBLIC (랩:퍼블릭) is a South Korean rap competition produced by Mnet with 60 contestants.

A real hip-hop survival show where players engage in a strategic survival competition using 'rap' as their weapon.

items.title: Ready, Set, Love
items.synopsis: Di dunia yang tengah berjuang mengatasi masalah penurunan populasi laki-laki, wanita sederhana ini menjadi penantang di suatu kompetisi kencan yang disponsori pemerintah.

items.title: Reblooming Blue
items.synopsis: Two ex-big city colleagues are reunited in a small town. Could they help each other solve their respective financial issues – and find love?

items.title: Red Queen
items.synopsis: Antonia Scott adalah wanita terpintar di dunia, kecerdasannya menjadikannya Ratu Merah dari proyek polisi rahasia. Setelah bebas tugas karena skors pendisiplinan, polisi Jon Gutiérrez - kuat, asli Basque, gay - mengubah kehidupan dan metodenya dalam kasus ganda penculikan dan pembunuhan yang menarik.

items.title: Red Swan
items.synopsis: Oh Wan-soo, who married into the powerful Hwain Group, faces death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do-yoon, a bodyguard investigating a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.

items.title: Regeneration
items.synopsis: Seorang jurnalis wanita bernama He Shan dan empat orang asing lainnya diundang bersama ke sebuah acara untuk mengenang Fei Ke. Mereka semua memiliki masa lalu yang tidak diketahui dengan Fei Ke, tetapi mereka menemukan bahwa Fei Ke yang mereka kenal bukanlah orang yang sama. Siapa Fei Ke sebenarnya? Orang-orang itu mulai melacak kembali masa lalu mereka dan perlahan-lahan mengungkap kebenaran tentang Fei Ke...

items.title: Renegade Nell
items.synopsis: England, 1705: Framed for murder and on the run with her sisters, Nell Jackson turns her hand to highway robbery to survive. Aided by her superpowered sidekick, a plucky little sprite called Billy Blind, Nell realizes that fate has put her on the wrong side of the law for a reason. A reason much bigger than she could have ever imagined: to defeat a magical plot against the Queen of England.

items.title: Rented in Finland
items.synopsis: What happens when four of Korea's biggest stars swap their city lights for the raw wilds of Lapland, where even electricity and running water are a luxury? Brace yourself for a hilarious journey as the City Boys experience the self-sufficient lifestyle of local residents.

items.title: Resurrected Rides
items.synopsis: Komedian Chris Redd bekerja sama dengan tim impian berisi para pakar mobil untuk menghidupkan kembali berbagai kendaraan usang dengan perombakan kustom yang menakjubkan.

items.title: Rick and Morty: The Anime
items.synopsis: It's life mostly as usual for the Smith family. Rick is in a pseudo-world, Summer helps Space Beth and Morty's in love. And they're all an anime.

items.title: Ripley
items.synopsis: Penipu ini terseret ke dunia penuh kemewahan dan privilese setelah menerima pekerjaan unik di Italia. Namun, ia harus merajut jaring kebohongan demi kehidupan impiannya.

items.title: Rivals
items.synopsis: It is 1986 and Britain is booming. "Rivals" dives headfirst into the cutthroat world of TV where hair-dos are big and ambitions are even bigger. Deals are brokered in boardrooms, as well as bedrooms. Nobody can be sure who will come out on top. With every man and woman out only for themselves, can true love really blossom?

items.title: Romance in the House
items.synopsis: After his business crashes, a man disappears from his family for 11 years. But when he makes a return as their wealthy landlord, a messy reunion ensues.

items.title: Romantic Boyfriend
items.synopsis: As the Lunar New Year nears, Qiu Feifei, fed up with marriage pressure, hires Ji Xuan, a drama student, to pose as her boyfriend. Her mother grows fond of him, but an unexpected event forces him to stay longer. With a new agreement in place, their charade continues, joined by friends Jin Mingming and her boyfriend, leading to a series of comical mishaps.

items.title: Rugged Rugby: Conquer or Die
items.synopsis: Di bawah dunia rugbi Korea yang samar, tujuh tim bertarung sengit menunjukkan kekuatan, strategi, dan kerja sama—semuanya demi memperebutkan gelar juara.

items.title: Ruyi
items.synopsis: Ye Ruyi is unexpectedly transported into a comic book as a minor, doomed character, where she encounters Zuo Qianchen, a fallen prince living a double life as a hero. Together, they move from mutual manipulation to redemption, awakening other characters and reshaping their fates to rewrite the story.

items.title: Saka no Ue no Akai Yane
Sanctuary: A Witch's Tale
items.synopsis: Set in a contemporary world where witchcraft is real, the story takes place in the idyllic English town of Sanctuary, where for hundreds of years witches have lived peacefully, as valued members of society. Until now…

items.title: Saudi Pro League: Kickoff
items.synopsis: Tonton aksi seru dalam serial dokumenter sepak bola nan mencekam ini saat para ikon internasional bersama bintang-bintang lokal mentransformasi liga di musim 2023/2024.

items.title: Say Nothing
items.synopsis: Through the eyes of various Irish Republican Army (IRA) members, explore the extremes some people will go to in the name of their beliefs, the way a deeply divided society can suddenly tip over into armed conflict, the long shadow of radical violence for both victims and perpetrators, and the emotional and psychological costs of a code of silence.

items.title: Sayonara Maestro: Chichi to Watashi no Appassionato
Scout Hero aka Zhen cha ying xiong
Secret Level
items.synopsis: Serial antologi animasi dewasa baru LEVEL RAHASIA menampilkan cerita-cerita asli dari beberapa gim video paling digemari di dunia. Kelima belas episode yang dibuat oleh para kreator LOVE, DEATH + ROBOTS didedikasikan untuk permainan dan para pemainnya.

items.title: Secret Makeover
items.synopsis: Mitsuko Motomiya (Haruka Fukuhara) is a mysterious total coordinator. To get what her client wants, she changes their visuals from head to toe and also their mentality through coaching. Using any means necessary, she always makes her client successful. Her next client is Natsu Imai, who is a single mother with a string of bad luck. Natsu Imai's aim is to become the president of a large company that is run by a family. Meanwhile, Mitsuko Motomiya has a secret.

items.title: Secrets of the Octopus
items.synopsis: Octopuses are like aliens on Earth: three hearts, blue blood and the ability to squeeze through a space the size of their eyeballs. But there is so much more to these weird and wonderful animals. Intelligent enough to use tools or transform their bodies to mimic other animals and even communicate with different species, the secrets of the octopus are more extraordinary than we ever imagined.

items.title: See Her Again
items.synopsis: While investigating a serial killer, a detective gets transported 25 years into the future – can he solve the case and return home?

items.title: Senna
items.synopsis: Tertarik dengan mobil sejak kecil, pembalap asal Brasil, Ayrton Senna, menjadi legenda olahraga—hingga sebuah tragedi terjadi, yang mengubah Formula 1 selamanya.

items.title: Seoul Busters
items.synopsis: Songwon Police Violent Crimes Unit 2 has the lowest arrest rate in the country. After their chief is demoted, the team is exiled to a closed daycare center. Enter Yubin, their new leader. Despite the team's initial distrust, Yubin and the team start to bond as they solve cases together.

items.title: Serendipity's Embrace
items.synopsis: After 10 years in the US, Hu-young returns to Korea and meets his first love, Hong-ju, at a café by chance. Just as the window into which Peter Pan flew happened to be Wendy's room. Just as the prince happened to find Cinderella's glass shoes. As if nothing had changed in the past 10 years, Hu-young becomes clumsier only in front of Hong-ju. It’s like going back to the age of 19 when he met his first love, Hong-ju. Hu-young and Hong-ju’s days, which have faded a little, begin to turn into vivid rainbow colors again.

items.title: Shameless Lover
items.synopsis: Shen Zhili embarks on a quest to revive her master using an ancient formula that requires a rare medicinal ingredient. When Su Chenche arrives, Shen Zhili is unexpectedly trapped in a time loop, discovering that each time Su Chenche dies, time resets. To complete the mission, the two set out together, navigating misunderstandings, a growing bond, and cryptic guidance from a mysterious figure in the shadows. Can they solve the riddle of the time loop and find the elusive ingredient?

items.title: She and Her Girls
items.synopsis: Zhang Guimei, a middle school teacher in China's western mountains, was determined to help girls escape the cycle of poverty after seeing many drop out due to financial struggles. She founded a free high school for girls, providing them with the opportunity for education and a better future. Despite ongoing challenges, her efforts continue to bring hope to girls from the mountains.

items.title: Simone Biles: Rising
items.synopsis: Pesenam Simone Biles harus menyeimbangkan kehidupan pribadi, perjalanan kesehatan mental, dan latihan menjelang kehadirannya kembali yang sangat dinantikan di Olimpiade.

items.title: Simple Days
items.synopsis: Gu Moli and Zhu Jincao struggled all the way from their hometown to set up a family of two in Shanghai. The marriage brought another problem that should not have been a problem - how they get along with their parents.

items.title: Sisters' Feud
items.synopsis: Penolakan seorang wanita terhadap rencana jahat saudarinya memicu pengkhianatan dan balas dendam saat ia mencoba bersatu lagi dengan putrinya yang lama hilang di penjara.

items.title: Six Nations: Full Contact
items.synopsis: Babak demi babak, pertandingan demi pertandingan, tim-tim rugbi terbaik di Eropa bertarung untuk membawa pulang piala Kejuaraan Enam Negara Guinness.

items.title: Smile Code
items.synopsis: Gu Yi is a stand-up comedian in Shanghai who juggles a day job and nighttime performances. Her simple goal is to make everyone laugh, but one day she encounters an audience member, Liang Daiwen, who seems immune to her humor. This leads to an unexpected clash between a woman driven by comedy and a man who never laughs.

items.title: Snowfall
items.synopsis: In Republican-era China, a century-old vampire survives a brutal assassination attempt with the help of a mortal blind girl. Both lonely souls, they soon find companionship amidst danger and chaos. But can their bond overcome their differences?

items.title: Snowy Night - Timeless Love
items.synopsis: The unrestrained swordsman Huo Zhanbai seeks medicine for a friend's child and encounters the pharmacist Xue Ziye. Over eight years of daily interaction, they progress from having their own convictions to deepening understanding, mutual redemption, and a promise to meet under a plum tree the following year. However, due to the responsibilities they bear, they find it difficult to express their love, leaving behind a regret of eternal separation. Amidst the joyous toasts in the snowy night and a farewell across a thousand miles, a poignant and unforgettable missed opportunity unfolds—a love destined to be unable to endure, depicting a tale of redemption and letting go in a life-and-death romance.

items.title: Sorry Not Sorry
items.synopsis: Set in 'Cheonpo New Town' under 'Cheondang', the story depicts the turbulent Cheonpo survival story of 'Jisongi', a disguised married woman who finds it difficult to love or get married.

items.title: Spice Up Our Love
items.synopsis: Novelis web khusus dewasa Nam Ja-yeon yang menulis serial No Gain No Love tiba-tiba secara ajaib tertukar dengan tokoh utama wanita dalam novelnya sendiri! Fantasi romansa yang tak terduga terjalin antara si penulis jomlo ini dan sang tokoh utama pria dalam novel romansanya, Kang Ha-jun.

items.title: St. Denis Medical
items.synopsis: An eclectic group of underfunded yet dedicated doctors and nurses navigates caring for patients — and each other — while keeping it all together at an Oregon hospital.

items.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire
items.synopsis: A journey into the fearsome Galactic Empire through the eyes of two warriors on divergent paths.

items.title: Starlight Boys
items.synopsis: Here, dazzling teenagers from all over the world gather to receive professional training at Starlight Academy, crossing the boundaries of language and culture and igniting the stage with their talent and passion. Through fierce competition and teamwork, they will compete for the opportunity to become a globally recognized super idol. Let’s witness how they are born from the starlight and become trendsetting stars!

items.title: Step by Step Love
items.synopsis: Space designer Bu Ran crosses paths with Lu Cenyang, a talented boss with a shared passion for design. Together, they navigate challenges, staying determined in pursuit of their dreams. Despite hardships, their passion never wavers, leading them to success and recognition in their industry.

items.title: Strange Notes
items.synopsis: In a bustling city, the House of Wonders offers mysterious items with extraordinary powers for visiting customers who seek solutions to their struggles.

items.title: Sugar
items.synopsis: Colin Farrell sebagai John Sugar, detektif ulung yang menelusuri sisi kelam LA. Meski selalu melihat sisi baik manusia, dia dihantui rahasia yang berbahaya jika terungkap.

items.title: Sukina Otoko to Wakaretai
items.synopsis: A woman nearing 30 struggles with doubts about her future, torn between leaving her unemployed boyfriend to seek stability in marriage and her true desire to stay with him, even as a coworker confesses his long-held feelings for her.

items.title: Summer Night
items.synopsis: School years should be the best time of our lives, but Lune spends his days invisible, no one taking an interest in him. At the start of a new summer, however, secrets are about to overturn his ordinary life.

items.title: Sunny
items.synopsis: Kehidupan seorang wanita Amerika yang tinggal di Kyoto, Jepang, berubah ketika suami dan putranya menghilang dalam kecelakaan pesawat misterius. Sebagai hiburan, dia diberikan Sunny, salah satu robot rumah tangga kelas baru yang dibuat oleh perusahaan elektronik suaminya.

items.title: Supacell
items.synopsis: Ketika lima penduduk biasa di London Selatan sadar mereka punya kekuatan luar biasa, seorang pria harus menyatukan mereka untuk menyelamatkan wanita yang ia cintai.

items.title: Sweet Trap
items.synopsis: Two young chefs pit their wits and culinary skills against one another. But as they begin their battle, might rivalry lose out to love?

items.title: Sweetpea
items.synopsis: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance. That is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control. Rhiannon's life transforms, but can she keep her killer secret?

items.title: Sword and Fairy
items.synopsis: The two amnesiac youths, Yue Jinzhao and Yue Qi, have been wandering the land in search of their identities and pasts, only for Yue Qi to lose all of her money to a member of the Risen Soul Cult. In the process of trying to recover the lost money, they meet up with Luo Zhouyan, the head of the "Evanescent" Luo family who is spearheading efforts in her region to destroy the cult and expose its crimes. As the Yue siblings and Luo Zhaoyan join forces with each other and members of the True Martial Alliance: Ju Shifang, Ming Xin, and her uncle Xian Qing, to root out the leaders of the cult while overcoming their personal demons and finding out about the mysterious organizations operating in the shadows.

items.title: Sword and Fairy 1
items.synopsis: Li Xiaoyao, a young inn attendant who dreams of becoming a great hero, accidentally meets Zhao Ling'er, a descendant of the goddess Nuwa. Together, they embark on a quest to find the Water Spiritual Bead, which can end the drought plaguing the land. Along the way, they befriend the bickering partner Lin Yueru and the scholarly Liu Jinyuan, among other like-minded companions. They face numerous dangers in their search for the spiritual bead and ultimately thwart the cataclysmic scheme of the Moon Worship Sect's leader, who aims to destroy the world.

items.title: Sword and Fairy 4
items.synopsis: Yun Tianhe, a young man who had been living alone on a mountain peak, was on a regular boar hunting trip when he came across the young woman Han Lingsha, from a clan of short-lived tomb raiders, attempting to break into his parents' tomb, culminating in the destruction of the tomb, and setting him on a journey alongside Lingsha to the outside world to uncover his parents' past. On the journey, they encountered and befriended the adopted daughter of the magistrate of Shouyang, Liu Mengli, who seemed to have connections to Tianhe's father, and a skilled and kind swordmaster who trained at Mt. Kunlun's Qionghua School since a young age, Murong Ziying.

items.title: Talentless TAKANO
items.synopsis: She looks super competent at work but has no idea what she's doing. He seems like a mess, but he's great at his job. Together — they make quite a team.

items.title: Taylor Swift vs Scooter Braun: Bad Blood
items.synopsis: Follow the feud between global poster Swift and music industry exec Braun, looking at the $300M dispute after Braun bought the rights to Swift’s first six albums. Hear from legal experts, journalists and those close to both Swift and Braun, presenting each side of the argument.

items.title: Teacup
items.synopsis: A mysterious event traps people on a rural Georgia farm, forcing them to unite against an unknown, deadly force. A young boy named Arlo becomes central to uncovering the truth.

items.title: Teasing Master Takagi-san
items.synopsis: Takagi suka mengerjai teman sekelasnya, Nishikata. Walaupun berusaha sekuat tenaga, Nishikata tak akan pernah bisa membalasnya—Takagi terlalu pintar!

items.title: Ted
items.synopsis: It's 1993 and Ted the bear's moment of fame has passed, leaving him living with his best friend, 16-year-old John Bennett, who lives in a working-class Boston home with his parents and cousin. Ted may not be the best influence on John, but when it comes right down to it, he's willing to go out on a limb to help his friend and his family.

items.title: Tell No One
items.synopsis: An arrest operation that both succeeds and fails changes everyone's fate. Waiting in agony means never giving up, and those unspeakable crimes are also waiting for an opportunity to return. This time, it is the final battle between good and evil!

items.title: Tender Light
items.synopsis: The dim light and shadow wake up the dark night, everything is silent, and there is no place to hide the heartbeat. In the lights of the town, Nanya and Zhou Luo encountered a touch of warmth.

items.title: Terlanjur Cinta
items.synopsis: To save her drug addict brother, Salleh from being jailed, Aisha accepted a proposal from an old widower Majid.

items.title: Territory
items.synopsis: Saat ladang ternak terbesar di dunia ditinggalkan tanpa ahli waris yang jelas, para faksi rival ikut menyerbu saat bentrok antargenerasi mengacaukan masa depan lahan itu.

items.title: Terror Tuesday: Extreme
items.synopsis: Serial yang terinspirasi oleh acara radio horor Thailand "Angkhan Khlumpong" ini menyuguhkan delapan cerita berdasarkan pengalaman nyata yang dibagikan oleh pendengar.

items.title: Thank You, Goodnight: The Bon Jovi Story
items.synopsis: An all access series chronicling the epic past and uncertain future of the iconic band Bon Jovi. A 40-year odyssey of rock 'n roll idolatry on the precipice as a vocal injury threatens to bring everything to a halt.

items.title: Thank You, Next
items.synopsis: After a painful breakup, a young lawyer dives head first into the confusing world of modern dating, with the unwavering support of her best friends.

items.title: The 8 Show
items.synopsis: Delapan orang yang terjebak di gedung delapan lantai misterius mengikuti acara yang menarik tetapi berbahaya. Dengan berjalannya waktu, mereka akan mendapat hadiah uang.

items.title: The Accident
items.synopsis: Sebuah pesta ulang tahun yang berakhir tragis berdampak pada hancurnya komunitas yang sangat akrab–menghancurkan banyak keluarga, persahabatan, dan hati.

items.title: The Acolyte
items.synopsis: A hundred years before the rise of the Empire, the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic have prospered for centuries without war. During this time, an investigation into a shocking crime spree pits a Jedi Master against a dangerous warrior from his past.

items.title: The Agency
items.synopsis: Covert CIA agent Martian is ordered to abandon his undercover life and return to London Station. When the love he left behind unexpectedly reappears, their romance reignites, pitting his career, his real identity and his mission against his heart while hurling them both into a deadly game of international intrigue and espionage.

items.title: The Atypical Family
items.synopsis: Once blessed with unique superpowers, a family loses their abilities due to modern day problems — until a mysterious woman changes everything.

items.title: The Auditors
items.synopsis: An office investigative drama that depicts the ups and downs of teamwork between a cool-headed audit team leader and affectionate audit team members.

items.title: The Believers
items.synopsis: Tiga pengusaha yang dikejar waktu merencanakan penipuan berisiko menggunakan kuil Buddha untuk membayar utang perusahaan rintisan mereka yang berjumlah sangat besar.

items.title: The Bequeathed
items.synopsis: After the death of an unknown uncle, a woman inherits a burial ground and finds herself in the center of a string of murders and dark secrets.

items.title: The Best Day of My Life
items.synopsis: After years apart, Xu Mu reunites with her high school classmate, Xie Shi, who has now become a cold and scheming project director. The two find themselves caught in a game of cat-and-mouse and hide-and-seek.

items.title: The Big Cigar
items.synopsis: Salah satu pendiri Partai Black Panther, Huey P. Newton, dibantu oleh sekutu tak terduga, produser Hollywood Bert Schneider, untuk menghindari kejaran FBI dan kabur ke Kuba.

items.title: The Brothers Sun
items.synopsis: Saat keluarganya diincar musuh misterius, anggota triad Taipei pergi ke Los Angeles demi melindungi ibunya yang keras kepala dan adik lelakinya yang tak tahu apa-apa.

items.title: The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin
items.synopsis: Penyamun legendaris Dick Turpin memulai seri pelarian absurd yang liar ketika dia menjadi pemimpin kelompok pelanggar hukum yang enggan - dan ditugaskan untuk mengecoh penegak hukum yang korup, Jonathan Wilde.

items.title: The Creep Tapes
items.synopsis: A secluded serial killer lures videographers into his world with the promise of a paid job documenting his life. Unfortunately, as the tape rolls, the killer's questionable intentions surface with his increasingly odd behavior and the victims will learn they may have made a deadly mistake.

items.title: The Dark Crown
items.synopsis: Betrayed by someone close to her, Yu Luo dies filled with resentment. After being reborn, she vows to take back control of her life, using memories from her past to make waves in the financial world. However, fate intervenes, and she finds herself once again entangled with Liao Youting—the same dark figure who haunted her previous life.

items.title: The Day of the Jackal
items.synopsis: Seorang pembunuh bayaran tak tertandingi dan sangat sulit ditangkap, Jackal, menjalani hidupnya dengan melakukan pembunuhan untuk bayaran tertinggi. Namun, setelah aksinya yang terbaru, ia bertemu lawan sepadan dalam sosok seorang perwira intelijen Inggris yang gigih. Perwira tersebut mulai memburunya dalam permainan kucing dan tikus yang menegangkan di seluruh Eropa, meninggalkan jejak kehancuran di setiap langkahnya.

items.title: The Decameron
items.synopsis: Saat wabah pes menyebar ke seluruh Italia, sekelompok bangsawan dan pelayan pergi ke sebuah vila, tempat liburan mewah mereka dengan cepat berubah menjadi kekacauan.

items.title: The Diamond Sleeping in the Sea
items.synopsis: Set on Hashima Island in Nagasaki Prefecture during the coal industry's rise in 1955, this story follows themes of family, friendship, and love. It contrasts the post-war era, where people had little but were full of dreams, with present-day Tokyo, where abundance prevails, but young people struggle to find their dreams.

items.title: The Dynasty: New England Patriots
items.synopsis: Jelajahi perjalanan 20 tahun tim, dari keterikatan unik yang melecut enam kemenangan Super Bowl hingga konflik internal yang menimbulkan persaingan. Tom Brady, Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft, dan pemain kunci memperlihatkan jalan menuju—dan harga—kejayaan.

items.title: The Elephant is Right Here
items.synopsis: Xiangcheng, a declining fifth-tier town, is about to hold an international marathon. Around this marathon, all kinds of people appear: young people from small towns who organize weddings, gangsters who open mahjong parlors, an acrobatic troupe with few people, and the boss behind the counterfeit money business... Zhang Kuang wanted to hitch a ride on the marathon and opportunistically "borrowed" the elephant from his girlfriend's acrobatic troupe. However, he accidentally lost the elephant and was involved in the vortex of the counterfeit banknote case...

items.title: The Farewell Song
items.synopsis: Ma Zhuo was born in Ya'an, Yucheng. At the age of eight, She was taken to Chengdu by her mother Lin Guoguo to live together. She grew up with Xia Gang's son Xia Ze. The two childhood sweethearts became each other's first love. Lin Guoguo and Xia Gang were accidentally involved in a strange murder. From then on, Ma Zhuo and Xia Ze were emotionally displaced, and their fate was tortuous, pursuing the truth of their fathers in danger and thorns.

items.title: The Fragments of Kylin
items.synopsis: Mo Yan and Xuanyuan Yu have an arranged marriage for the alliance between their two great demon-slaying families. It is supposed to be a two-year superficial marriage, but Mo Yan discovers he has long fallen for her... With endless conflicts and hidden truths, can they truly be together?

items.title: The Franchise
items.synopsis: Para kru sebuah film waralaba yang tidak dicintai berjuang mendapatkan tempat di semesta sinematik yang ganas dan sulit diatur.

items.title: The Frog
items.synopsis: Di musim panas nan damai, seorang wanita misterius masuk ke sebuah penginapan—memicu beragam peristiwa yang mengganggu kehidupan si pemilik dan orang-orang di sekitarnya.

items.title: The Gentlemen
items.synopsis: Saat Eddie si bangsawan mewarisi properti keluarga, ia mendapati bahwa tanah itu merupakan lokasi kerajaan ganja yang sangat besar—dan para pemiliknya tidak mau pergi.

items.title: The Girl Inside Me
items.synopsis: Pressured to marry, modern-day Xiaoxiao is transported into the body of an ancient bathhouse worker, Chu Xiaoran. Armed with a magic pouch of modern items, she helps Chu Xiaoran woo a distant princess while using his body to flirt with every handsome man she meets, leading to a series of comedic misadventures in this whimsical, time-traveling journey.

items.title: The Girls on the Bus
items.synopsis: Four female journalists follow every move of a parade of flawed presidential candidates, while finding friendship, love, and scandal along the way.

items.title: The Great Nobody
items.synopsis: It’s a comedy story about a little panda fairy named Lingling who accidentally entered the Flower Neck Mountain and was mistaken for the king. She and the chicken-blood military strategist Mole jointly led the demon village to become bigger and stronger.

items.title: The Heir's Forbidden Love
items.synopsis: After her mother falls into a coma and her gambler father tries to seize the family fortune, Gu An'an agrees to marry Huo Siwen to protect her inheritance. However, she meets Huo Siting, the overlooked second son, and as they form an alliance, a forbidden romance quietly unfolds.

items.title: The Heiress Luo Wanwan
items.synopsis: Luo Wanwan, the outspoken "chivalrous woman" and daughter of the Director of the Ministry of Rites, was involved in a murder case on the way to escape from marriage. She and her husband, Li Yichen, the young minister of Dali Temple, became a pair of "enemies" without knowing each other. In order to find out the truth, she disguised herself as a man in Dali Temple and became Li's assistant. Together, they fought crime, solved crimes, upheld justice, and developed an ironic romance.

items.title: The Helicopter Heist
items.synopsis: Dua teman masa kecil memutuskan akan melakukan pencurian terakhir—merampok uang jutaan dari tempat penyimpanan teraman di Swedia. Namun, polisi sudah mengintai mereka.

items.title: The Hijacking of Flight 601
items.synopsis: Setelah sebuah pesawat dibajak, dua pramugari harus mengecoh para penyerang mereka di tengah negosiasi yang intens di udara dan di darat. Berdasarkan kejadian nyata.

items.title: The Impossible Heir
items.synopsis: An ambitious boy grows up and joins an intense war of desires to become a star of his own.

items.title: The Indrani Mukerjea Story: Buried Truth
items.synopsis: Dengan berbagai informasi baru dan akses khusus, serial dokumenter ini menyelidiki hilangnya Sheena Bora yang berusia 25 tahun dan buntut mengejutkan dari peristiwa itu.

items.title: The Influencer
items.synopsis: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram—77 pemengaruh elite memamerkan keterampilan mereka untuk menarik perhatian secara strategis di acara kompetisi sosial yang berisiko tinggi ini.

items.title: The Judge from Hell
items.synopsis: A cruel and vicious judge, who wields power only for herself, meets a warm and cheerful detective who puts the victims first.

items.title: The Land of Warriors
items.synopsis: Setelah perpisahan, Tang San dan teman-temannya menjalani pelatihan keras dan meraih kekuatan baru. Namun, ancaman baru dari Istana Wuhun membawa mereka kembali bersatu untuk menjaga perdamaian benua. Berhasilkah mereka melawan kekuatan gelap dan membela keadilan?

items.title: The Legend of Heroes aka Jin Yong Wu Xia Shi Jie
The Legend of ShenLi
items.synopsis:
The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find.

Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale.

The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

items.title: The Life You Wanted
items.synopsis: Gloria akhirnya bahagia setelah bertransisi dan hidup tenang, sampai teman lamanya muncul kembali dengan berita yang mengganggu dan membuat kehidupannya kacau balau.

items.title: The Limbo
items.synopsis: As the New Year approaches, the long-established Luobai Department Store in Haizhou City suddenly experiences a subsidence accident, trapping 13 people underground. This race against time and life brings profound tests of humanity, morality, and faith.

items.title: The Love We Couldn't Keep
items.synopsis: Tang Weiwei, closed off to love, unexpectedly falls for intern Li Shu after a series of comical misunderstandings. Just as she begins to find happiness, she learns Li Shu is the younger brother of her deceased first love—and his arrival was driven by revenge.

items.title: The Madness
items.synopsis: Setelah seorang pakar langganan media menemukan mayat di kedalaman hutan Poconos, ia dijebak atas pembunuhan seorang pendukung supremasi kulit putih yang terkenal.

items.title: The Man with 1000 Kids
items.synopsis: Sejumlah keluarga kini tahu bahwa donor sperma yang selama ini mereka percayai ternyata juga merupakan ayah dari ratusan—atau mungkin ribuan—anak lain di seluruh dunia.

items.title: The Marlow Murder Club
items.synopsis: Retired archaeologist and crossword setter Judith Potts believes that a brutal murder has taken place in the sleepy town of Marlow; when the police refuse to believe her story, she kicks off a private investigation with two unlikely friends.

items.title: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon
items.synopsis: A secret and sweet real-life romance between veteran academy instructor Seo Hye-jin and her flirty student Lee Joon-ho, who returns after 10 years and stirs her heart.

items.title: The New Look
items.synopsis: Serial emosional menegangkan ini menguak cerita mengejutkan tentang bagaimana tokoh busana Christian Dior dan rekannya Balenciaga dan Coco Chanel mengarungi Perang Dunia II dan meluncurkan gaya busana modern.

items.title: The Office
items.synopsis: Hannah Howard adalah direktur pelaksana perusahaan pengemasan Flinley Craddick. Ketika dia mendapat kabar dari Kantor Pusat bahwa cabangnya akan ditutup dan semua orang akan bekerja jarak jauh, dia beralih ke mode bertahan hidup, membuat janji-janji yang tidak dapat dia tepati demi menjaga "keluarga kerja"-nya tetap bersama.

items.title: The Outing
items.synopsis: Three families on a resort outing face unveiled secrets, betrayals, and differing views on love, forever altering their relationships and the company’s fate.

items.title: The Penguin
items.synopsis: With the city in peril following the seawall's collapse, Oswald "Oz" Cobb seeks to fill the power vacuum left by the death of Carmine Falcone and finally give his mother Francis the life he's always promised. But first, Oz must confront his enemies and his own demoralizing reputation as "the Penguin."

items.title: The Pradeeps of Pittsburgh
items.synopsis: The Pradeeps attempt to prove their innocence to a pair of investigating government agents by recounting their initial life in America after moving from India. Though each family member has a different perspective on the events, they weave together a story of humor, heartbreak, and the often-complicated pursuit of their respective American Dreams.

items.title: The Princess Royal
items.synopsis: Li Rong, Tuan Putri Pertama Dinasti Daxia, dan Pei Wenxuan, Sekretariat Agung, memulai perjalanan dari musuh menjadi sahabat dan akhirnya menjadi kekasih. Bersama, mereka menghadapi tantangan, menemukan kebenaran, dan membangun karier, sambil menemukan cinta sejati.

items.title: The Program: Cons, Cults, and Kidnapping
items.synopsis: Bertahun-tahun setelah dikirim ke sekolah disiplin, wanita yang masih dihantui oleh pengalamannya ini mengungkap korupsi dan pelecehan dalam industri remaja bermasalah.

items.title: The Queen of Villains
items.synopsis: Berlatar era '80-an nan liar, seorang gadis baik hati berubah jadi pegulat pro haus darah yang berjaya di pertarungan-pertarungan rusuh, membuat seisi negeri membencinya.

items.title: The Reason We Fall in Love
items.synopsis: Third-year advertising company employee Morita Aoi has long struggled with her self-confidence, as her tall height makes her an anomaly among Japanese women. While taking the elevator at work one day, Aoi's director teases her about her height, but an unexpected savior swoops in to defend her: aloof sales manager Kurosawa Tomonari, whose direct manner of communication gave him a chilly reputation despite his genuine care for others. As Aoi starts to learn more about Tomonari, she begins feeling more drawn to him but can't quite get a read on how he feels. Meanwhile, Tomonari has largely steered clear of relationships, wishing to avoid anything that makes his life more complicated, but even he isn't immune to feeling jealous when others get close to Aoi.

items.title: The Regime
items.synopsis: The story of one year within the walls of the palace of a modern European regime as it begins to unravel.

items.title: The Rise of Ning
items.synopsis: Luo Yining, unbound by traditional formalities, frequently stood up for her downtrodden "Third Brother" Luo Shenyuan, discovering his hidden talents in the process. After heartbreak, she aimed for independence by starting a business. Luo Shenyuan, wrongfully accused, sought the truth about his mentor's death. Grateful for Yining's support, he helped her when her business faced difficulties, and their mutual understanding grew into love.

items.title: The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy
items.synopsis: Pada Musim Satu dari The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy, dokter Sleech dan Klak menangani kasus yang sangat berbahaya dan berpotensi menjadi terobosan yang, dengan melakukan hal tersebut, akan membahayakan keberadaan mereka. Meski mengingat kehidupan pribadi mereka yang suram, ketidaksadaran mungkin merupakan suatu perbaikan.

items.title: The Secret
items.synopsis:
